1.82.22: traya evādhanā rājan bhāryā dāsastathā sutaḥ,
yat te samadhigacchanti yasyaite tasya tad dhanam ॥22॥
1.82.23: devayānyā bhujiṣyāsmi vaśyā ca tava bhārgavī,
sā cāhaṁ ca tvayā rājan bhajanīye bhajasva mām ॥23॥
1.82.27: prajajñe ca tataḥ kāle rājan rājīvalocanā,
1.82.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi yayātyupākhyāne dvyaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥82॥
1.83.1: śrutvā kumāraṁ jātaṁ tu devayānī śucismitā,
1.83.2: kimidaṁ vr̥jinaṁ subhru kr̥taṁ vai kāmalubdhayā ॥2॥
1.83.3: sa mayā varadaḥ kāmaṁ yācito dharmasaṁhitam ॥3॥
1.83.5: śobhanaṁ bhīru yadyevamatha sa jñāyate dvijaḥ,
1.83.6: tapasā tejasā caiva dīpyamānaṁ yathā ravim,
1.83.7: apatyaṁ yadi te labdhaṁ jyeṣṭhācchreṣṭhācca vai dvijāt ॥7॥
1.83.8: anyonyamevamuktvā tu samprahasya ca te mithaḥ,
1.83.9: yaduṁ ca turvasuṁ caiva śakraviṣṇū ivāparau ॥9॥
1.83.10: druhyuṁ cānuṁ ca pūruṁ ca trīn kumārānajījanat ॥10॥
1.83.11: tataḥ kāle tu kasmiṁścid devayānī śucismitā,
1.83.12: dadarśa ca tadā tatra kumārān devarūpiṇaḥ,
1.83.14: evaṁ pr̥ṣṭvā tu rājānaṁ kumārān paryapr̥cchata,
kiṁ nāmadheyaṁ vaṁśo vaḥ putrakāḥ kaśca vaḥ pitā,
prabrūta me yathātathyaṁ śrotumicchāmi taṁ hyaham ॥14॥
1.83.17: śrutvā tu teṣāṁ bālānaṁ savrīḍa iva pārthivaḥ ॥17॥
1.83.18: dr̥ṣṭvā tu teṣāṁ bālānāṁ praṇayaṁ pārthivaṁ prati,
buddhvā ca tattvaṁ sā devī śarmiṣṭhāmidamabravīt ॥18॥
1.83.18d2: pūrvameva mayā proktaṁ tvayā tu vr̥jinaṁ kr̥tam,
1.83.20: nyāyato dharmataścaiva carantī na bibhemi te ॥20॥
1.83.21: yadā tvayā vr̥to bhartā vr̥ta eva tadā mayā,
sakhībhartā hi dharmeṇa bhartā bhavati śobhane ॥21॥
1.83.22: pūjyāsi mama mānyā ca jyeṣṭhā ca brāhmaṇī hyasi,
tvatto’pi me pūjyatamo rājarṣiḥ kiṁ na vettha tat ॥22॥
1.83.22d1: tvatpitrā guruṇā me ca saha datte ubhe śubhe,
tava bhartā ca pūjyaśca poṣyāṁ poṣayatīha mām.
1.83.23: rājan nādyeha vatsyāmi vipriyaṁ me kr̥taṁ tvayā ॥23॥
1.83.29: durbhagāyā mama dvau tu putrau tāta bravīmi te ॥29॥
1.83.30: dharmajña iti vikhyāta eṣa rājā bhr̥gūdvaha,
1.83.33: r̥tuṁ vai yācamānāyā na dadāti pumānr̥tum,
1.83.34: abhikāmāṁ striyaṁ yaśca gamyāṁ rahasi yācitaḥ,
nopaiti sa ca dharmeṣu bhrūṇahetyucyate budhaiḥ ॥34॥
1.83.34d1: yad yad yācati māṁ kaścit tat tad deyamiti vratam,
tvayā ca sāpi dattā me nānyaṁ nāthamihecchati.
1.83.34d2: matvaitanme dharma iti kr̥taṁ brahman kṣamasva mām,
1.83.38: prasādaṁ kuru me brahmañjareyaṁ na viśecca mām ॥38॥
1.83.40: rājyabhāk sa bhaved brahman puṇyabhāk kīrtibhāk tathā,
yo me dadyāt vayaḥ putrastad bhavānanumanyatām ॥40॥
1.83.42: vayo dāsyati te putro yaḥ sa rājā bhaviṣyati,
1.83.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi yayātyupākhyāne tryaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥83॥
1.84.1: jarāṁ prāpya yayātistu svapuraṁ prāpya caiva hi,
putraṁ jyeṣṭhaṁ variṣṭhaṁ ca yadumityabravīd vacaḥ ॥1॥
1.84.2: jarā valī ca māṁ tāta palitāni ca paryaguḥ,
1.84.3: tvaṁ yado pratipadyasva pāpmānaṁ jarayā saha,
1.84.4: pūrṇe varṣasahasre tu punaste yauvanaṁ tvaham,
dattvā svaṁ pratipatsyāmi pāpmānaṁ jarayā saha ॥4॥
1.84.5: tasmājjarāṁ na te rājan grahīṣya iti me matiḥ ॥5॥
1.84.8: santi te bahavaḥ putrā mattaḥ priyatarā nr̥pa,
jarāṁ grahītuṁ dharmajña tasmādanyaṁ vr̥ṇīṣva vai ॥8॥
1.84.9: yat tvaṁ me hr̥dayājjāto vayaḥ svaṁ na prayacchasi,
1.84.11: svaṁ caiva pratipatsyāmi pāpmānaṁ jarayā saha ॥11॥
1.84.13: yat tvaṁ me hr̥dayājjāto vayaḥ svaṁ na prayacchasi,
tasmāt prajā samucchedaṁ turvaso tava yāsyati ॥13॥
1.84.16: evaṁ sa turvasuṁ śaptvā yayātiḥ sutamātmanaḥ,
1.84.17: jarāṁ varṣasahasraṁ me yauvanaṁ svaṁ dadasva ca ॥17॥
1.84.18: svaṁ cādāsyāmi bhūyo’haṁ pāpmānaṁ jarayā saha ॥18॥
1.84.19: na gajaṁ na rathaṁ nāśvaṁ jīrṇo bhuṅkte na ca striyam,
1.84.20: yat tvaṁ me hr̥dayājjāto vayaḥ svaṁ na prayacchasi,
tasmād druhyo priyaḥ kāmo na te sampatsyate kvacit ॥20॥
1.84.21: hastināṁ pīṭhakānāṁ ca gardabhānāṁ tathaiva ca ॥21॥
1.84.22: bastānāṁ ca gavāṁ caiva śibikāyāstathaiva ca,
arājā bhojaśabdaṁ tvaṁ tatra prāpsyasi sānvayaḥ ॥22॥
1.84.23: ano tvaṁ pratipadyasva pāpmānaṁ jarayā saha,
ekaṁ varṣasahasraṁ tu careyaṁ yauvanena te ॥23॥
1.84.24: na juhoti ca kāle’gniṁ tāṁ jarāṁ nābhikāmaye ॥24॥
1.84.25: yat tvaṁ me hr̥dayājjāto vayaḥ svaṁ na prayacchasi,
1.84.27: pūro tvaṁ me priyaḥ putrastvaṁ varīyān bhaviṣyasi,
jarā valī ca māṁ tāta palitāni ca paryaguḥ ॥27॥
1.84.28: pūro tvaṁ pratipadyasva pāpmānaṁ jarayā saha,
kañcit kālaṁ careyaṁ vai viṣayān vayasā tava ॥28॥
1.84.29: svaṁ caiva pratipatsyāmi pāpmānaṁ jarayā saha ॥29॥
1.84.30: yathā’’ttha māṁ mahārāja tat kariṣyāmi te vacaḥ ॥30॥
1.84.31: pratipatsyāmi te rājan pāpmānaṁ jarayā saha,
1.84.32: yauvanaṁ bhavate dattvā cariṣyāmi yathā’’ttha mām ॥32॥
1.84.33: pūro prīto’smi te vatsa prītaścedaṁ dadāmi te,
1.84.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi yayātyupākhyāne caturaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥84॥
1.85.2: dharmāviruddhaṁ rājendra yathārhati sa eva hi ॥2॥
1.85.7: sa samprāpya śubhān kāmāṁstr̥ptaḥ khinnaśca pārthivaḥ,
1.85.9: alakāyāṁ sa kālaṁ tu meruśr̥ṅge tathottare ॥9॥
1.85.10: yadā sa paśyate kālaṁ dharmātmā taṁ mahīpatiḥ,
pūrṇaṁ matvā tataḥ kālaṁ pūruṁ putramuvāca ha ॥10॥
1.85.11: sevitā viṣayāḥ putra yauvanena mayā tava ॥11॥
1.85.13: yat pr̥thivyāṁ vrīhiyavaṁ hiraṇyaṁ paśavaḥ striyaḥ,
ekasyāpi na paryāptaṁ tasmāt tr̥ṣṇāṁ parityajet ॥13॥
1.85.14: yā dustyajā durmatibhiryā na jīryati jīryataḥ,
yo’sau prāṇāntiko rogastāṁ tr̥ṣṇāṁ tyajataḥ sukham ॥14॥
1.85.16: nirdvandvo nirmamo bhūtvā cariṣyāmi mr̥gaiḥ saha ॥16॥
1.85.17: pūro prīto’smi bhadraṁ te gr̥hāṇedaṁ svayauvanam,
rājyaṁ cedaṁ gr̥hāṇa tvaṁ tvaṁ hi me priyakr̥t sutaḥ ॥17॥
1.85.18: yauvanaṁ pratipede ca pūruḥ svaṁ punarātmanaḥ ॥18॥
1.85.20: kathaṁ śukrasya naptāraṁ devayānyāḥ sutaṁ prabho,
1.85.23: brāhmaṇapramukhā varṇāḥ sarve śr̥ṇvantu me vacaḥ,
jyeṣṭhaṁ prati yathā rājyaṁ na deyaṁ me kathañcana ॥23॥
1.85.24: pratikūlaḥ pituryaśca na sa putraḥ satāṁ mataḥ ॥24॥
1.85.25: sa putraḥ putravad yaśca vartate pitr̥mātr̥ṣu ॥25॥
1.85.25d1: puditi narakasyākhyā duḥkhaṁ hi narakaṁ viduḥ,
1.85.25d2: yo bahūnāṁ guṇakaraḥ sa putro jyeṣṭha ucyate.
1.85.25d3: jyeṣṭhāṁśabhāk sa guṇakr̥diha loke paratra ca,
śreyān putro guṇopetaḥ sa putro netaro vr̥thā.
1.85.26: druhyunā cānunā caiva mayyavajñā kr̥tā bhr̥śam ॥26॥
1.85.27: pūruṇā tu kr̥taṁ vākyaṁ mānitaṁ ca viśeṣataḥ,
kanīyān mama dāyādo dhr̥tā yena jarā mama ॥27॥
1.85.28: mama kāmaḥ sa ca kr̥taḥ pūruṇā mitrarūpiṇā,
śukreṇa ca varo dattaḥ kāvyenośanasā svayam ॥28॥
1.85.31: arhaḥ pūruridaṁ rājyaṁ yaḥ sutaḥ priyakr̥t tava,
1.85.32: abhyaṣiñcat tataḥ pūruṁ rājye sve sutamātmanaḥ ॥32॥
1.85.33: dattvā ca pūrave rājyaṁ vanavāsāya dīkṣitaḥ,
purāt sa niryayau rājā brāhmaṇaistāpasaiḥ saha ॥33॥
1.85.34: druhyoḥ sutāstu vai bhojā anostu mlecchajātayaḥ ॥34॥
1.85.35: pūrostu pauravo vaṁśo yatra jāto’si pārthiva,
1.85.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi yayātyupākhyāne pūrvayāyātasamāptau pañcāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥85॥
1.86.1: evaṁ sa nāhuṣo rājā yayātiḥ putramīpsitam,
1.86.2: uṣitvā ca vane vāsaṁ brāhmaṇaiḥ saṁśitavrataḥ,
1.86.3: sa gataḥ svarnivāsaṁ taṁ nivasan muditaḥ sukhī,
1.86.4: sthita āsīdantarikṣe sa tadeti śrutaṁ mayā ॥4॥
1.86.5: tata eva punaścāpi gataḥ svargamiti śrutam,
1.86.6: karmaṇā kena sa divaṁ punaḥ prāpto mahīpatiḥ ॥6॥
1.86.9: caritaṁ śrotumicchāmi divi ceha ca sarvaśaḥ ॥9॥
1.86.16: tathā pañcāgnimadhye ca tapastepe ca vatsaram ॥16॥
1.86.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi uttarayāyāte ṣaḍaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥86॥
1.87.1: svargataḥ sa tu rājendro nivasan devaveśmani,
1.87.3: kathānte tatra śakreṇa sa pr̥ṣṭaḥ pr̥thivīpatiḥ ॥3॥
1.87.5d1: na ca kuryānnaro dainyaṁ śāṭhyaṁ krodhaṁ tathaiva ca,
jaihmyaṁ ca matsaraṁ vairaṁ sarvatraiva na kārayet.
1.87.5d2: mātaraṁ pitaraṁ caiva vidvāṁsaṁ ca tapodhanam,
1.87.5d4: akarmī karmiṇaṁ dveṣṭi dhārmikaṁ ca na dhārmikaḥ.
1.87.12: na hīdr̥śaṁ saṁvananaṁ triṣu lokeṣu vidyate,
dayā maitrī ca bhūteṣu dānaṁ ca madhurā ca vāk ॥12॥
1.87.13: tasmāt sāntvaṁ sadā vācyaṁ na vācyaṁ paruṣaṁ kvacit,
pūjyān sampūjayed dadyānna ca yācet kadācana ॥13॥
1.87.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi uttarayāyāte saptāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥87॥
1.88.4: kṣayaṁ gatā me yadi śakra lokāḥ,
1.88.10: na ca tvamasmān pr̥cchasi ye vayaṁ smaḥ,
1.88.13: prabhuḥ sūryaḥ prakāśitve satāṁ cābhyāgataḥ prabhuḥ ॥13॥
1.88.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi uttarayāyāte aṣṭāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥88॥
1.89.3: sa vai rājan nābhyadhikaḥ kathyate ca,
1.89.5: abhūd dhanaṁ me vipulaṁ gataṁ tad
1.89.7: tat tat prāpya na vihanyeta dhīro
1.89.12: kiṁ kuryāṁ vai kiṁ ca kr̥tvā na tapye
1.89.14: stvayā bhuktā yaṁ ca kālaṁ yathāvat,
tān me rājan brūhi sarvān yathāvat
1.89.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi uttarayāyāte ekonanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥89॥
1.90.3: tad vai brūhi kṣetravit tvaṁ mato me ॥3॥
1.90.10: sa vai tasyā raja āpadyate vai
1.90.15: sa vai rūpaṁ paśyati cakṣuṣā ca ॥15॥
1.90.23: na cāsya tad brahma phalaṁ dadāti ॥23॥
1.90.26: iti dadyāmiti yaja ityadhīya iti vratam,
1.90.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi uttarayāyāte navatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥90॥
1.91.9: araṇye vasato yasya grāmo bhavati pr̥ṣṭhataḥ,
grāme vā vasato’raṇyaṁ sa muniḥ syājjanādhipa ॥9॥
1.91.10: grāme vā vasato’raṇyaṁ kathaṁ bhavati pr̥ṣṭhataḥ ॥10॥
1.91.16: sa ca lokamimaṁ jitvā lokaṁ vijayate param ॥16॥
1.91.17: atha lokamimaṁ jitvā lokaṁ vijayate param ॥17॥
1.91.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi uttarayāyāte ekanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥91॥
1.92.2: grāma eva vasan bhikṣustayoḥ pūrvataraṁ gataḥ ॥2॥
1.92.3: avāpya dīrghamāyustu yaḥ prāpto vikr̥tiṁ caret,
tapyate yadi tat kr̥tvā caret so’nyat tapastataḥ ॥3॥
1.92.4: pāpānāṁ karmaṇāṁ nityaṁ bibhiyād yastu mānavaḥ,
1.92.11: ye me lokā divi rājendra santi,
1.92.16: ye me lokāstava te vai bhavantu,
1.92.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi uttarayāyāte dvinavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥92॥
1.93.3: ye me lokāstava te vai bhavantu,
1.93.5: ahaṁ na tān vai pratigantā narendra
1.93.8: na cāhaṁ tān pratipatsye ha dattvā
1.93.10: sarve pradāya bhavate gantāro narakaṁ vayam ॥10॥
1.93.11: ahaṁ tannābhijānāmi yat kr̥taṁ na mayā purā ॥11॥
1.93.13d4: paśyantī yajñamāhātmyaṁ mudaṁ lebhe ca mādhavī,
1.93.13d5: tato vasumanāḥ pr̥cchan mātaraṁ vai tapasvinīm.
1.93.13d6: ko’yaṁ devo’thavā rājā yadi jānāsi me vada.
1.93.13d7: śr̥ṇudhvaṁ sahitāḥ putrā nāhuṣo’yaṁ pitā mama,
1.93.13d8: pūruṁ me bhrātaraṁ rājye samāveśya divaṁ gataḥ,
kena vā kāraṇenaiva iha prāpto mahāyaśāḥ.
1.93.13d15: sa kālaḥ kutapo nāma pitr̥̄ṇāṁ dattamakṣayam.
1.93.13d16: tilāḥ piśācād rakṣanti darbhā rakṣanti rākṣasāt,
1.93.13d17: labdhvā pātraṁ tu vidvāṁsaṁ śrotriyaṁ suvrataṁ śucim,
sa kālaḥ kālato dattaṁ nānyathā kāla iṣyate.
1.93.15: eṣa no virajāḥ panthā dr̥śyate devasadmanaḥ ॥15॥
1.93.18: uśīnarasya putro’yaṁ tasmācchreṣṭho hi vaḥ śibiḥ ॥18॥
1.93.21: kr̥taṁ tvayā yaddhi na tasya kartā
1.93.27: yo naḥ svargajitaḥ sarvān yathā vr̥ttaṁ nivedayet,
1.93.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi uttarayāyātasamāptau trinavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥93॥
1.94.2: na hyasmin śīlahīno vā nirvīryo vā narādhipaḥ,
1.94.4: hanta te kathayiṣyāmi yanmāṁ tvaṁ paripr̥cchasi,
1.94.15: ājahāra yaśo dīptaṁ jigāya ca vasundharām ॥15॥
1.94.16: so’pi kr̥tsnāmimāṁ bhūmiṁ vijigye jayatāṁ varaḥ ॥16॥
1.94.18: duṣyantaṁ śūrabhīmau ca pravasuṁ vasumeva ca,
1.94.22: lebhe putraṁ bharadvājād bhumanyuṁ nāma bhārata ॥22॥
1.94.28: suhotre rājani tadā dharmataḥ śāsati prajāḥ ॥28॥
1.94.30: ajamīḍhaṁ sumīḍhaṁ ca purumīḍhaṁ ca bhārata ॥30॥
1.94.31: ṣaṭ putrān so’pyajanayat tisr̥ṣu strīṣu bhārata ॥31॥
1.94.34: r̥kṣāt saṁvaraṇo jajñe rājan vaṁśakaraḥ sutaḥ ॥34॥
1.94.38: abhyayāt taṁ ca pāñcālyo vijitya tarasā mahīm,
1.94.44: tamāsane copaviṣṭaṁ rājā vavre svayaṁ tadā,
1.94.47: tataḥ sa pr̥thivīṁ prāpya punarīje mahābalaḥ ॥47॥
1.94.48: tataḥ saṁvaraṇāt saurī tapatī suṣuve kurum ॥48॥
1.94.49: rājatve taṁ prajāḥ sarvā dharmajña iti vavrire,
1.94.50: kurukṣetraṁ sa tapasā puṇyaṁ cakre mahātapāḥ,
1.94.60: pratīpaṁ dharmanetraṁ ca sunetraṁ cāpi bhārata,
1.94.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi pūruvaṁśānukīrtane caturnavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥94॥
1.95.1: śrutastvatto mayā brahman pūrveṣāṁ sambhavo mahān,
1.95.2: prīṇātyato bhavān bhūyo vistareṇa bravītu me ॥2॥
1.95.7: dakṣādaditiraditervivasvān vivasvato manurmano-rilā ilāyāḥ purūravāḥ purūravasa āyurāyuṣo nahuṣo nahuṣād yayātiḥ; yayāterdve bhārye babhūvatuḥ ॥7॥
1.95.8: uśanaso duhitā devayānī; vr̥ṣaparvaṇaśca duhitā śarmiṣṭhā nāma ॥8॥
1.95.9: yaduṁ ca turvasuṁ caiva devayānī vyajāyata,
druhyuṁ cānuṁ ca pūruṁ ca śarmiṣṭhā vārṣaparvaṇī ॥9॥
1.95.11: pūrostu bhāryā kausalyā nāma, tasyāmasya jajñe janamejayo nāma; yastrīnaśvamedhānājahāra, viśvajitā ceṣṭvā vanaṁ viveśa ॥11॥
1.95.12: janamejayaḥ khalvanantāṁ nāmopayeme mādhavīm, tasyāmasya jajñe prācinvān; yaḥ prācīṁ diśaṁ jigāya yāvat sūryodayāt, tatastasya prācinvattvam ॥12॥
1.95.13: prācinvān khalvaśmakīmupayeme yādavīm, tasyāmasya jajñe saṁyātiḥ ॥13॥
1.95.14: saṁyātiḥ khalu dr̥ṣadvato duhitaraṁ varāṅgīṁ nāmopayeme, tasyāmasya jajñe ahaṁyātiḥ ॥14॥
1.95.15: ahaṁyātiḥ khalu kr̥tavīryaduhitaramupayeme bhānumatīṁ nāma, tasyāmasya jajñe sārvabhaumaḥ ॥15॥
1.95.16: sārvabhaumaḥ khalu jitvā jahāra kaikeyīṁ sunandāṁ nāma, tāmupayeme, tasyāmasya jajñe jayatseno nāma ॥16॥
1.95.17: jayatseno khalu vaidarbhīmupayeme suśravāṁ nāma, tasyāmasya jajñe avācīnaḥ ॥17॥
1.95.18: avācīno’pi vaidarbhīmaparāmevopayeme maryādāṁ nāma, tasyāmasya jajñe arihaḥ ॥18॥
1.95.20: mahābhaumaḥ khalu prāsenajitīmupayeme suyajñā nāma, tasyāmasya jajñe ayutanāyī; yaḥ puruṣamedhānāmayutamānayat, tenāsyāyutanāyitvam ॥20॥
1.95.21: ayutanāyī khalu pr̥thuśravaso duhitaramupayeme kāmāṁ nāma, tasyāmasya jajñe akrodhanaḥ ॥21॥
1.95.22: sa khalu kāliṅgīṁ karambhāṁ nāmopayeme, tasyāmasya jajñe devātithiḥ ॥22॥
1.95.23: devātithiḥ khalu vaidehīmupayeme maryādāṁ nāma, tasyāmasya jajñe ariho nāma ॥23॥
1.95.24: arihaḥ khalvāṅgeyīmupayeme sudevāṁ nāma, tasyāṁ putramajījanadr̥kṣam ॥24॥
1.95.25: r̥kṣaḥ khalu takṣakaduhitaramupayeme jvālāṁ nāma, tasyāṁ putraṁ matināraṁ nāmotpādayāmāsa ॥25॥
1.95.26: matināraḥ khalu sarasvatyāṁ guṇasamanvitaṁ dvādaśavārṣikaṁ satramāharat, samāpte ca satre sarasvatya-bhigamya taṁ bhartāraṁ varayāmāsa, tasyāṁ putramajījanat taṁsuṁ nāma ॥26॥
1.95.29: duṣyantaḥ khalu viśvāmitraduhitaraṁ śakuntalāṁ nāmopayeme, tasyāmasya jajñe bharataḥ ॥29॥
1.95.30: bhastrā mātā pituḥ putro yena jātaḥ sa eva saḥ,
1.95.31: tvaṁ cāsya dhātā garbhasya satyamāha śakuntalā ॥31॥
1.95.32: tato’sya bharatatvam, bharataḥ khalu kāśeyīmupayeme sārvasenīṁ sunandāṁ nāma, tasyāmasya jajñe bhumanyuḥ ॥32॥
1.95.33: bhumanyuḥ khalu dāśārhīmupayeme vijayāṁ nāma, tasyāmasya jajñe suhotraḥ ॥33॥
1.95.34: suhotraḥ khalvikṣvākukanyāmupayeme suvarṇāṁ nāma, tasyāmasya jajñe hastī; ya idaṁ hāstinapuraṁ sthāpayāmāsa, etadasya hāstinapuratvam ॥34॥
1.95.35: hastī khalu traigartīmupayeme yaśodharāṁ nāma, tasyāmasya jajñe vikuṇṭhano nāma ॥35॥
1.95.36: vikuṇṭhanaḥ khalu dāśārhīmupayeme sudevāṁ nāma, tasyāmasya jajñe ajamīḍho nāma ॥36॥
1.95.37: ajamīḍhasya caturviṁśaṁ putraśataṁ babhūva kaikeyyāṁ gāndhāryāṁ viśālāyāmr̥kṣāyāṁ ceti, pr̥thak pr̥thak vaṁśadharā nr̥patayaḥ, tatra vaṁśakaraḥ saṁvaraṇaḥ ॥37॥
1.95.38: saṁvaraṇaḥ khalu vaivasvatīṁ tapatīṁ nāmopayeme, tasyāmasya jajñe kuruḥ ॥38॥
1.95.39: kuruḥ khalu dāśārhīmupayeme śubhāṅgīṁ nāma, tasyāmasya jajñe vidūraḥ ॥39॥
1.95.40: vidūrastu mādhavīmupayeme sampriyāṁ nāma, tasyā-masya jajñe anaśvā nāma ॥40॥
1.95.41: anaśvā khalu māgadhīmupayeme amr̥tāṁ nāma, tasyāmasya jajñe parikṣit ॥41॥
1.95.42: parikṣit khalu bāhudāmupayeme suyaśāṁ nāma, tasyāmasya jajñe bhīmasenaḥ ॥42॥
1.95.43: bhīmasenaḥ khalu kaikeyīmupayeme kumārīṁ nāma, tasyāmasya jajñe pratiśravā nāma ॥43॥
1.95.44: pratiśravasaḥ pratīpaḥ khalu, śaibyāmupayeme sunandāṁ nāma, tasyāṁ putrānutpādayāmāsa devāpiṁ śāntanuṁ bāhlīkaṁ ceti ॥44॥
1.95.45: devāpiḥ khalu bāla evāraṇyaṁ viveśa, śāntanustu mahīpālo babhūva ॥45॥
1.95.46: yaṁ yaṁ karābhyāṁ spr̥śati jīrṇaṁ sa sukhamaśnute, punaryuvā ca bhavati tasmāt taṁ śāntanuṁ viduḥ ॥ iti tadasya śāntanutvam ॥46॥
1.95.47: śāntanuḥ khalu gaṅgāṁ bhāgīrathīmupayeme, tasyāmasya jajñe devavrato nāmaḥ yamāhurbhīṣmamiti ॥47॥
1.95.48: bhīṣmaḥ khalu pituḥ priyacikīrṣayā satyavatīṁ mātaramudavāhayat; yāmāhurgandhakālīti ॥48॥
1.95.49: tasyāṁ pūrvaṁ kānīno garbhaḥ parāśarād dvaipāyano’bhavat, tasyāmeva śāntanoranyau dvau putrau babhūvatuḥ ॥49॥
1.95.50: vicitravīryaścitrāṅgadaśca, tayoraprāptayauvana eva citrāṅgado gandharveṇa hataḥ; vicitravīryastu rājā’’sīt ॥50॥
1.95.52: vicitravīryastvanapatya eva videhatvaṁ prāptaḥ, tataḥ satyavatyacintayanmā dauṣyanto vaṁśa ucchedaṁ vrajediti ॥52॥
1.95.53: sā dvaipāyanamr̥ṣiṁ manasā cintayāmāsa, sa tasyāḥ purataḥ sthitaḥ, kiṁ karavāṇīti ॥53॥
1.95.54: sā tamuvāca—bhrātā tavānapatya eva svaryāto vicitravīryaḥ, sādhvapatyaṁ tasyotpādayeti ॥54॥
1.95.55: sa tathetyuktvā trīn putrānutpādayāmāsa; dhr̥tarāṣṭraṁ pāṇḍuṁ viduraṁ ceti ॥55॥
1.95.56: tatra dhr̥tarāṣṭrasya rājñaḥ putraśataṁ babhūva gāndhāryāṁ varadānād dvaipāyanasya ॥56॥
1.95.57: teṣāṁ dhr̥tarāṣṭrasya putrāṇāṁ catvāraḥ pradhānā babhūvuḥ; duryodhano duḥśāsano vikarṇaścitrasenaśceti ॥57॥
1.95.58: pāṇḍostu dve bhārye babhūvatuḥ kuntī pr̥thā nāma mādrī ca ityubhe strīratne ॥58॥
1.95.59: atha pāṇḍurmr̥gayāṁ caran maithunagatamr̥ṣimapaśyanmr̥gyāṁ vartamānam, tathaivādbhutamanāsāditakāmarasamatr̥ptaṁ ca bāṇenājaghāna ॥59॥
1.95.60: sa bāṇaviddha uvāca pāṇḍum—caratā dharmamimaṁ yena tvayābhijñena kāmarasasyāhamanavāptakāmaraso nihatastasmāt tvamapyetāmavasthāmāsādyānavāptakāmarasaḥ pañcatvamāpsyasi kṣiprameveti, sa vivarṇarūpastathā pāṇḍuḥ śāpaṁ pariharamāṇo nopāsarpata bhārye, vākyaṁ covāca— ॥60॥
1.95.61: svacāpalyādidaṁ prāptavānahaṁ śr̥ṇomi ca nānapatyasya lokāḥ santīti, sā tvaṁ madarthe putrānutpādayeti kuntīmuvāca, sā tathoktā putrānutpādayāmāsa, dharmād yudhiṣṭhiraṁ mārutād bhīmasenaṁ śakrādarjunamiti ॥61॥
1.95.62: iyaṁ te sapatnyanapatyā; sādhvasyā apatyamutpādyatāmiti, evamastviti kuntī tāṁ vidyāṁ mādryāḥ prāyacchat ॥62॥
1.95.64: mādrīṁ khalvalaṅkr̥tāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā pāṇḍurbhāvaṁ cakre ca tāṁ spr̥ṣṭvaiva videhatvaṁ prāptaḥ ॥64॥
1.95.65: tatrainaṁ citāgnisthaṁ mādrī samanvāruroha uvāca kuntīm; yamayorapramattayā tvayā bhavitavyamiti ॥65॥
1.95.66: tataste pāṇḍavāḥ kuntyā sahitā hāstinapura-mānīya tāpasairbhīṣmasya ca vidurasya ca niveditāḥ, sarvavarṇānāṁ ca nivedyāntarhitāstāpasā babhūvuḥ prekṣya-māṇānāṁ teṣām ॥66॥
1.95.67: tacca vākyamupaśrutya bhagavatāmantarikṣāt puṣpavr̥ṣṭiḥ papāta; devadundubhayaśca praṇeduḥ ॥67॥
1.95.68: pratigr̥hītāśca pāṇḍavāḥ piturnidhanamāvedayan tasyaurdhvadehikaṁ nyāyataśca kr̥tavantaḥ, tāṁstatra nivasataḥ pāṇḍavān bālyāt prabhr̥ti duryodhano nāmarṣayat ॥68॥
1.95.69: pāpācāro rākṣasīṁ buddhimāśrito’nekairupāyairuddhartuṁ ca vyavasitaḥ; bhāvitvāccārthasya na śakitāste samuddhartum ॥69॥
1.95.71: tatrāpi jatugr̥he dagdhuṁ samārabdhā na śakitā viduramantriteneti ॥71॥
1.95.73: tasyāmapyekacakrāyāṁ bakaṁ nāma rākṣasaṁ hatvā pāñcālanagaramadhigatāḥ ॥73॥
1.95.75: kuśalinaḥ putrāṁścotpādayāmāsuḥ, prativindhyaṁ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ, sutasomaṁ vr̥kodaraḥ, śrutakīrtimarjunaḥ, śatānīkaṁ nakulaḥ, śrutakarmāṇaṁ sahadeva iti ॥75॥
1.95.76: yudhiṣṭhirastu govāsanasya śaibyasya devikāṁ nāma kanyāṁ svayaṁvare lebhe, tasyāṁ putraṁ janayāmāsa yaudheyaṁ nāma ॥76॥
1.95.77: bhīmaseno’pi kāśyāṁ balandharāṁ nāmopayeme vīrya-śulkām, tasyāṁ putraṁ sarvagaṁ nāmotpādayāmāsa ॥77॥
1.95.78: arjunaḥ khalu dvāravatīṁ gatvā bhaginīṁ vāsudevasya subhadrāṁ bhadrabhāṣiṇīṁ bhāryāmudāvahat, svaviṣayaṁ cābhyājagāma kuśalī, tasyāṁ putramabhimanyumatīva guṇasampannaṁ dayitaṁ vāsudevasyājanayat ॥78॥
1.95.79: nakulastu caidyāṁ kareṇumatīṁ nāma bhāryāmudāvahat, tasyāṁ putraṁ niramitraṁ nāmājanayat ॥79॥
1.95.80: sahadevo’pi mādrīmeva svayaṁvare vijayāṁ nāmopayeme madrarājasya dyutimato duhitaram, tasyāṁ putramajanayat suhotraṁ nāma ॥80॥
1.95.81: bhīmasenastu pūrvameva hiḍimbāyāṁ rākṣasaṁ ghaṭotkacaṁ putramutpādayāmāsa ॥81॥
1.95.82: ityeta ekādaśa pāṇḍavānāṁ putrāḥ, teṣāṁ vaṁśakaro’bhimanyuḥ ॥82॥
1.95.83: sa virāṭasya duhitaramupayeme uttarāṁ nāma, tasyāmasya parāsurgarbho’bhavat, tamutsaṅgena pratijagrāha pr̥thā niyogāt puruṣottamasya vāsudevasya, ṣāṇmāsikaṁ garbhamahamenaṁ jīvayiṣyāmīti ॥83॥
1.95.84: sa bhagavatā vāsudevenāsañjātabalavīrya-parākramo’kālajāto’strāgninā dagdhastejasā svena sañjīvitaḥ, jīvayitvā cainamuvāca—parikṣīṇe kule jāto bhavatvayaṁ parikṣinnāmeti ॥84॥
1.95.85: parikṣit khalu mādravatīṁ nāmopayeme tvanmātaram, tasyāṁ bhavān janamejayaḥ ॥85॥
1.95.86: bhavato vapuṣṭamāyāṁ dvau putrau jajñāte; śatānīkaḥ śaṅkukarṇaśca, śatānīkasya vaidehyāṁ putra utpanno’śva-medhadatta iti ॥86॥
1.95.87: eṣa pūrorvaṁśaḥ pāṇḍavānāṁ ca kīrtitaḥ; dhanyaḥ puṇyaḥ paramapavitraḥ satataṁ śrotavyo brāhmaṇairniyama-vadbhiranantaraṁ kṣatriyaiḥ svadharmanirataiḥ prajāpālana-tatparairvaiśyairapi ca śrotavyo’dhigamyaśca tathā śūdrairapi trivarṇaśuśrūṣubhiḥ śraddadhānairiti ॥87॥
1.95.88: itihāsamimaṁ puṇyamaśeṣataḥ śrāvayiṣyanti ye narāḥ śroṣyanti vā niyatātmāno vimatsarā maitrā veda-parāste’pi svargajitaḥ puṇyalokā bhavanti satataṁ devabrāhmaṇamanuṣyāṇāṁ mānyāḥ sampūjyāśca ॥88॥
1.95.89: paraṁ hīdaṁ bhārataṁ bhagavatā vyāsena proktaṁ pāvanaṁ ye brāhmaṇādayo varṇāḥ śraddadhānā amatsarā maitrā vedasampannāḥ śroṣyanti, te’pi svargajitaḥ sukr̥tino’śocyāḥ kr̥tākr̥te bhavanti ॥89॥
1.95.90: idaṁ hi vedaiḥ samitaṁ pavitramapi cottamam,
1.95.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi pūruvaṁśānukīrtane pañcanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥95॥
1.96.2: toṣayāmāsa deveśaṁ svargaṁ lebhe tataḥ prabhuḥ ॥2॥
1.96.3: tatra rājarṣayo hyāsan sa ca rājā mahābhiṣaḥ ॥3॥
1.96.7: sā te vai mānuṣe loke vipriyāṇyācariṣyati ॥7॥
1.96.8: yadā te bhavitā manyustadā śāpād vimokṣyase,
1.96.9: mahābhiṣaṁ tu taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā nadī dhairyāccyutaṁ nr̥pam ॥9॥
1.96.11: dadarśa pathi gacchantī vasūn devān divaukasaḥ,
tathārūpāṁśca tān dr̥ṣṭvā papraccha saritāṁ varā ॥11॥
1.96.12: kimidaṁ naṣṭarūpāḥ stha kaccit kṣemaṁ divaukasām,
tāmūcurvasavo devāḥ śaptāḥ smo vai mahānadi ॥12॥
1.96.14: tena kopād vayaṁ śaptā yonau sambhavateti ha ॥14॥
1.96.15: tvamasmān mānuṣī bhūtvā sr̥ja putrān-vasūn bhuvi ॥15॥
1.96.16: na mānuṣīṇāṁ jaṭharaṁ praviśema vayaṁ śubhe,
1.96.17: martyeṣu puruṣaśreṣṭhaḥ ko vaḥ kartā bhaviṣyati,
bhavitā mānuṣe loke sa naḥ kartā bhaviṣyati ॥17॥
1.96.18: mamāpyevaṁ mataṁ devā yathā māṁ vadatānaghāḥ,
1.96.19: jātān kumārān svānapsu prakṣeptuṁ vai tvamarhasi,
yathā na cirakālaṁ no niṣkr̥tiḥ syāt trilokage ॥19॥
1.96.20: nāsya moghaḥ saṅgamaḥ syāt putrahetormayā saha ॥20॥
1.96.21: tena vīryeṇa putraste bhavitā tasya cepsitaḥ ॥21॥
1.96.22: na sampatsyati martyeṣu punastasya tu santatiḥ,
1.96.23: evaṁ te samayaṁ kr̥tvā gaṅgayā vasavaḥ saha,
1.96.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi mahābhiṣopākhyāne ṣaṇṇavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥96॥
1.97.4: karomi kiṁ te kalyāṇi priyaṁ yat te’bhikāṅkṣitam ॥4॥
1.97.5: tvāmahaṁ kāmaye rājan bhajamānāṁ bhajasva mām,
1.97.6: na cāsavarṇāṁ kalyāṇi dharmyametaddhi me vratam ॥6॥
1.97.7: nāśreyasyasmi nāgamyā na vaktavyā ca karhicit,
bhajantīṁ bhaja māṁ rājan divyāṁ kanyāṁ varastriyam ॥7॥
1.97.8: tvayā nivr̥ttametat tu yanmāṁ codayasi priyam,
1.97.11: snuṣā me bhava suśroṇi putrārthaṁ tvāṁ vr̥ṇomyaham,
1.97.12: tvadbhaktyā tu bhajiṣyāmi prakhyātaṁ bhārataṁ kulam ॥12॥
1.97.13: pr̥thivyāṁ pārthivā ye ca teṣāṁ yūyaṁ parāyaṇam,
guṇā na hi mayā śakyā vaktuṁ varṣaśatairapi ॥13॥
1.97.14: samayeneha dharmajña ācareyaṁ ca yad vibho ॥14॥
1.97.15: tat sarvameva putraste na mīmāṁseta karhicit,
evaṁ vasantī putre te vardhayiṣyāmyahaṁ ratim ॥15॥
1.97.16: putraiḥ puṇyaiḥ priyaiścaiva svargaṁ prāpsyati te sutaḥ,
1.97.17: putrajanma pratīkṣan vai sa rājā tadadhārayat,
1.97.18: tayoḥ samabhavat putro vr̥ddhayoḥ sa mahābhiṣaḥ ॥18॥
1.97.18d1: śriyā paramayā yuktaḥ śaracchukle yathā śaśī.
1.97.19d3: sa tu lebhe parāṁ niṣṭhāṁ prāpya dharmavidāṁ varaḥ.
1.97.19d4: dhanurvede ca vede ca gatiṁ sa paramāṁ gataḥ,
yauvanaṁ cāpi samprāptaḥ kumāro vadatāṁ varaḥ.
1.97.21: purā strī māṁ samabhyāgācchāntano bhūtaye tava,
tvāmāvrajed yadi rahaḥ sā putra varavarṇinī ॥21॥
1.97.22: sā tvayā nānuyoktavyā kāsi kasyāsi cāṅgane ॥22॥
1.97.23: yacca kuryānna tat karma sā praṣṭavyā tvayānagha,
manniyogād bhajantīṁ tāṁ bhajethā ityuvāca tam ॥23॥
1.97.24: evaṁ sandiśya tanayaṁ pratīpaḥ śāntanuṁ tadā,
sve ca rājye’bhiṣicyainaṁ vanaṁ rājā viveśa ha ॥24॥
1.97.30: sā ca dr̥ṣṭvaiva rājānaṁ vicarantaṁ mahādyutim,
1.97.31: devī vā dānavī vā tvaṁ gandharvī cātha vāpsarāḥ ॥31॥
1.97.32: yakṣī vā pannagī vāpi mānuṣī vā sumadhyame,
yāce tvāṁ suragarbhābhe bhāryā me bhava śobhane ॥32॥
1.97.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi śāntanūpākhyāne saptanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥97॥
1.98.1: etacchrutvā vaco rājñaḥ sasmitaṁ mr̥du valgu ca,
1.98.1d1: sā ca dr̥ṣṭvā nr̥paśreṣṭhaṁ carantaṁ tīramāśritam.
1.98.2: uvāca caiva rājñaḥ sā hlādayantī mano girā,
1.98.3: yat tu kuryāmahaṁ rājañchubhaṁ vā yadi vāśubham,
na tad vārayitavyāsmi na vaktavyā tathāpriyam ॥3॥
1.98.4: evaṁ hi vartamāne’haṁ tvayi vatsyāmi pārthiva,
1.98.5: tatheti sā yadā tūktā tadā bharatasattama,
1.98.5d1: rathamāropya tāṁ devīṁ jagāma sa tayā saha,
1.98.6: āsādya śāntanustāṁ ca bubhuje kāmato vaśī,
na praṣṭavyeti manvāno na sa tāṁ kiñcidūcivān ॥6॥
1.98.8: divyarūpā hi sā devī gaṅgā tripathagāminī,
1.98.10: rājānaṁ ramayāmāsa yathā reme tathaiva saḥ ॥10॥
1.98.11: saṁvatsarānr̥tūn māsān bubudhe na bahūn gatān ॥11॥
1.98.13: jātaṁ jātaṁ ca sā putraṁ kṣipatyambhasi bhārata,
1.98.14: tasya tanna priyaṁ rājñaḥ śāntanorabhavat tadā,
na ca tāṁ kiñcanovāca tyāgād bhīto mahīpatiḥ ॥14॥
1.98.16: mā vadhīḥ kasya kāsīti kiṁ hinatsi sutāniti,
putraghni sumahat pāpaṁ samprāptaṁ te sugarhitam ॥16॥
1.98.17: putrakāma na te hanmi putraṁ putravatāṁ vara,
jīrṇastu mama vāso’yaṁ yathā sa samayaḥ kr̥taḥ ॥17॥
1.98.20: madvidhā mānuṣī dhātrī loke nāstīha kācana ॥20॥
1.98.23: tat te śāpād vinirmuktā āpavasya mahātmanaḥ,
svasti te’stu gamiṣyāmi putraṁ pāhi mahāvratam ॥23॥
1.98.24: eṣa paryāyavāso me vasūnāṁ saṁnidhau kr̥taḥ,
1.99.1: āpavo nāma ko nveṣa vasūnāṁ kiṁ ca duṣkr̥tam,
1.99.2: anena ca kumāreṇa tvayā dattena kiṁ kr̥tam,
1.99.3: īśā vai sarvalokasya vasavaste ca vai katham,
1.99.5: yaṁ lebhe varuṇaḥ putraṁ purā bharatasattama,
vasiṣṭhanāmā sa muniḥ khyāta āpava ityuta ॥5॥
1.99.8: gāṁ prajātā tu sā devī kaśyapād bharatarṣabha ॥8॥
1.99.9: tāṁ lebhe gāṁ tu dharmātmā homadhenuṁ sa vāruṇiḥ ॥9॥
1.99.10: cacāra puṇye ramye ca gaurapetabhayā tadā ॥10॥
1.99.12: te sadārā vanaṁ tacca vyacaranta samantataḥ,
1.99.13: sañcarantī vane tasmin gāṁ dadarśa sumadhyamā ॥13॥
1.99.15: dyave vai darśayāmāsa tāṁ gāṁ govr̥ṣabhekṣaṇa,
āpīnāṁ ca sudogdhrīṁ ca suvāladhikhurāṁ śubhām ॥15॥
1.99.17: dyaustadā tāṁ tu dr̥ṣṭvaiva gāṁ gajendrendravikrama ॥17॥
1.99.18: uvāca rājaṁstāṁ devīṁ tasyā rūpaguṇān vadan,
1.99.19: asyāḥ kṣīraṁ pibenmartyaḥ svādu yo vai sumadhyame ॥19॥
1.99.20: etacchrutvā tu sā devī nr̥pottama sumadhyamā ॥20॥
1.99.21: asti me mānuṣe loke naradevātmajā sakhī ॥21॥
1.99.24: yāvadasyāḥ payaḥ pītvā sā sakhī mama mānada ॥24॥
1.99.27: pr̥thvādyairbhrātr̥bhiḥ sārdhaṁ dyaustadā tāṁ jahāra gām,
1.99.28: hr̥tā gauḥ sā sadā tena prapātastu na tarkitaḥ ॥28॥
1.99.29: na cāpaśyat sa gāṁ tatra savatsāṁ kānanottame ॥29॥
1.99.31: yayau krodhavaśaṁ sadyaḥ śaśāpa ca vasūṁstadā ॥31॥
1.99.32: yasmānme vasavo jahnurgāṁ vai dogdhrīṁ suvāladhim,
tasmāt sarve janiṣyanti mānuṣeṣu na saṁśayaḥ ॥32॥
1.99.34: śaptvā ca tān mahābhāgastapasyeva mano dadhe,
evaṁ sa śaptavān rājan vasūnaṣṭau tapodhanaḥ ॥34॥
1.99.36: śaptāḥ sma iti jānanta r̥ṣiṁ tamupacakramuḥ,
1.99.37: lebhire na ca tasmāt te prasādamr̥ṣisattamāt,
1.99.38: uvāca ca sa dharmātmā śaptā yūyaṁ dharādayaḥ,
1.99.39: ayaṁ tu yatkr̥te yūyaṁ mayā śaptāḥ sa vatsyati,
1.99.42: evamuktvā vasūn sarvān sa jagāma mahānr̥ṣiḥ,
1.99.43: ayācanta ca māṁ rājan varaṁ tacca mayā kr̥tam,
1.99.45: dyau rājan mānuṣe loke ciraṁ vatsyati bhārata ॥45॥
1.99.45d2: ahaṁ ca te bhaviṣyāmi āhvānopagatā nr̥pa.
1.99.46: ādāya ca kumāraṁ taṁ jagāmātha yathepsitam ॥46॥
1.99.47: sa tu devavrato nāma gāṅgeya iti cābhavat,
1.99.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi āpavopākhyāne navanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥99॥
1.100.6: na cāsya sadr̥śaḥ kaścid dharmataḥ pārthivo’bhavat ॥6॥
1.100.18: sa eva rājā sarveṣāṁ bhūtānāmabhavat pitā ॥18॥
1.100.20: sa samāḥ ṣoḍaśāṣṭau ca catasro’ṣṭau tathāparāḥ,
1.100.24: svandate kiṁ tviyaṁ nādya saricchreṣṭhā yathā purā ॥24॥
1.100.27: tāṁ śarairācitāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā nadīṁ gaṅgāṁ tadantike,
1.100.28: jātamātraṁ purā dr̥ṣṭvā taṁ putraṁ śāntanustadā,
1.100.29: sa tu taṁ pitaraṁ dr̥ṣṭvā mohayāmāsa māyayā,
1.100.30: tadadbhutaṁ tato dr̥ṣṭvā tatra rājā sa śāntanuḥ,
1.100.32: dr̥ṣṭapūrvāmapi sa tāṁ nābhyajānāt sa śāntanuḥ ॥32॥
1.100.36: uśanā veda yacchāstramayaṁ tad veda sarvaśaḥ ॥36॥
1.100.37: yad veda śāstraṁ taccāpi kr̥tsnamasmin pratiṣṭhitam ॥37॥
1.100.40: mayā dattaṁ nijaṁ putraṁ vīraṁ vīra gr̥haṁ naya,
1.100.44: sa tathā saha putreṇa ramamāṇo mahīpatiḥ ॥44॥
1.100.45: sa kadācid vanaṁ yāto yamunāmabhito nadīm ॥45॥
1.100.47: sa dadarśa tadā kanyāṁ dāśānāṁ devarūpiṇīm,
1.100.48: kasya tvamasi kā cāsi kiṁ ca bhīru cikīrṣasi,
1.100.50: sa gatvā pitaraṁ tasyā varayāmāsa tāṁ tadā ॥50॥
1.100.51: sa ca taṁ pratyuvācedaṁ dāśarājo mahīpatim ॥51॥
1.100.52: hr̥di kāmastu me kaścit taṁ nibodha janeśvara ॥52॥
1.100.53: satyavāgasi satyena samayaṁ kuru me tataḥ ॥53॥
1.100.54: na hi me tvatsamaḥ kaścid varo jātu bhaviṣyati ॥54॥
1.100.55: śrutvā tava varaṁ dāśa vyavasyeyamahaṁ tava,
dātavyaṁ cet pradāsyāmi na tvadeyaṁ kathañcana ॥55॥
1.100.56: asyāṁ jāyeta yaḥ putraḥ sa rājā pr̥thivīpate,
1.100.57: nākāmayata taṁ dātuṁ varaṁ dāśāya śāntanuḥ,
1.100.61: na cāśvena viniryāsi vivarṇo hariṇaḥ kr̥śaḥ ॥61॥
1.100.62: vyādhimicchāmi te jñātuṁ pratikuryāṁ hi tatra vai,
1.100.63: asaṁśayaṁ dhyānaparo yathā vatsa tathā śr̥ṇu,
1.100.65: kathañcit tava gāṅgeya vipattau nāsti naḥ kulam,
1.100.66: na cāpyahaṁ vr̥thā bhūyo dārān kartumihotsahe,
1.100.67d1: cakṣurekaṁ ca putraśca asti nāsti ca bhārata,
1.100.69: yadapatyaṁ mahāprājña tatra me nāsti saṁśayaḥ,
1.100.69d1: apatyaṁ karma vidyā ca trīṇi jyotīṁṣi bhārata,
1.100.70: tvaṁ ca śūraḥ sadāmarṣī śastranityaśca bhārata,
nānyatra yuddhāt tasmāt te nidhanaṁ vidyate kvacit ॥70॥
1.100.74d1: sūtaṁ bhūyo’pi santapta āhvayāmāsa vai pituḥ.
1.100.74d2: tamuvāca mahāprājño bhīṣmo vai sārathiṁ pituḥ.
1.100.74d3: tvaṁ sārathe piturmahyaṁ sakhāsi rathayug yataḥ,
api jānāsi yadi vai kasyāṁ bhāvo nr̥pasya tu.
1.100.74d4: yathā vakṣyasi me pr̥ṣṭaḥ kariṣye na tadanyathā,
1.100.74d5: yo’syāṁ pumān bhaved garbhaḥ sa rājā tvadanantaram,
nākāmayata taṁ dātuṁ pitā tava varaṁ tadā.
1.100.74d6: sa cāpi niścayastasya na ca dadyāmato’nyathā,
evaṁ te kathitaṁ vīra kuruṣva yadanantaram.
1.100.75: abhigamya dāśarājaṁ kanyāṁ vavre pituḥ svayam ॥75॥
1.100.76: taṁ dāśaḥ pratijagrāha vidhivat pratipūjya ca,
1.100.76d1: apatyaṁ yad bhavet tasyāḥ sa rājāstu pituḥ param.
1.100.77: putraḥ śastrabhr̥tāṁ śreṣṭhaḥ kiṁ tu vakṣyāmi te vacaḥ ॥77॥
1.100.79: apatyaṁ caitadāryasya yo yuṣmākaṁ samo guṇaiḥ,
1.100.80: tena me bahuśastāta pitā te parikīrtitaḥ,
arhaḥ satyavatīṁ boḍhuṁ dharmajñaḥ sa narādhipaḥ ॥80॥
1.100.82: kanyāpitr̥tvāt kiñcit tu vakṣyāmi tvāṁ narādhipa,
1.100.83: yasya hi tvaṁ sapatnaḥ syā gandharvasyāsurasya vā,
na sa jātu ciraṁ jīvet tvayi kruddhe parantapa ॥83॥
1.100.84: etāvānatra doṣo hi nānyaḥ kaścan pārthiva,
1.100.86: idaṁ me vratamādatsva satyaṁ satyavatāṁ vara,
naiva jāto na vājāta īdr̥śaṁ vaktumutsahet ॥86॥
1.100.87: yo’syāṁ janiṣyate putraḥ sa no rājā bhaviṣyati ॥87॥
1.100.90: idaṁ tu vacanaṁ saumya kāryaṁ caiva nibodha me,
1.100.92: tavāpatyaṁ bhaved yat tu tatra naḥ saṁśayo mahān ॥92॥
1.100.94: śr̥ṇvatāṁ bhūmipālānāṁ yad bravīmi pituḥ kr̥te ॥94॥
1.100.94d1: yāni yānīha śr̥ṇvantu nāsti vaktā hi matsamaḥ.
1.100.95: rājyaṁ tāvat pūrvameva mayā tyaktaṁ narādhipāḥ,
1.100.96d1: yāvat prāṇā dhriyante vai mama dehaṁ samāśritāḥ.
1.100.96d2: tāvanna janayiṣyāmi pitre kanyāṁ prayaccha me,
1.100.96d3: ūrdhvaretā bhaviṣyāmi dāśa satyaṁ bravīmi te,
1.100.102: nacchrutvā duṣkaraṁ karma kr̥taṁ bhīṣmeṇa śāntanuḥ,
1.100.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi satyavatīlābhopākhyāne śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥100॥
1.101.1: tato vivāhe nirvr̥tte sa rājā śāntanurnr̥paḥ,
1.101.5: sthāpayāmāsa vai rājye satyavatyā mate sthitaḥ ॥5॥
1.101.6: sa tu citrāṅgadaḥ śauryāt sarvāṁścikṣepa pārthivān,
manuṣyaṁ na hi mene sa kañcit sadr̥śamātmanaḥ ॥6॥
1.101.7d1: tvaṁ vai sadr̥śanāmāsi yuddhaṁ dehi nr̥pātmaja,
nāma cānyat pragr̥ṇīṣva yadi yuddhaṁ na dāsyasi.
1.101.8: tenāsya sumahad yuddhaṁ kurukṣetre babhūva ha,
1.101.13: vicitravīryaḥ sa tadā bhīṣmasya vacane sthitaḥ,
1.101.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi citrāṅgadopākhyāne ekādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥101॥
1.102.1: hate citrāṅgade bhīṣmo bāle bhrātari kaurava,
pālayāmāsa tad rājyaṁ satyavatyā mate sthitaḥ ॥1॥
1.102.3: śuśrāva sahitā rājan vr̥ṇvānā vai svayaṁvaram ॥3॥
1.102.4: tataḥ sa rathināṁ śreṣṭho rathenaikena śatrujit,
1.102.6: kīrtyamāneṣu rājñāṁ tu tadā nāmasu sarvaśaḥ,
1.102.7: sodvegā iva taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā kanyāḥ paramaśobhanāḥ,
apākrāmanta tāḥ sarvā vr̥ddha ityeva cintayā ॥7॥
1.102.9: brahmacārīti bhīṣmo hi vr̥thaiva prathito bhuvi ॥9॥
1.102.11: bhīṣmastadā svayaṁ kanyā varayāmāsa tāḥ prabhuḥ,
1.102.12: rathamāropya tāḥ kanyā bhīṣmaḥ praharatāṁ varaḥ,
āhūya dānaṁ kanyānāṁ guṇavadbhyaḥ smr̥taṁ budhaḥ ॥12॥
1.102.15: ārṣaṁ vidhiṁ puraskr̥tya dārān vindanti cāpare,
1.102.17: te yatadhvaṁ paraṁ śaktyā vijayāyetarāya vā ॥17॥
1.102.19: sarvāḥ kanyāḥ sa kauravyo rathamāropya ca svakam,
āmantrya ca sa tān prāyācchīghraṁ kanyāḥ pragr̥hya tāḥ ॥19॥
1.102.22: bhūṣaṇānāṁ ca sarveṣāṁ kavacānāṁ ca sarvaśaḥ ॥22॥
1.102.25: tataḥ samabhavad yuddhaṁ teṣāṁ tasya ca bhārata,
ekasya ca bahūnāṁ ca tumulaṁ lomaharṣaṇam ॥25॥
1.102.27: tataste pārthivāḥ sarve sarvataḥ parivārya tam ॥27॥
1.102.28: sa taṁ bāṇamayaṁ varṣaṁ śarairāvārya sarvataḥ ॥28॥
1.102.29: ekaikastu tato bhīṣmaṁ rājan vivyādha pañcabhiḥ ॥29॥
1.102.30: sa ca tān prativivyādha dvābhyāṁ dvābhyāṁ parākraman,
1.102.31: sa dhanūṁṣi dhvajāgrāṇi varmāṇi ca śirāṁsi ca ॥31॥
1.102.33: tān vinirjitya tu raṇe sarvaśastrabhr̥tāṁ varaḥ ॥33॥
1.102.34: kanyābhiḥ sahitaḥ prāyād bhārato bhāratān prati,
1.102.40: nivartamānaṁ taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā rājānaḥ sarva eva te,
1.102.43: pūrvamabhyarditaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā bhīṣmaṁ śālvena te nr̥pāḥ,
1.102.44: lāghavaṁ tasya te dr̥ṣṭvā samare sarvapārthivāḥ,
1.102.46: sārathiṁ cābravīt kruddho yāhi yatraiṣa pārthivaḥ,
1.102.52: evaṁ vijitya tāḥ kanyā bhīṣmaḥ praharatāṁ varaḥ ॥52॥
1.102.53: prayayau hāstinapuraṁ yatra rājā sa kauravaḥ,
1.102.56: snuṣā iva sa dharmātmā bhaginīriva cānujāḥ ॥56॥
1.102.61: mayā saubhapatiḥ pūrvaṁ manasā hi vr̥taḥ patiḥ,
tena cāsmi vr̥tā pūrvameṣa kāmaśca me pituḥ ॥61॥
1.102.70: tābhyāṁ saha samāḥ sapta viharan pr̥thivīpatiḥ,
1.102.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi vicitravīryoparame dvyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥102॥
1.103.1: putrasya kr̥tvā kāryāṇi snuṣābhyāṁ saha bhārata ॥1॥
1.103.2: samāśvāsya snuṣe te ca bhīṣmaṁ śastrabhr̥tāṁ varam,
dharmaṁ ca pitr̥vaṁśaṁ ca mātr̥vaṁśaṁ ca bhāvinī,
1.103.3: tvayi piṇḍaśca kīrtiśca santānaṁ ca pratiṣṭhitam ॥3॥
1.103.4: yathā karma śubhaṁ kr̥tvā svargopagamanaṁ dhruvam,
yathā cāyurdhruvaṁ satye tvayi dharmastathā dhruvaḥ ॥4॥
1.103.6: vyavasthānaṁ ca te dharme kulācāraṁ ca lakṣaye,
1.103.8: mama putrastava bhrātā vīryavān supriyaśca te,
1.103.11: dārāṁśca kuru dharmeṇa mā nimajjīḥ pitāmahān ॥11॥
1.103.13: tvamapatyaṁ prati ca me pratijñāṁ vettha vai parām ॥13॥
1.103.14: sa satyavati satyaṁ te pratijānāmyahaṁ punaḥ ॥14॥
1.103.15: parityajeyaṁ trailokyaṁ rājyaṁ deveṣu vā punaḥ,
yad vāpyadhikametābhyāṁ na tu satyaṁ kathañcana ॥15॥
1.103.16: jyotistathā tyajed rūpaṁ vāyuḥ sparśaguṇaṁ tyajet ॥16॥
1.103.18: vikramaṁ vr̥trahā jahyād dharmaṁ jahyācca dharmarāṭ,
1.103.20: jānāmi te sthitiṁ satye parāṁ satyaparākrama,
1.103.21: jānāmi caivaṁ satyaṁ tanmadarthe yacca bhāṣitam,
1.103.22: yathā te kulatantuśca dharmaśca na parābhavet,
1.103.24: rājñi dharmānavekṣasva mā naḥ sarvān vyanīnaśaḥ,
1.103.25: tat te dharmaṁ pravakṣyāmi kṣātraṁ rājñi sanātanam ॥25॥
1.103.26: śrutvā taṁ pratipadyasva prājñaiḥ saha purohitaiḥ,
1.103.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi bhīṣmasatyavatīsaṁvāde tryadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥103॥
1.104.4: viśvāsāt te pravakṣyāmi santānāya kulasya naḥ ॥4॥
1.104.5: tvameva naḥ kule dharmastvaṁ satyaṁ tvaṁ parā gatiḥ ॥5॥
1.104.6d1: tasya śukrādahaṁ matsyād dhr̥tā kukṣau purā kila.
1.104.10: tamahaṁ śāpabhītā ca piturbhītā ca bhārata,
1.104.11: abhibhūya sa māṁ bālāṁ tejasā vaśamānayat,
1.104.12: tamapāsya śubhaṁ gandhamimaṁ prādāt sa me muniḥ ॥12॥
1.104.13: dvīpe’syā eva saritaḥ kanyaiva tvaṁ bhaviṣyasi ॥13॥
1.104.14: kanyāputro mama purā dvaipāyana iti śrutaḥ ॥14॥
1.104.16: samutpannaḥ sa tu mahān saha pitrā tato gataḥ ॥16॥
1.104.17: sa niyukto mayā vyaktaṁ tvayā cāpratimadyutiḥ,
1.104.18: sa hi māmuktavāṁstatra smareḥ kr̥cchreṣu māmiti,
taṁ smariṣye mahābāho yadi bhīṣma tvamicchasi ॥18॥
1.104.19: tava hyanumate bhīṣma niyataṁ sa mahātapāḥ,
1.104.20: dharmamarthaṁ ca kāmaṁ ca trīnetān yo’nupaśyati ॥20॥
1.104.21: kāmaṁ kāmānubandhaṁ ca viparītān pr̥thak pr̥thak ॥21॥
1.104.22: yo vicintya dhiyā dhīro vyavasyati sa buddhimān,
tadidaṁ dharmayuktaṁ ca hitaṁ caiva kulasya naḥ ॥22॥
1.104.24: sa vedān vibruvan dhīmān māturvijñāya cintitam ॥24॥
1.104.25: tasmai pūjāṁ tataḥ kr̥tvā sutāya vidhipūrvakam ॥25॥
1.104.26: mumoca bāṣpaṁ dāśeyī putraṁ dr̥ṣṭvā cirasya tu ॥26॥
1.104.28: śādhi māṁ dharmatattvajñe karavāṇi priyaṁ tava ॥28॥
1.104.30: pūjito mantrapūrvaṁ tu vidhivat prītimāpa saḥ,
1.104.32: teṣāṁ pitā yathā svāmī tathā mātā na saṁśayaḥ,
vidhānavihitaḥ satyaṁ yathā me prathamaḥ sutaḥ ॥32॥
1.104.34: bhrātā vicitravīryasya yathā vā putra manyase,
1.104.35: sa tvaṁ vyapekṣayā bhrātuḥ santānāya kulasya ca ॥35॥
1.104.39: vettha dharmaṁ satyavati paraṁ cāparameva ca ॥39॥
1.104.40: tathā tava mahāprājñe dharme praṇihitā matiḥ,
1.104.41: īpsitaṁ te kariṣyāmi dr̥ṣṭaṁ hyotat sanātanam,
1.104.42: vrataṁ caretāṁ te devyau nirdiṣṭamiha yanmayā,
1.104.43: sadyo yathā prapadyete devyau garbhaṁ tathā kuru ॥43॥
1.104.44: naśyanti ca kriyāḥ sarvā nāsti vr̥ṣṭirna devatā ॥44॥
1.104.45: kathaṁ cārājaṅka rāṣṭraṁ śakyaṁ dhārayituṁ prabho,
1.104.46: virūpatāṁ me sahatāṁ tayoretat paraṁ vratam ॥46॥
1.104.47: yadi me sahate gandhaṁ rūpaṁ veṣaṁ tathā vapuḥ,
1.104.48: śayane sā ca kausalyā śucivastrā hyalaṅkr̥tā ॥48॥
1.104.49: tato’bhigamya sā devī snuṣāṁ rahasi saṅgatām ॥49॥
1.104.50: kausalye dharmatantraṁ tvāṁ yad bravīmi nibodha tat ॥50॥
1.104.51: vyathitāṁ māṁ ca samprekṣya pitr̥vaṁśaṁ ca pīḍitam ॥51॥
1.104.52: sā ca buddhistvayyadhīnā putri prāpaya māṁ tathā ॥52॥
1.104.53: naṣṭaṁ ca bhārataṁ vaṁśaṁ punareva samuddhara,
1.104.54: sa hi rājyadhuraṁ gurvīmudvakṣyati kulasya naḥ,
1.104.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi satyavatyupadeśe caturadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥104॥
1.105.1: tataḥ satyavatī kāle vadhūṁ snātāmr̥tau tadā,
1.105.3: śvaśrvāstad vacanaṁ śrutvā śayānā śayane śubhe,
1.105.5: tasya kr̥ṣṇasya kapilāṁ jaṭāṁ dīpte ca locane,
babhrūṇi caiva śmaśrūṇi dr̥ṣṭvā devī nyamīlayat ॥5॥
1.105.9: tasya cāpi śataṁ putrā bhaviṣyanti mahātmanaḥ ॥9॥
1.105.10: kiṁ tu mātuḥ sa vaiguṇyādandha eva bhaviṣyati,
tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā mātā putramathābravīt ॥10॥
1.105.13: punareva tu sā devī paribhāṣya snuṣāṁ tataḥ ॥13॥
1.105.16: tāṁ bhītāṁ pāṇḍusaṅkāśāṁ viṣaṇṇāṁ prekṣya bhārata,
1.105.19: śaśaṁsa sa punarmātre tasya bālasya pāṇḍutām ॥19॥
1.105.22: yasya putrā maheṣvāsā jajñire pañca pāṇḍavāḥ,
r̥tukāle tato jyeṣṭhāṁ vadhūṁ tasmai nyayojayat ॥22॥
1.105.23: sā tu rūpaṁ ca gandhaṁ ca maharṣeḥ pravicintya tam,
1.105.27: ayaṁ ca te śubhe garbhaḥ śreyānudaramāgataḥ,
1.105.31: sa dharmasyānr̥ṇo bhūtvā punarmātrā sametya ca,
1.105.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi vicitravīryasutotpattau pañcādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥105॥
1.106.1: kiṁ kr̥taṁ karma dharmeṇa yena śāpamupeyivān,
1.106.2: dhr̥timān sarvadharmajñaḥ satye tapasi ca sthitaḥ ॥2॥
1.106.6: teṣu līneṣvatho śīghraṁ tatastad rakṣiṇāṁ balam ॥6॥
1.106.8: tena gacchāmahe brahman yathā śīghrataraṁ vayam ॥8॥
1.106.9: tathā tu rakṣiṇāṁ teṣāṁ bruvatāṁ sa tapodhanaḥ,
na kiñcid vacanaṁ rājannabravīt sādhvasādhu vā ॥9॥
1.106.11: tataḥ śaṅkā samabhavad rakṣiṇāṁ taṁ muniṁ prati,
1.106.14: śūlasthaḥ sa tu dharmātmā kālena mahatā tataḥ,
1.106.16: te rātrau śakunā bhūtvā saṁnipatya tu bhārata,
1.106.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi aṇīmāṇḍavyopākhyāne ṣaḍadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥106॥
1.107.1: doṣataḥ kaṁ gamiṣyāmi na hi me’nyo’parādhyati ॥1॥
1.107.3: śrutvā ca vacanaṁ teṣāṁ niścitya saha mantribhiḥ,
1.107.4: prasādaye tvāṁ tatrāhaṁ na me tvaṁ kroddhumarhasi ॥4॥
1.107.6: avatārya ca śūlāgrāt tacchūlaṁ niścakarṣa ha,
aśaknuvaṁśca niṣkraṣṭuṁ śūlaṁ mūle sa cicchide ॥6॥
1.107.8: aṇīmāṇḍavya iti ca tato lokeṣu gīyate,
sa gatvā sadanaṁ vipro dharmasya paramātmavit ॥8॥
1.107.9: kiṁ nu tad duṣkr̥taṁ karma mayā kr̥tamajānatā ॥9॥
1.107.10: śīghramācakṣva me tattvaṁ paśya me tapaso balam ॥10॥
1.107.12: svalpameva yathā dattaṁ dānaṁ bahuguṇaṁ bhavet,
1.107.13: kasmin kāle mayā tat tu kr̥taṁ brūhi yathātatham,
1.107.14: bālo hi dvādaśād varṣājjanmato yat kariṣyati,
na bhaviṣyatyadharmo’tra na prajñāsyanti vai diśaḥ ॥14॥
1.107.19: dīrghadarśī śamaparaḥ kurūṇāṁ ca hite rataḥ ॥19॥
1.107.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi aṇīmāṇḍavyopākhyāne saptādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥107॥
1.108.0d1: dhr̥tarāṣṭre ca pāṇḍau ca vidure ca mahātmani,
1.108.3: gandhavanti ca mālyāni rasavanti phalāni ca ॥3॥
1.108.22: triṣu lokeṣu na tvāsīt kaścid vidurasammitaḥ,
dharmanityastathā rājan dharme ca paramaṁ gataḥ ॥22॥
1.109.1: guṇaiḥ samuditaṁ samyagidaṁ naḥ prathitaṁ kulam,
1.109.3: mayā ca satyavatyā ca kr̥ṣṇena ca mahātmanā,
1.109.4: taccaitad vardhate bhūyaḥ kulaṁ sāgaravad yathā,
tathā mayā vidhātavyaṁ tvayā caiva na saṁśayaḥ ॥4॥
1.109.5: śrūyate yādavī kanyā svanurūpā kulasya naḥ,
1.109.6: kulīnā rūpavatyaśca tāḥ kanyāḥ putra sarvaśaḥ,
1.109.7: santānārthaṁ kulasyāsya yad vā vidura manyase ॥7॥
1.109.8: bhavān pitā bhavān mātā bhavān naḥ paramo guruḥ,
tasmāt svayaṁ kulasyāsya vicārya kuru yaddhitam ॥8॥
1.109.10: gāndhārī kila putrāṇāṁ śataṁ lebhe varaṁ śubhā,
1.109.12: kulaṁ khyātiṁ ca vr̥ttaṁ ca buddhyā tu prasamīkṣya saḥ,
1.109.13: ātmānaṁ ditsitaṁ cāsmai pitrā mātrā ca bhārata ॥13॥
1.109.14: tataḥ sā paṭṭamādāya kr̥tvā bahuguṇaṁ tadā,
1.109.17: dattvā sa bhaginīṁ vīro yathārhaṁ ca paricchadam,
1.109.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi dhr̥tarāṣṭravivāhe navādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥109॥
1.110.1: tasya kanyā pr̥thā nāma rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi ॥1॥
1.110.5: nigūḍhaniścayaṁ dharme yaṁ taṁ durvāsasaṁ viduḥ,
1.110.8: tathoktā sā tu vipreṇa kuntī kautūhalānvitā,
1.110.11: kaścinme brāhmaṇaḥ prādād varaṁ vidyāṁ ca śatruhan,
1.110.12: yoṣito hi sadā rakṣyāḥ svāparāddhāpi nityaśaḥ ॥12॥
1.110.13: vedāhaṁ sarvamevaitad yad durvāsā varaṁ dadau,
1.110.14: vr̥thāhvāne’pi te bhīru doṣaḥ svānnātra saṁśayaḥ ॥14॥
1.110.15: sā tu naicchad varārohā kanyāhamiti bhārata ॥15॥
1.110.16d2: āditye kuṇḍale bibhrat kavacaṁ caiva māmakam,
1.110.16d3: na na kiñcana deyaṁ tu brāhmaṇebhyo bhaviṣyati,
dāsyatyeva hi viprebhyo mānī caiva bhaviṣyati.
1.110.17: matprasādānna te rājñi bhavitā doṣa ityuta,
1.110.20: prādācca tasyai kanyātvaṁ punaḥ sa paramadyutiḥ,
dattvā ca tapatāṁ śreṣṭho divamācakrame tataḥ ॥20॥
1.110.21: dr̥ṣṭvā kumāraṁ jātaṁ sā vārṣṇeyī dīnamānasā,
ekāgraṁ cintayāmāsa kiṁ kr̥tvā sukr̥taṁ bhavet ॥21॥
1.110.22: utsasarja kumāraṁ taṁ jale kuntī mahābalam ॥22॥
1.110.24: nāmadheyaṁ ca cakrāte tasya bālasya tāyubhau,
1.110.26: tasmin kāle tu japatastasya vīrasya dhīmataḥ,
1.110.26d1: tataḥ kāle tu kasmiṁścicat svapnānte karṇamabravīt,
ādityo brāhmaṇo bhūtvā śr̥ṇu vīra vaco mama.
1.110.26d2: na tasya bhikṣā dātavyā viprarūpī bhaviṣyati.
1.110.26d4: śakro māṁ viprarūpeṇa yadi vai yācate dvija,
kathaṁ cāsmai na dāsyāmi yathā cāsmyavabodhitaḥ.
1.110.26d5: taṁ devadevaṁ jānan vai na śaknomyavamantraṇe.
1.110.26d6: yadyevaṁ śr̥ṇu me vīra varaṁ te so’pi dāsyati,
1.110.29d2: na taṁ paśyāmi ko hyetat karma kartā bhaviṣyati,
prīto’smi karmaṇā tena varaṁ vr̥ṇu yamicchasi.
1.110.31: prāṅ nāma tasya kathitaṁ vasuṣeṇa iti kṣitau,
1.110.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi karṇasambhave daśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥110॥
1.111.4: tataḥ sā raṅgamadhyasthaṁ teṣāṁ rājñāṁ manasvinī,
1.111.5: ādityamiva sarveṣāṁ rājñāṁ pracchādya vai prabhāḥ ॥5॥
1.111.8: vrīḍamānā srajaṁ kuntī rājñaḥ skandhe samāsajat,
taṁ niśamya vr̥taṁ pāṇḍuṁ kuntyā sarve narādhipāḥ ॥8॥
1.111.13: nyaveśayata tāṁ bhāryāṁ kuntīṁ svabhavane prabhuḥ ॥13॥
1.111.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi kuntīvivāhe ekādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥111॥
1.112.4: dattvā tasyāsanaṁ śubhraṁ pādyamarghyaṁ tathaiva ca,
1.112.6: śrūyate bhavataḥ sādhvī svasā mādrī yaśasvinī,
1.112.7: yuktarūpo hi sambandhe tvaṁ no rājan vayaṁ tava,
1.112.8: na hi me’nyo varastvattaḥ śreyāniti matirmama ॥8॥
1.112.10: vyaktaṁ tad bhavataścāpi viditaṁ nātra saṁśayaḥ,
na ca yuktaṁ tathā vaktuṁ bhavān dehīti sattama ॥10॥
1.112.11: kuladharmaḥ sa no vīra pramāṇaṁ paramaṁ ca tat,
1.112.12: dharma eṣa paro rājan svayamuktaḥ svayambhuvā ॥12॥
1.112.13: viditeya ca te śalya maryādā sādhusammatā ॥13॥
1.112.16: tat pragr̥hya dhanaṁ sarvaṁ śalyaḥ samprītamānasaḥ,
1.112.19: tato vivāhe nirvr̥tte sa rājā kurunandanaḥ,
sthāpayāmāsa tāṁ bhāryāṁ śubhe veśmani bhāvinīm ॥19॥
1.112.20: sa tābhyāṁ vyacarat sārdhaṁ bhāryābhyāṁ rājasattamaḥ,
kuntyā mādryā ca rājendro yathākāmaṁ yathāsukham ॥20॥
1.112.21: tataḥ sa kauravo rājā vihr̥tya tridaśā niśāḥ,
1.112.28: tataḥ kośaṁ samādāya vāhanāni ca bhūriśaḥ,
pāṇḍunā mithilāṁ gatvā videhāḥ samare jitāḥ ॥28॥
1.112.29: tathā kāśiṣu suhmeṣu puṇḍreṣu ca nararṣabha,
1.112.32: tena te nirjitāḥ sarve pr̥thivyāṁ sarvapārthivāḥ,
1.112.38: ye purā kururāṣṭrāṇi jahruḥ kurudhanāni ca,
1.112.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi pāṇḍudigvijaye dvādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥112॥
1.113.1: bhīṣmāya satyavatyai ca mātre copajahāra saḥ ॥1॥
1.113.2: vidurāya ca vai pāṇḍuḥ preṣayāmāsa tad dhanam,
1.113.3: tataḥ satyavatī bhīṣmaṁ kausalyāṁ ca yaśasvinīm,
1.113.6: samprayuktastu kuntyā ca mādryā ca bharatarṣabha,
1.113.8: sa caran dakṣiṇaṁ pārśvaṁ ramyaṁ himavato gireḥ,
1.113.9: rarāja kuntyā mādryā ca pāṇḍuḥ saha vane caran,
1.113.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi vidurapariṇaye trayodaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥113॥
1.114.2: pāṇḍoḥ kuntyāṁ ca mādryāṁ ca putrāḥ pañca mahārathāḥ,
1.114.3: kiyatā caiva kālena teṣāmāyuśca kiṁ param ॥3॥
1.114.4: kathaṁ ca sadr̥śīṁ bhāryāṁ gāndhārīṁ dharmacāriṇīm ॥4॥
1.114.5: kathaṁ ca śaptasya sataḥ pāṇḍostena mahātmanā ॥5॥
1.114.7: kathayasva na me tr̥ptiḥ kathyamāneṣu bandhuṣu,
1.114.8: sā vavre sadr̥śaṁ bhartuḥ putrāṇāṁ śatamātmanaḥ ॥8॥
1.114.14: tāṁ sa māṁsamayīṁ peśīṁ dadarśa japatāṁ varaḥ,
1.114.15: sā cātmano mataṁ satyaṁ śaśaṁsa paramarṣaye,
1.114.16: śataṁ ca kila putrāṇāṁ vitīrṇaṁ me tvayā purā ॥16॥
1.114.17: iyaṁ ca me māṁsapeśī jātā putraśatāya vai,
1.114.19: sugupteṣu ca deśeṣu rakṣā caiva vidhīyatām,
1.114.20: sā sicyamānā tvaṣṭhīlā babhūva śatadhā tadā,
1.114.22: svanugupteṣu deśeṣu rakṣāṁ vai vyadadhāt tataḥ ॥22॥
1.114.25: jajñe krameṇa caitena teṣāṁ duryodhano nr̥paḥ,
1.114.26: tadākhyātaṁ tu bhīṣmāya vidurāya ca dhīmate,
1.114.30: samānīya bahūn viprān bhīṣmaṁ vidurameva ca,
anyāṁśca suhr̥do rājan kurūn sarvāṁstathaiva ca ॥30॥
1.114.31: prāptaḥ svaguṇato rājyaṁ na tasmin vācyamasti naḥ ॥31॥
1.114.32: etad vibrūta me tathyaṁ yadatra bhavitā dhruvam ॥32॥
1.114.35: utthitāni sute jāte jyeṣṭhe te puruṣarṣabha ॥35॥
1.114.38: ekena kuru vai kṣemaṁ kulasya jagatastathā,
1.114.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi gāndhārīputrotpattau caturdaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥114॥
1.115.1: r̥ṣeḥ prasādāt tu śataṁ na ca kanyā prakīrtitā ॥1॥
1.115.3: kathaṁ tvidānīṁ bhagavan kanyāṁ tvaṁ tu bravīṣi me ॥3॥
1.115.4: yadi bhāgaśataṁ peśī kr̥tā tena maharṣiṇā,
na prajāsyati ced bhūyaḥ saubaleyī kathañcana ॥4॥
1.115.5: kathaṁ tu sambhavastasyā duḥśalāyā vadasva me,
1.115.6: sādhvayaṁ praśna uddiṣṭaḥ pāṇḍaveya bravīmi te,
1.115.7: yo yathā kalpito bhāgastaṁ taṁ dhātryā tathā nr̥pa ॥7॥
1.115.10: bhaviṣyati na sandeho na bravītyanyathā muniḥ,
mameyaṁ paramā tuṣṭirduhitā me bhaved yadi ॥10॥
1.115.12: yadi nāma mamāpi syād duhitaikā śatādhikā ॥12॥
1.115.13: yadi satyaṁ tapastaptaṁ dattaṁ vāpyathavā hutam ॥13॥
1.115.16: dauhitrayogāya bhāga ekaḥ śiṣṭaḥ śatāt paraḥ,
eṣā te subhagā kanyā bhaviṣyati yathepsitā ॥16॥
1.115.17: taṁ cāpi prākṣipat tatra kanyābhāgaṁ tapodhanaḥ ॥17॥
1.115.18: etat te kathitaṁ rājan duḥśalājanma bhārata,
brūhi rājendra kiṁ bhūyo vartayiṣyāmi te’nagha ॥18॥
1.115.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi duḥśalotpattau pañcadaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥115॥
1.116.1: jyeṣṭhānujyeṣṭhatāṁ teṣāṁ nāmāni ca pr̥thak pr̥thak,
1.116.3: durmarṣaṇo durmukhaśca duṣkarṇaḥ karṇa eva ca ॥3॥
1.116.15: iti putraśataṁ rājan kanyā caiva śatādhikā,
1.116.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi dhr̥tarāṣṭraputranāmakathane ṣoḍaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥116॥
1.117.2: tvattaḥ śrutāni me brahman pāṇḍavānāṁ ca kīrtaya ॥2॥
1.117.6: tatastāṁ ca mr̥gīṁ taṁ ca rukmapuṅkhaiḥ supatribhiḥ,
1.117.10: na vidhiṁ grasate prajñā prajñāṁ tu grasate vidhiḥ,
1.117.12: śatrūṇāṁ yā vadhe vr̥ttiḥ sā mr̥gāṇāṁ vadhe smr̥tā,
rājñāṁ mr̥ga na māṁ mohāt tvaṁ garhayitumarhasi ॥12॥
1.117.13: acchadmanā māyayā ca mr̥gāṇāṁ vadha iṣyate,
sa eva dharmo rājñāṁ tu taddhi tvaṁ kiṁ nu garhase ॥13॥
1.117.16: na ripūn vai samuddiśya vimuñcanti narāḥ śarān,
randhra eṣāṁ viśeṣeṇa vadhaḥ kāle praśasyate ॥16॥
1.117.18: nāhaṁ ghnantaṁ mr̥gān rājan vigarhe cātmakāraṇāt,
1.117.19: ko hi vidvān mr̥gaṁ hanyāccarantaṁ maithunaṁ vane ॥19॥
1.117.25: kiṁ kr̥taṁ te naraśreṣṭha māmihānāgasaṁ ghnatā,
1.117.26: tvayāhaṁ hiṁsito yasmāt tasmāt tvāmapyahaṁ śape ॥26॥
1.117.28: ahaṁ hi kindamo nāma tapasā bhāvito muniḥ,
1.117.29: mr̥go bhūtvā mr̥gaiḥ sārdhaṁ carāmi gahane vane,
1.117.30: asya tu tvaṁ phalaṁ mūḍha prāpsyasīdr̥śameva hi ॥30॥
1.117.32: antakāle hi saṁvāsaṁ yayā gantāsi kāntayā,
1.117.33: tathā tvāṁ ca sukhaṁ prāptaṁ duḥkhamabhyāgamiṣyati ॥33॥
1.117.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi pāṇḍumr̥gaśāpe saptadaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥117॥
1.118.2: satāmapi kule jātāḥ karmaṇā bata durgatim,
1.118.3: śaśvaddharmātmanā jāto bāla eva pitā mama,
1.118.6: mokṣameva vyavasyāmi bandho hi vyasanaṁ mahat,
1.118.10: na cāpyavahasan kaccinna kurvan bhrukuṭīṁ kvacit ॥10॥
1.118.12: svāsu prajāsviva sadā samaḥ prāṇabhr̥tāṁ prati,
ekakālaṁ caran bhaikṣyaṁ kulāni daśa pañca vā ॥12॥
1.118.13: alpamalpaṁ ca bhuñjānaḥ pūrvālābhe na jātucit ॥13॥
1.118.14: alābhe yadi vā lābhe samadarśī mahātapāḥ ॥14॥
1.118.16: jīvitaṁ maraṇaṁ caiva nābhinandan na ca dviṣan ॥16॥
1.118.19: na vaśe kasyacit tiṣṭhan sadharmā mātariśvanaḥ ॥19॥
1.118.22: upaiti vr̥ttiṁ kāmātmā sa śunāṁ vartate pathi ॥22॥
1.118.23: avekṣamāṇaḥ kuntīṁ ca mādrīṁ ca samabhāṣata ॥23॥
1.118.24: kausalyā viduraḥ kṣattā rājā ca saha bandhubhiḥ,
1.118.25: prasādya sarve vaktavyāḥ pāṇḍuḥ pravrajito vanam ॥25॥
1.118.26: tatsamaṁ vacanaṁ kuntī mādrī ca samabhāṣatām ॥26॥
1.118.27: anye’pi hyāśramāḥ santi ye śakyā bharatarṣabha,
āvābhyāṁ dharmapatnībhyāṁ saha taptuṁ tapo mahat ॥27॥
1.118.28: tvameva bhavitā bhartā svargasyāpi na saṁśayaḥ ॥28॥
1.118.30: yadi cāvāṁ mahāprājña tyakṣyasi tvaṁ viśāmpate,
1.118.40: gatvā nāgapuraṁ vācyaṁ pāṇḍuḥ pravrajito vanam,
arthaṁ kāmaṁ sukhaṁ caiva ratiṁ ca paramātmikām ॥40॥
1.118.44: te gatvā nagaraṁ rājño yathāvr̥ttaṁ mahātmanaḥ,
1.118.47: jagāma saha patnībhyāṁ tato nāgaśataṁ girim ॥47॥
1.118.49: uvāsa sa mahārāja sameṣu viṣameṣu ca ॥49॥
1.119.1: tatrāpi tapasi śreṣṭhe vartamānaḥ sa vīryavān,
1.119.2: svargaṁ gantuṁ parākrāntaḥ svena vīryeṇa bhārata ॥2॥
1.119.4: sa tu kālena mahatā prāpya niṣkalmaṣaṁ tapaḥ,
1.119.6: bhavantaḥ kva gamiṣyanti brūta me vadatāṁ varāḥ ॥6॥
1.119.7: devānāṁ ca r̥ṣīṇāṁ ca pitr̥̄ṇāṁ ca mahātmanām,
1.119.10: dr̥ṣṭavanto girau ramye durgān deśān bahūn vayam,
1.119.13: nātikrāmeta pakṣī yān kuta evetare mr̥gāḥ ॥13॥
1.119.18: etāni tu yathākālaṁ yo na budhyati mānavaḥ ॥18॥
1.119.19: na tasya lokāḥ santīti dharmavidbhiḥ pratiṣṭhitam,
1.119.23: tathaivāsmin mama kṣetre kathaṁ vai sambhavet prajā,
asti vai tava dharmātman vidmo devopamaṁ śubham ॥23॥
1.119.25: tasmin dr̥ṣṭe phale rājan prayatnaṁ kartumarhasi ॥25॥
1.119.32: ime vai bandhudāyādāḥ ṣaṭ putrā dharmadarśane,
1.119.34: dattaḥ krītaḥ kr̥trimaśca upagacchet svayaṁ ca yaḥ,
1.119.37: tasmāt praheṣyāmyadya tvāṁ hīnaḥ prajananāt svayam,
1.119.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi pāṇḍupr̥thāsaṁvāde ūnaviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥119॥
1.120.4: apatyāya ca māṁ gaccha tvameva kurunandana ॥4॥
1.120.5: na hyahaṁ manasāpyanyaṁ gaccheyaṁ tvadr̥te naram,
1.120.6: imāṁ ca tāvad dharmātman paurāṇīṁ śr̥ṇu me kathām,
1.120.7: vyuṣitāśva iti khyāto babhūva kila pārthivaḥ,
1.120.10: devā brahmarṣayaścaiva cakruḥ karma svayaṁ tadā,
1.120.11: sa vijitya gr̥hītvā ca nr̥patīn rājasattamaḥ ॥11॥
1.120.13: apyatra gāthāṁ gāyanti ye purāṇavido janāḥ ॥13॥
1.120.16: suṣāva ca bahūn somān somasaṁsthāstatāna ca ॥16॥
1.120.21: patiṁ vinā jīvati yā na sā jīvati duḥkhitā ॥21॥
1.120.22: patiṁ vinā mr̥taṁ śreyo nāryāḥ kṣatriyapuṅgava,
1.120.23: prasādaṁ kuru me rājannitastūrṇaṁ nayasva mām ॥23॥
1.120.28: viprayuktā tu yā patyā muhūrtamapi jīvati,
duḥkhaṁ jīvati sā pāpā narakastheva pārthiva ॥28॥
1.120.32: evaṁ bahuvidhaṁ tasyāṁ vilapantyāṁ punaḥ punaḥ,
1.120.33: uttiṣṭha bhadre gaccha tvaṁ dadānīha varaṁ tava,
1.120.34: aṣṭamīṁ vā r̥tusnātā saṁviśethā mayā saha ॥34॥
1.120.35: evamuktā tu sā devī tathā cakre pativratā,
1.120.36: sā tena suṣuve devī śavena bharatarṣabha,
1.120.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi vyuṣitāśvopākhyāne viṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥120॥
1.121.3: atha tvidaṁ pravakṣyāmi dharmatattvaṁ nibodha me,
1.121.4: bhartā bhāryāṁ rājaputri dharmyaṁ vādharmyameva vā ॥4॥
1.121.5: yad brūyāt tat tathā kāryamiti vedavido viduḥ,
1.121.9d2: bhr̥ṇu cedaṁ mahābāho mama prītikaraṁ vacaḥ.
1.121.11: nigūḍhaniścayaṁ dharme yaṁ taṁ durvāsasaṁ viduḥ,
1.121.12: mantraṁ tvimaṁ ca me prādādabravīccaiva māmidam ॥12॥
1.121.13: akāmo vā sakāmo vā vaśaṁ te samupaiṣyati ॥13॥
1.121.14: tasya tasya prasādāt te rājñi putro bhaviṣyati,
1.121.15: tena mantreṇa rājarṣe yathāsyānnau prajā hitā ॥15॥
1.121.15d1: yāṁ me vidyāṁ mahārāja adadāt sa mahāyaśāḥ,
1.121.16: āvāhayāmi kaṁ devaṁ brūhi satyavatāṁ vara,
1.121.16d1: dhanyo’smyanugr̥hīto’smi tvaṁ no dhātrī kulasya hi,
namo maharṣaye tasmai yena datto varastava.
1.121.16d2: na cādharmeṇa dharmajñe śakyāḥ pālayituṁ prajāḥ.
1.121.17: dharmamāvāhaya śubhe sa hi lokeṣu puṇyabhāk ॥17॥
1.121.18: adharmeṇa na no dharmaḥ saṁyujyati kathañcana,
1.121.19: dhārmikaśca kurūṇāṁ sa bhaviṣyati na saṁśayaḥ,
dharmeṇa cāpi dattasya nādharme raṁsyate manaḥ ॥19॥
1.121.20: tasmād dharmaṁ puraskr̥tya niyatā tvaṁ śucismite,
1.121.21: sā tathoktā tathetyuktvā tena bhartrā varāṅganā,
1.121.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi kuntīputrotpattyanujñāne ekaviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥121॥
1.122.2: sā baliṁ tvaritā devī dharmāyopajahāra ha,
1.122.3: ājagāma tato devo dharmo mantrabalāt tataḥ,
1.122.4: vihasya tāṁ tato brūyāḥ kunti kiṁ te dadāmyaham,
1.122.5: saṁyuktā sā hi dharmeṇa yogamūrtidhareṇa ha,
1.122.8: vikrāntaḥ satyavāk tveva rājā pr̥thvyāṁ bhaviṣyati ॥8॥
1.122.9: yudhiṣṭhira iti khyātaḥ pāṇḍoḥ prathamajaḥ sutaḥ,
bhavitā prathito rājā triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ ॥9॥
1.122.10: yaśasā tejasā caiva vr̥ttena ca samanvitaḥ,
dhārmikaṁ taṁ sutaṁ labdhvā pāṇḍustāṁ punarabravīt ॥10॥
1.122.11: prāhuḥ kṣatraṁ balajyeṣṭhaṁ balajyeṣṭhaṁ sutaṁ vr̥ṇu,
1.122.11d3: sa no yaṁ dāsyati sutaṁ sa prāṇabalavān nr̥ṣu,
1.122.12: kiṁ te kunti dadāmyadya brūhi yat te hr̥di sthitam ॥12॥
1.122.13: sā salajjā vihasyāha putraṁ dehi surottama,
1.122.16d1: kuntī tu saha putreṇa yātvā suruciraṁ saraḥ,
1.122.16d5: nādena mahatā tāṁ tu pūrayantaṁ girerguhām,
1.122.17: tataḥ sa vajrasaṅghātaḥ kumāro nyapatad girau ॥17॥
1.122.18d1: maghe candramasā yukte siṁhe cābhyudite gurau,
1.122.18d2: maitre muhūrte sā kuntī suṣuve bhīmamacyutam.
1.122.20: kathaṁ nu me varaḥ putro lokaśreṣṭho bhavediti ॥20॥
1.122.21: tatra daivaṁ tu vidhinā kālayuktena labhyate ॥21॥
1.122.22: indro hi rājā devānāṁ pradhāna iti naḥ śrutam,
1.122.23: taṁ toṣayitvā tapasā putraṁ lapsye mahābalam,
yaṁ dāsyati sa me putraṁ sa varīyān bhaviṣyati ॥23॥
1.122.24: karmaṇā manasā vācā tasmāt tapsye mahat tapaḥ ॥24॥
1.122.25: dideśa kuntyāḥ kauravyo vrataṁ sāṁvatsaraṁ śubham ॥25॥
1.122.26: ugraṁ sa tapa āsthāya parameṇa samādhinā ॥26॥
1.122.28: taṁ tu kālena mahatā vāsavaḥ pratyapadyata,
putraṁ tava pradāsyāmi triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam ॥28॥
1.122.32: dātumicchati te putraṁ yathā saṅkalpitaṁ tvayā,
1.122.35d1: uttarābhyāṁ tu pūrvābhyāṁ phalgunībhyāṁ tato divā,
jātastu phālgune māsi tenāsau phālgunaḥ smr̥taḥ.
1.122.40: eṣa madrān vaśe kr̥tvā kurūṁśca saha somakaiḥ,
1.122.41: medasā sarvabhūtānāṁ tr̥ptiṁ yāsyati vai parām ॥41॥
1.122.49: ākāśe dundubhīnāṁ ca babhūva tumulaḥ svanaḥ,
1.122.50: prajānāṁ patayaḥ sarve sapta caiva maharṣayaḥ ॥50॥
1.122.54: gandharvaiḥ sahitaḥ śrīmān prāgāyata ca tumburuḥ ॥54॥
1.122.61: adrikā ca tathā somā miśrakeśī tvalambuṣā ॥61॥
1.122.62: ambikā lakṣaṇā kṣemā devī rambhā manoramā ॥62॥
1.122.63: asitā ca subāhuśca supriyā ca vapustathā,
puṇḍarīkā sugandhā ca surasā ca pramāthinī ॥63॥
1.122.65: umloceti ca vikhyātā pramloceti ca tā daśa ॥65॥
1.122.67: indro vivasvān pūṣā ca tvaṣṭā ca savitā tathā,
1.122.72: ete cānye ca bahavastatra nāgā vyavasthitāḥ ॥72॥
1.122.75: adhikāṁ sma tato vr̥ttimavartan pāṇḍavān prati ॥75॥
1.122.77: ataḥ paraṁ svairiṇī syād bandhakī pañcame bhavet ॥77॥
1.122.78: sa tvaṁ vidvan dharmamimamadhigamya kathaṁ nu mām,
1.122.78d1: evametad dharmaśāstraṁ yathā vadasi tat tathā,
1.122.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi pāṇḍavotpattau dvāviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥122॥
1.123.2: na me’sti tvayi santāpo viguṇe’pi parantapa,
1.123.3: śrutvā na me tathā duḥkhamabhavat kurunandana ॥3॥
1.123.4: idaṁ tu me mahad duḥkhaṁ tulyatāyāmaputratā,
1.123.5: kuryādanugraho me syāt tava cāpi hitaṁ bhavet ॥5॥
1.123.6: saṁrambho hi sapatnītvād vaktuṁ kuntisutāṁ prati,
yadi tu tvaṁ prasanno me svayamenāṁ pracodaya ॥6॥
1.123.8: tava tvidaṁ mataṁ matvā prayatiṣyāmyataḥ param,
manye dhruvaṁ mayoktā sā vacanaṁ pratipatsyate ॥8॥
1.123.9: kulasya mama santānaṁ lokasya ca kuru priyam ॥9॥
1.123.11: yaśaso’rthāya caiva tvaṁ kuru karma suduṣkaram,
1.123.24: mudaṁ paramikāṁ lebhe nananda ca narādhipaḥ,
1.123.26: tamuvāca pr̥thā rājan rahasyuktā tadā satī,
uktā sakr̥d dvandvameṣā lebhe tenāsmi vañcitā ॥26॥
1.123.28: evaṁ pāṇḍoḥ sutāḥ pañca devadattā mahābalāḥ ॥28॥
1.123.31d6: na bhaveran kriyāhīnāḥ pāṇḍoḥ putrā mahāyaśaḥ,
1.123.31d8: gāśca raupyaṁ hiraṇyaṁ ca preṣayāmāsa bhārata.
1.123.31d9: tāni sarvāṇi saṅgr̥hya prayayau sa purohitaḥ,
1.123.31d10: pr̥thā mādrī ca saṁhr̥ṣṭe vasudevaṁ praśaṁsatām.
1.123.31d13: śaryāteḥ pr̥ṣataḥ putraḥ śuko nāma parantapaḥ.
1.123.31d18: anujñāya tato rājā śaktiṁ khaḍgaṁ tathā śarān.
1.123.32: te ca pañca śataṁ caiva kuruvaṁśavivardhanāḥ,
1.123.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi pāṇḍavotpattau trayoviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥123॥
1.124.1d1: pūrṇe caturdaśe varṣe phālgunasya ca dhīmataḥ,
1.124.4: pāṇḍorvanaṁ tat samprekṣya prajajñe hr̥di manmathaḥ ॥4॥
1.124.6: samīkṣamāṇaḥ sa tu tāṁ vayaḥsthāṁ tanuvāsasam,
1.124.7: rahasyekāṁ tu tāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā rājā rājīvalocanām,
na śaśāka niyantuṁ taṁ kāmaṁ kāmavaśīkr̥taḥ ॥7॥
1.124.8: tata enāṁ balād rājā nijagrāha raho gatām,
1.124.9: sa tu kāmaparītātmā taṁ śāpaṁ nānvabudhyata,
1.124.11: tasya kāmātmano buddhiḥ sākṣāt kālena mohitā,
1.124.12: sa tayā saha saṅgamya bhāryayā kurunandanaḥ,
1.124.13: mumoca duḥkhajaṁ śabdaṁ punaḥ punaratīva hi ॥13॥
1.124.14: saha putraistataḥ kuntī mādrīputrau ca pāṇḍavau,
1.124.17: dr̥ṣṭvā pāṇḍuṁ ca mādrīṁ ca śayānau dharaṇītale,
1.124.19: nanu nāma tvayā mādri rakṣitavyo narādhipaḥ,
sā kathaṁ lobhitavatī vijane tvaṁ narādhipam ॥19॥
1.124.21: dhanyā tvamasi bāhlīki matto bhāgyatarā tathā,
1.124.22: ātmā na vārito’nena satyaṁ diṣṭaṁ cikīrṣuṇā ॥22॥
1.124.22d1: papāta sahasā bhūmau chinnamūla iva drumaḥ.
1.124.22d2: niśceṣṭā patitā bhūmau mohānnaiva cacāla sā.
1.124.22d5: mādrī cāpi samāliṅgya rājānaṁ vilalāpa sā.
1.124.22d7: dr̥ṣṭvā pāṇḍuṁ naravyāghraṁ śocanti sma maharṣayaḥ.
1.124.22d9: hā rājan kasya nau hitvā gacchasi tridaśālayam.
1.124.22d10: hā rājan mama mandāyāḥ kathaṁ mādrīṁ sametya vai,
1.124.22d11: kasya hitvā priyān putrān prayāto’si viśāmpate.
1.124.22d12: nūnaṁ tvāṁ tridaśā devāḥ pratinandanti bhārata,
yathā hi tapa ugraṁ te caritaṁ viprasaṁsadi.
1.124.22d13: āvābhyāṁ sahito rājan gamiṣyasi divaṁ śubham,
1.124.22d14: vilapitvā bhr̥śaṁ tvevaṁ niḥsañjñe patite bhuvi,
1.124.22d15: pāṇḍoḥ pādau pariṣvajya vilapanti sma pāṇḍavāḥ.
1.124.23: ahaṁ jyeṣṭhā dharmapatnī jyeṣṭhaṁ dharmaphalaṁ mama,
1.124.25: na hi tr̥ptāsmi kāmānāṁ jyeṣṭhā māmanumanyatām ॥25॥
1.124.27: na cāpyahaṁ vartayantī nirviśeṣaṁ suneṣu te,
1.124.28: māṁ ca kāmayamāno’yaṁ rājā pretavaśaṁ gataḥ ॥28॥
1.124.28d1: ūcuḥ kuntīṁ ca mādrīṁ ca samāśvāsya tapasvinaḥ.
1.124.28d2: subhage bālaputre tu na martavyaṁ kathañcana,
1.124.28d4: mādryāśca balināṁ śreṣṭhaḥ śalyo bhrātā mahārathaḥ.
1.124.28d5: bhartrā tu maraṇaṁ sārdhaṁ phalavannātra saṁśayaḥ,
1.124.28d6: mr̥te bhartari yā sādhvī brahmacaryavrate sthitā,
1.124.28d12: ājñā śirasi nikṣiptā kariṣyāmi ca tat tathā.
1.124.28d13: bhartuśca mama putrāṇāṁ mama caiva na saṁśayaḥ.
1.124.28d14: asyā hi na samā buddhyā yadyapi syādarundhatī.
1.124.28d15: nāhaṁ tvamiva putrāṇāṁ samarthā dhāraṇe tathā.
1.124.28d18: dadau kuntyai yamau mādrī śirasābhipraṇamya ca.
1.124.28d19: abhivādya r̥ṣīn sarvān pariṣvajya ca pāṇḍavān,
1.124.28d21: kuntī mātā ahaṁ dhātrī yuṣmākaṁ tu pitā mr̥taḥ,
1.124.28d22: tādr̥śā na vinaśyanti naiva yānti parābhavam.
1.124.28d24: r̥ṣīṇāṁ ca pr̥thāyāśca namaskr̥tya punaḥ punaḥ,
1.124.28d25: dhanyā tvamasi vārṣṇeyi nāsti strī sadr̥śī tvayā,
vīryaṁ tejaśca yogaṁ ca māhātmyaṁ ca yaśasvinām.
1.124.28d27: svargaṁ didr̥kṣamāṇāyā mamaiṣā na vr̥thā bhavet,
āryā cāpyabhivādyā ca mama pūjyā ca sarvataḥ.
1.124.28d28: jyeṣṭhā variṣṭhā tvaṁ devi bhūṣitā svaguṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ,
1.124.28d29: dharmaṁ svargaṁ ca kīrtiṁ ca tvatkr̥te’hamavāpnuyām,
yathā tathā vidhatsveha mā ca kārṣīrvicāraṇām.
1.124.28d32: saṅgatā svargaloke tvaṁ ramethāḥ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ.
1.124.31d3: kāśyapaḥ kārayāmāsa pāṇḍoḥ pretasya tāṁ kriyām.
1.124.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi pāṇḍūparame caturviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥124॥
1.125.2: hitvā rājyaṁ ca rāṣṭraṁ ca sa mahātmā mahāyaśāḥ,
1.125.4: svarāṣṭraṁ gr̥hya gacchāmo dharma eṣa hi naḥ smr̥taḥ ॥4॥
1.125.6: bhīṣmāya pāṇḍavān dātuṁ dhr̥tarāṣṭrāya caiva hi ॥6॥
1.125.7: pāṇḍordārāṁśca putrāṁśca śarīre te ca tāpasāḥ ॥7॥
1.125.8: sukhinī sā purā bhūtvā satataṁ putravatsalā,
1.125.10: dvāriṇaṁ tāpasā ūcū rājānaṁ ca prakāśaya,
te tu gatvā kṣaṇenaiva sabhāyāṁ viniveditāḥ ॥10॥
1.125.15: prajñācakṣuśca rājarṣiḥ kṣattā ca viduraḥ svayam ॥15॥
1.125.16: sā ca satyavatī devī kausalyā ca yaśasvinī,
1.125.21: bhīṣmo rājyaṁ ca rāṣṭraṁ ca maharṣibhyo nyavedayat,
1.125.22: yaḥ sa kauravya dāyādaḥ pāṇḍurnāma narādhipaḥ,
1.125.24: tathainaṁ balināṁ śreṣṭhaṁ tasya rājño mahātmanaḥ,
mātariśvā dadau putraṁ bhīmaṁ nāma mahābalam ॥24॥
1.125.31: tasyāstasya ca yat kāryaṁ kriyatāṁ tadanantaram ॥31॥
1.125.31d1: pr̥thāṁ ca śaraṇaṁ prāptāṁ pāṇḍavāṁśca yaśasvinaḥ,
1.125.32: ime tayoḥ śarīre dve putrāśceme tayorvarāḥ,
1.125.35: r̥ṣisiddhagaṇaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā vismayaṁ te paraṁ yayuḥ ॥35॥
1.125.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi r̥ṣisaṁvāde pañcaviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥125॥
1.126.2: paśūn vāsāṁsi ratnāni dhanāni vividhāni ca,
pāṇḍoḥ prayaccha mādryāśca yebhyo yāvacca vāñchitam ॥2॥
1.126.3: yathā ca kuntī satkāraṁ kuryānmādryāstathā kuru,
yathā na vāyurnādityaḥ paśyetāṁ tāṁ susaṁvr̥tām ॥3॥
1.126.4: na śocyaḥ pāṇḍuranaghaḥ praśasyaḥ sa narādhipaḥ,
yasya pañca sutā vīrā jātāḥ surasutopamāḥ ॥4॥
1.126.6: nirhr̥tāḥ pāvakā dīptāḥ pāṇḍo rājan purohitaiḥ ॥6॥
1.126.16: krośantaḥ pāṇḍavāḥ sarve bhīṣmo vidura eva ca,
1.126.24: tatastayoḥ śarīre dve dr̥ṣṭvā mohavaśaṁ gatā,
hā hā putreti kausalyā papāta sahasā bhuvi ॥24॥
1.126.28: tato bhīṣmo’tha viduro rājā ca saha pāṇḍavaiḥ,
1.126.31: yathaiva pāṇḍavā bhūmau suṣupuḥ saha bāndhavaiḥ,
1.126.32: babhūva pāṇḍavaiḥ sārdhaṁ nagaraṁ dvādaśa kṣapāḥ ॥32॥
1.126.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi pāṇḍudāhe ṣaḍviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥126॥
1.127.1: tataḥ kuntī ca rājā ca bhīṣmaśca saha bandhubhiḥ,
daduḥ śrāddhaṁ tadā pāṇḍoḥ svadhāmr̥tamayaṁ tadā ॥1॥
1.127.5: śrāddhāvasāne tu tadā dr̥ṣṭvā taṁ duḥkhitaṁ janam,
1.127.8: gaccha tvaṁ yogamāsthāya yuktā vasa tapovane ॥8॥
1.127.10: ambike tava pautrasya durnayāt kila bhāratāḥ,
1.127.11: vanamādāya bhadraṁ te gacchāmi yadi manyase ॥11॥
1.127.12: vanaṁ yayau satyavatī snuṣābhyāṁ saha bhārata ॥12॥
1.127.19: kaceṣu ca nigr̥hyainān vinihatya balād balī,
1.127.20: daśa bālāñjale krīḍan bhujābhyāṁ parigr̥hya saḥ,
āste sma salile magno mr̥takalpān vimuñcati ॥20॥
1.127.21: phalāni vr̥kṣamāruhya vicinvanti ca te tadā,
1.127.22: saphalāḥ prapatanti sma drutaṁ trastāḥ kumārakāḥ ॥22॥
1.127.23: na te niyuddhe na jave na yogyāsu kadācana,
1.127.29: taṁ tu suptaṁ purodyāne gaṅgāyāṁ prakṣipāmahe,
1.127.30: evaṁ sa niścayaṁ pāpaḥ kr̥tvā duryodhanastadā,
1.127.33: pramāṇakoṭyāṁ taṁ deśaṁ sthalaṁ kiñcidupetya ha ॥33॥
1.127.34: bhakṣyaṁ bhojyaṁ ca peyaṁ ca coṣyaṁ lehyamathāpi ca,
1.127.39: viśanti sma tadā vīrāḥ siṁhā iva girerguhām,
1.127.47: svayaṁ prakṣipate bhakṣyaṁ bahu bhīmasya pāpakr̥t,
pratīcchitaṁ sma bhīmena taṁ vai doṣamajānatā ॥47॥
1.127.59: tataḥ prabuddhaḥ kaunteyaḥ sarvaṁ sañchidya bandhanam,
pothayāmāsa tān sarvān kecid bhītāḥ pradudruvuḥ ॥59॥
1.127.61: ayaṁ naro vai nāgendra hyapsu baddhvā praveśitaḥ,
yathā ca no matirvīra viṣapīto bhaviṣyati ॥61॥
1.127.63: pothayantaṁ mahābāhuṁ tvaṁ vai taṁ jñātumarhasi,
1.127.64: āryakeṇa ca dr̥ṣṭaḥ sa pr̥thāyā āryakeṇa ca ॥64॥
1.127.66: abravīt taṁ ca nāgendraḥ kimasya kriyatāṁ priyam,
1.127.68: rasaṁ pibet kumāro’yaṁ tvayi prīte mahābalaḥ,
1.127.71: ekocchvāsāt tataḥ kuṇḍaṁ pibati sma mahābalaḥ,
1.127.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi bhīmasenarasapāne saptaviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥127॥
1.128.1: tataste kauravāḥ sarve vinā bhīmaṁ ca pāṇḍavāḥ,
1.128.2: bruvanto bhīmasenastu yāto hyagrata eva naḥ ॥2॥
1.128.3: bhrātr̥bhiḥ sahito hr̥ṣṭo nagaraṁ praviveśa ha ॥3॥
1.128.6: kva gato bhavitā mātarneha paśyāmi taṁ śubhe,
1.128.7: tadarthaṁ na ca taṁ vīraṁ dr̥ṣṭavanto vr̥kodaram,
manyamānāstataḥ sarve yāto naḥ pūrvameva saḥ ॥7॥
1.128.8: ihāgamya kva nu gatastvayā vā preṣitaḥ kva nu ॥8॥
1.128.9: na hi me śudhyate bhāvastaṁ vīraṁ prati śobhane ॥9॥
1.128.10: yataḥ prasuptaṁ manye’haṁ bhīmaṁ neti hatastu saḥ,
ityuktā ca tataḥ kuntī dharmarājena dhīmatā ॥10॥
1.128.11: hā heti kr̥tvā sambhrāntā pratyuvāca yudhiṣṭhiram,
na putra bhīmaṁ paśyāmi na māmabhyetyasāviti ॥11॥
1.128.13: kya gato bhagavan kṣattarbhīmaseno na dr̥śyate ॥13॥
1.128.15: na ca prīṇayate cakṣuḥ sadā duryodhanasya saḥ,
1.128.16: tena me vyākulaṁ cittaṁ hr̥dayaṁ dahyatīva ca ॥16॥
1.128.17: pratyādiṣṭo hi duṣṭātmā śeṣe’pi praharet tava ॥17॥
1.128.19: evamuktvā yayau vidvān viduraḥ svaṁ niveśanam,
1.128.21: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā pratibudhyantaṁ pāṇḍavaṁ te bhujaṅgamāḥ,
1.128.22: yat te pīto mahābāho raso’yaṁ vīryasambhr̥taḥ,
1.128.23: gacchādya tvaṁ ca svagr̥haṁ snāto divyairimairjalaiḥ,
1.128.34: tūṣṇīṁ bhava na te jalpyamidaṁ kāryaṁ kathañcana ॥34॥
1.128.39: vikāraṁ na hyajanayat sutīkṣṇamapi tad viṣam,
1.128.43: adhijagmuśca kuravo dhanurvedaṁ kr̥pāt tu te ॥43॥
1.128.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi bhīmapratyāgamane aṣṭāviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥128॥
1.129.2: putraḥ kila mahārāja jātaḥ saha śarairvibho ॥2॥
1.129.6: prāhiṇot tapaso vighnaṁ kuru tasyeti kaurava ॥6॥
1.129.7: sā hi gatvā’’śramaṁ tasya ramaṇīyaṁ śaradvataḥ,
1.129.11: tena susrāva reto’sya sa ca tannānvabudhyata ॥11॥
1.129.12: dhanuśca saśaraṁ tyaktvā tathā kr̥ṣṇājināni ca,
sa vihāyāśramaṁ taṁ ca tāṁ caivāpsarasaṁ muniḥ ॥12॥
1.129.13: jagāma retastat tasya śarastambe papāta ca,
1.129.15: dhanuśca saśaraṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tathā kr̥ṣṇājināni ca ॥15॥
1.129.16: sa rājñe darśayāmāsa mithunaṁ saśaraṁ dhanuḥ ॥16॥
1.129.17: sa tadādāya mithunaṁ rājā ca kr̥payānvitaḥ,
1.129.20: tasmāt tayornāma cakre tadeva sa mahīpatiḥ,
1.129.31: kathaṁ cāgāt kurūn brahman kasya putraḥ sa vīryavān ॥31॥
1.129.38: tataḥ samabhavad droṇaḥ kalaśe tasya dhīmataḥ,
adhyagīṣṭa sa vedāṁśca vedāṅgāni ca sarvaśaḥ ॥38॥
1.129.41: tasyāpi drupado nāma tadā samabhavat sutaḥ ॥41॥
1.129.42: sa nityamāśramaṁ gatvā droṇena saha pārthivaḥ,
1.129.43: tato vyatīte pr̥ṣate sa rājā drupado’bhavat,
1.129.46: agnihotre ca dharme ca dame ca satataṁ ratām ॥46॥
1.129.48: aśvasyevāsya yat sthāma nadataḥ pradiśo gatam ॥48॥
1.129.52: sa rāmasya dhanurvedaṁ divyānyastrāṇi caiva ha,
śrutvā teṣu manaścakre nītiśāstre tathaiva ca ॥52॥
1.129.58: āgataṁ vittakāmaṁ māṁ viddhi droṇaṁ dvijarṣabha,
1.129.59: svāgataṁ te dvijaśreṣṭha yadicchasi vadasva me,
1.129.60: rāmaṁ praharatāṁ śreṣṭhaṁ ditsantaṁ vividhaṁ vasu,
1.129.61: hiraṇyaṁ mama yaccānyad vasu kiñcidiha sthitam,
1.129.63: astrāṇi ca mahārhāṇi śastrāṇi vividhāni ca ॥63॥
1.129.64: vr̥ṇīṣva kiṁ prayacchāmi tubhyaṁ droṇa vadāśu tat ॥64॥
1.129.67: priyaṁ sakhāyaṁ suprīto jagāma drupadaṁ prati ॥67॥
1.129.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi droṇasya bhārgavādastraprāptau ūnatriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥129॥
1.130.1: abravīt pārthivaṁ rājan sakhāyaṁ viddhi māmiha ॥1॥
1.130.4: yanmāṁ bravīṣi prasabhaṁ sakhā te’hamiti dvija ॥4॥
1.130.6: sauhr̥daṁ me tvayā hyāsīt pūrvaṁ sāmarthyabandhanam ॥6॥
1.130.7: na sakhyamajaraṁ loke hr̥di tiṣṭhati kasyacit,
kālo hyenaṁ viharati krodho vainaṁ haratyuta ॥7॥
1.130.9: na daridro vasumato nāvidvān viduṣaḥ sakhā,
na śūrasya sakhā klībaḥ sakhipūrvaṁ kimiṣyate ॥9॥
1.130.10: yayoreva samaṁ vittaṁ yayoreva samaṁ śrutam,
tayorvivāhaḥ sakhyaṁ ca na tu puṣṭavipuṣṭayoḥ ॥10॥
1.130.13: sa viniścitya manasā pāñcālaṁ prati buddhimān,
1.130.15: astrāṇi śikṣayāmāsa nābudhyanta ca taṁ janāḥ ॥15॥
1.130.16: evaṁ sa tatra gūḍhātmā kañcit kālamuvāsa ha,
1.130.17: krīḍanto vīṭayā tatra vīrāḥ paryacaran mudā,
papāta kūpe sā vīṭā teṣāṁ vai krīḍatāṁ tadā ॥17॥
1.130.18: na ca te pratyapadyanta karma vīṭopalabdhaye ॥18॥
1.130.23: aho vo dhig balaṁ kṣātraṁ dhigetāṁ vaḥ kr̥tāstrātām,
1.130.24: vīṭāṁ ca mudrikāṁ caiva hyahametadapi dvayam,
1.130.28: asyā vīryaṁ nirīkṣadhvaṁ yadanyasya na vidyate,
1.130.29: tato yathoktaṁ droṇena tat sarvaṁ kr̥tamañjasā ॥29॥
1.130.34: ko’si kasyāsi jānīmo vayaṁ kiṁ karavāmahe ॥34॥
1.130.35: ācakṣadhvaṁ ca bhīṣmāya rūpeṇa ca guṇaiśca mām ॥35॥
1.130.36: tathetyuktvā ca gatvā ca bhīṣmamūcuḥ kumārakāḥ ॥36॥
1.130.37: bhīṣmaḥ śrutvā kumārāṇāṁ droṇaṁ taṁ pratyajānata ॥37॥
1.130.43: sa me tatra sakhā cāsīdupakārī priyaśca me,
tenāhaṁ saha saṅgamya vartayan suciraṁ prabho ॥43॥
1.130.44: sa me sakhā sadā tatra priyavādī priyaṅkaraḥ ॥44॥
1.130.46: abhiṣekṣyati māṁ rājye sa pāñcālo yadā tadā,
tvadbhogyaṁ bhavitā tāta sakhe satyena te śape ॥46॥
1.130.47: mama bhogāśca vittaṁ ca tvadadhīnaṁ sukhāni ca,
1.130.49: agnihotre ca satre ca dame ca satataṁ ratām ॥49॥
1.130.51: putreṇa tena prīto’haṁ bharadvājo mayā yathā,
1.130.52: iti sañcintya manasā taṁ deśaṁ bahuśo bhraman ॥52॥
1.130.54: pītvā piṣṭarasaṁ bālaḥ kṣīraṁ pītaṁ mayāpi ca ॥54॥
1.130.55: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā nr̥tyamānaṁ tu bālaiḥ parivr̥taṁ sutam ॥55॥
1.130.57: piṣṭodakaṁ suto yasya pītvā kṣīrasya tr̥ṣṇayā,
nr̥tyati sma mudāviṣṭaḥ kṣīraṁ pītaṁ mayāpyuta ॥57॥
1.130.58: iti sambhāṣatāṁ vācaṁ śrutvā me buddhiracyavat,
1.130.59: api cāhaṁ purā viprairvarjito garhito vase,
paropasevāṁ pāpiṣṭhāṁ na ca kuryāṁ dhanepsayā ॥59॥
1.130.60: iti matvā priyaṁ putraṁ bhīṣmādāya tato hyaham,
1.130.62: saṁsmaran saṅgamaṁ caiva vacanaṁ caiva tasya tat,
1.130.65: yadāttha māṁ tvaṁ prasabhaṁ sakhā te’hamiti dvija,
1.130.66: sauhr̥daṁ me tvayā hyāsīt pūrvaṁ sāmarthyabandhanam,
1.130.67: na sakhyamajaraṁ loke vidyate jātu kasyacit ॥67॥
1.130.68: kālo vainaṁ viharati krodho vainaṁ haratyuta,
1.130.69: na hyanāḍhyaḥ sakhāḍhyasya nāvidvān viduṣaḥ sakhā ॥69॥
1.130.70: na śūrasya sakhā klībaḥ sakhipūrvaṁ kimiṣyate,
1.130.72: ahaṁ tvayā na jānāmi rājyārthe saṁvidaṁ kr̥tām ॥72॥
1.130.73: ekarātraṁ tu te brahman kāmaṁ dāsyāmi bhojanam,
1.130.76: idaṁ nāgapuraṁ ramyaṁ brūhi kiṁ karavāṇi te,
1.130.77: bhuṅkṣva bhogān bhr̥śaṁ prītaḥ pūjyamānaḥ kurukṣaye ॥77॥
1.130.78: kurūṇāmasti yad vittaṁ rājyaṁ cedaṁ sarāṣṭrakam,
tvameva paramo rājā sarve ca kuravastava ॥78॥
1.130.79: yacca te prārthitaṁ brahman kr̥taṁ taditi cintyatām,
diṣṭyā prāpto’si viprarṣe mahān me’nugrahaḥ kr̥taḥ ॥79॥
1.130.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi bhīṣmadroṇasamāgame triṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥130॥
1.131.1: tataḥ sampūjito droṇo bhīṣmeṇa dvipadāṁ varaḥ,
1.131.2: śiṣyatvena dadau bhīṣmo vasūni vividhāni ca ॥2॥
1.131.5: pratigr̥hya ca tān sarvān droṇo vacanamabravīt,
1.131.8: tato’rjunaṁ tadā mūrdhni samāghrāya punaḥ punaḥ,
1.131.17: yāvat te nopagacchanti tāvadasmai parāṁ kriyām,
droṇa ācaṣṭa putrāya tat karma jiṣṇurauhata ॥17॥
1.131.20: astre ca paramaṁ yogaṁ priyo droṇasya cābhavat ॥20॥
1.131.22: na cākhyeyamidaṁ cāpi madvākyaṁ vijaye tvayā ॥22॥
1.131.23: tena tatra pradīpaḥ sa dīpyamāno vilopitaḥ ॥23॥
1.131.24: bhuṅkta eva tu kaunteyo nāsyādanyatra vartate,
1.131.27: prayatiṣye tathā kartuṁ yathā nānyo dhanurdharaḥ,
tvatsamo bhavitā loke satyametad bravīmi te ॥27॥
1.131.28: tato droṇo’rjunaṁ bhūyo hayeṣu ca gajeṣu ca,
1.131.32: na sa taṁ pratijagrāha naiṣādiriti cintayan,
1.131.33: sa tu droṇasya śirasā pādau gr̥hya parantapaḥ,
1.131.38: śvā caran sa vane mūḍho naiṣādiṁ prati jagmivān ॥38॥
1.131.40: tadā tasyātha bhaṣataḥ śunaḥ sapta śarān mukhe,
1.131.41: sa tu śvā śarapūrṇāsyaḥ pāṇḍavānājagāma ha,
taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā pāṇḍavā vīrāḥ paraṁ vismayamāgatāḥ ॥41॥
1.131.42: lāghavaṁ śabdavedhitvaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tat paramaṁ tadā,
1.131.44: athainaṁ paripapracchuḥ ko bhavān kasya vetyuta ॥44॥
1.131.53: pūjayitvā tato droṇaṁ vidhivat sa niṣādajaḥ,
1.131.54: yadi śiṣyo’si me vīra vetanaṁ dīyatāṁ mama ॥54॥
1.131.56: na hi kiñcidadeyaṁ me gurave brahmavittama,
1.131.57: pratijñāmātmano rakṣan satye ca niyataḥ sadā ॥57॥
1.131.59: na tathā ca sa śīghro’bhūd yathā pūrvaṁ narādhipa ॥59॥
1.131.61: droṇasya tu tadā śiṣyau gadāyogyau babhūvatuḥ,
1.131.71: sandhatsva bāṇaṁ durdharṣa madvākyānte vimuñca tam ॥71॥
1.131.75: atha vr̥kṣamimaṁ māṁ vā bhrātr̥̄n vāpi prapaśyasi ॥75॥
1.131.76: bhavantaṁ ca tathā bhrātr̥̄n bhāsaṁ ceti punaḥ punaḥ ॥76॥
1.131.79: tathā ca sarve tat sarvaṁ paśyāma iti kutsitāḥ ॥79॥
1.132.4: paśyasyenaṁ sthitaṁ bhāsaṁ drumaṁ māmapi cārjuna ॥4॥
1.132.5: na tu vr̥kṣaṁ bhavantaṁ vā paśyāmīti ca bhārata ॥5॥
1.132.6: tataḥ prītamanā droṇo muhūrtādiva taṁ punaḥ,
1.132.7: bhāsaṁ paśyasi yadyenaṁ tathā brūhi punarvacaḥ,
śiraḥ paśyāmi bhāsasya na gātramiti so’bravīt ॥7॥
1.132.10: mene ca drupadaṁ saṅkhye sānubandhaṁ parājitam ॥10॥
1.132.15: taṁ tu dr̥ṣṭvā kriyopetaṁ droṇo’manyata pāṇḍavam ॥15॥
1.132.19: na ca te mānuṣeṣvetat prayoktavyaṁ kathañcana,
1.132.20: tad dhārayethāḥ prayataḥ śr̥ṇu cedaṁ vaco mama ॥20॥
1.132.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi droṇagrāhamokṣaṇe dvātriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥132॥
1.133.2: gāṅgeyasya ca sāṁnidhye vyāsasya vidurasya ca ॥2॥
1.133.3: te darśayeyuḥ svāṁ śikṣāṁ rājannanumate tava ॥3॥
1.133.4: bhāradvāja mahat karma kr̥taṁ te dvijasattama ॥4॥
1.133.5: yadānumanyase kālaṁ yasmin deśe yathā yathā,
1.133.6: astrahetoḥ parākrāntān ye me drakṣyanti putrakān ॥6॥
1.133.7: kṣattaryad gururācāryo bravīti kuru tat tathā,
na hīdr̥śaṁ priyaṁ manye bhavitā dharmavatsala ॥7॥
1.133.9: tasyāṁ bhūmau baliṁ cakre tithau nakṣatrapūjite ॥9॥
1.133.10: avaghuṣṭe samāje ca tadarthaṁ vadatāṁ varaḥ,
1.133.15: gāndhārī ca mahābhāgā kuntī ca jayatāṁ vara,
1.133.18: mahārṇava iva kṣubdhaḥ samājaḥ so’bhavat tadā ॥18॥
1.133.21: sa yathāsamayaṁ cakre baliṁ balavatāṁ varaḥ,
1.133.21d1: pradadau dakṣiṇāṁ rājā droṇasya ca kr̥pasya ca.
1.133.24d1: pūjāṁ cakruryathānyāyaṁ droṇasya ca kr̥pasya ca.
1.133.29: kr̥tvā dhanuṣi te mārgān rathacaryāsu cāsakr̥t,
1.134.1: kururāje hi raṅgasthe bhīme ca balināṁ vare,
1.134.2: hī vīra kururājeti hī bhīma iti jalpatām,
1.134.21: kṣaṇāt prāṁśuḥ kṣaṇād hrasvaḥ kṣaṇācca rathadhūrgataḥ,
1.134.22: sukumāraṁ ca sūkṣmaṁ ca guruṁ cāpi gurupriyaḥ,
1.134.26: mandībhūte samāje ca vāditrasya ca niḥsvane ॥26॥
1.134.28: dīryante kiṁ nu girayaḥ kiṁsvid bhūmirvidīryate,
1.134.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi astradarśane catustriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥134॥
1.135.9: pārtha yat te kr̥taṁ karma viśeṣavadahaṁ tataḥ,
kariṣye paśyatāṁ nr̥̄ṇāṁ mā’’tmanā vismayaṁ gamaḥ ॥9॥
1.135.10: yantrotkṣipta ivottasthau kṣipraṁ vai sarvato janaḥ ॥10॥
1.135.12: yat kr̥taṁ tatra pārthena taccakāra mahābalaḥ ॥12॥
1.135.14: svāgataṁ te mahābāho diṣṭyā prāpto’si mānada,
1.135.15: kr̥taṁ sarvamahaṁ manye sakhitvaṁ ca tvayā vr̥ṇe,
1.135.16: bhuṅkṣva bhogān mayā sārdhaṁ bandhūnāṁ piyakr̥d bhava,
1.135.18: ye lokāstān hataḥ karṇa mayā tvaṁ pratipatsyase ॥18॥
1.135.20: guroḥ samakṣaṁ yāvat te harāmyadya śiraḥ śaraiḥ ॥20॥
1.135.22: pariṣvaktaḥ sthitaḥ karṇaḥ pragr̥hya saśaraṁ dhanuḥ ॥22॥
1.135.33: tato viditvā pārthastvāṁ pratiyotsyati vā na vā,
1.135.39: uvāca kauravaṁ rājan vacanaṁ sa vr̥ṣastadā,
asya rājyapradānasya sadr̥śaṁ kiṁ dadāni te ॥39॥
1.135.40: prabrūhi rājaśārdūla kartā hyasmi tathā nr̥pa,
1.135.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi karṇābhiṣeke pañcatriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥135॥
1.136.6: na tvamarhasi pārthena sūtaputra raṇe vadham,
1.136.10: vr̥kodara na yuktaṁ te vacanaṁ vaktumīdr̥śam ॥10॥
1.136.11: śūrāṇāṁ ca nadīnāṁ ca durvidāḥ prabhavāḥ kila ॥11॥
1.136.14: kṣatriyebhyaśca ye jātā brāhmaṇāste ca te śrutāḥ,
1.136.16: bhavatāṁ ca yathā janma tadapyāgamitaṁ mayā,
1.136.18: yasya vā manujasyedaṁ na kṣāntaṁ madviceṣṭitam,
1.136.21: bhīṣmeṇa sahitāḥ sarve yayuḥ svaṁ svaṁ niveśanam ॥21॥
1.136.22: arjuneti janaḥ kaścit kaścit karṇeti bhārata,
1.136.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi astradarśane ṣaṭtriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥136॥
1.137.3: paryānayata bhadraṁ vaḥ sā syāt paramadakṣiṇā ॥3॥
1.137.4: tathetyuktvā tu te sarve rathaistūrṇaṁ prahāriṇaḥ,
1.137.7: ete cānye ca bahavaḥ kumārā bahuvikramāḥ,
1.137.9: tasmin kāle tu pāñcālaḥ śrutvā dr̥ṣṭvā mahad balam,
1.137.10: śaravarṣāṇi muñcantaḥ praṇeduḥ sarva eva te ॥10॥
1.137.11: tato rathena śubhreṇa samāsādya tu kauravān,
yajñasenaḥ śarān ghorān vavarṣa yudhi durjayaḥ ॥11॥
1.137.17: drupadasya śarā ghorā viceruḥ sarvato diśam,
1.137.21: duryodhanaṁ vikarṇaṁ ca karṇaṁ cāpi mahābalam ॥21॥
1.137.25: dravanti sma nadanti sma krośantaḥ pāṇḍavān prati,
1.137.32: te gajā girisaṅkāśāḥ kṣaranto rudhiraṁ bahu,
1.137.34: gopāla iva daṇḍena yathā paśugaṇān vane ॥34॥
1.137.41d1: na diśo nāntarikṣaṁ ca tadā naiva ca medinī,
1.137.50: sāśvaṁ sasūtaṁ sarathaṁ pārthaṁ vivyādha satvaraḥ ॥50॥
1.137.51: sa taṁ na mamr̥ṣe pārthaḥ pāñcālenārdito yudhi,
1.137.52: sa tathā bhidyamāneṣu kārmukeṣu punaḥ punaḥ ॥52॥
1.137.54: tadā cakre mahad yuddhamarjuno jayatāṁ varaḥ ॥54॥
1.137.55: pañcabhistasya vivyādha hayān sūtaṁ ca sāyakaiḥ ॥55॥
1.137.64: sa vairaṁ manasā dhyātvā droṇo drupadamabravīt ॥64॥
1.137.65: vimr̥dya tarasā rāṣṭraṁ puraṁ te mr̥ditaṁ mayā,
1.137.66: mā bhaiḥ prāṇabhayād vīra kṣamiṇo brāhmaṇā vayam ॥66॥
1.137.67: āśrame krīḍitaṁ yat tu tvayā bālye mayā saha,
1.137.69: arājā kila no rājñaḥ sakhā bhavitumarhasi,
ataḥ prayatitaṁ rājye yajñasena mayā tava ॥69॥
1.137.70: sakhāyaṁ māṁ vijānīhi pāñcāla yadi manyase ॥70॥
1.137.72: evamuktaḥ sa taṁ droṇo mokṣayāmāsa bhārata,
1.137.75: kṣātreṇa ca balenāsya nāpaśyat sa parājayam,
hīnaṁ viditvā cātmānaṁ brāhmeṇa sa balena tu ॥75॥
1.137.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi drupadaśāsane saptatriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥137॥
1.138.7: lāghave sauṣṭhave caiva nānyaḥ kaścana vidyate ॥7॥
1.138.9: agastyasya dhanurvede śiṣyo mama guruḥ purā,
1.138.11: astraṁ brahmaśiro nāma yad dahet pr̥thivīmapi,
dadatā guruṇā coktaṁ na manuṣyeṣvidaṁ tvayā ॥11॥
1.138.12: tvayā prāptamidaṁ vīra divyaṁ nānyo’rhati tvidam ॥12॥
1.138.16: arjunasya samo loke nāsti kaścid dhanurdharaḥ ॥16॥
1.138.21: na śaśāka vaśe kartuṁ yaṁ pāṇḍurapi vīryavān,
1.138.22: atīva balasampannaḥ sadā mānī kurūn prati,
vipulo nāma sauvīraḥ śastaḥ pārthena dhīmatā ॥22॥
1.139.3: kaṇika tvaṁ mamācakṣva kariṣye vacanaṁ tava ॥3॥
1.139.11: āpadyāpadi kāle ca kurvīta na vicārayet,
1.139.14: dayā na tasmin kartavyā śaraṇāgata ityuta,
1.139.15: hanyāt trīn pañca sapteti parapakṣasya sarvaśaḥ ॥15॥
1.139.19: lokān viśvāsayitvaiva tato lumped yathā vr̥kaḥ ॥19॥
1.139.20: ānāmya phalitāṁ śākhāṁ pakvaṁ pakvaṁ praśātayet ॥20॥
1.139.22: amitro na vimoktavyaḥ kr̥paṇaṁ bahvapi bruvan ॥22॥
