1.139.23: hanyādamitraṁ sāntvena tathā dānena vā punaḥ ॥23॥
1.139.24: kathaṁ sāntvena dānena bhedairdaṇḍena vā punaḥ ॥24॥
1.139.25: amitraḥ śakyate hantuṁ tanme brūhi yathātatham,
śr̥ṇu rājan yathāvr̥ttaṁ vane nivasataḥ purā ॥25॥
1.139.28: asakr̥d yatito hyeṣa hantuṁ vyāghra vane tvayā ॥28॥
1.139.29: yuvā vai javasampanno buddhiśālī na śakyate,
1.139.30: yathainaṁ bhakṣitaiḥ pādairvyāghro gr̥hṇātu vai tataḥ,
1.139.31: jambukasya tu tad vākyaṁ tathā cakruḥ samāhitāḥ,
1.139.33: śr̥gālavacanāt te’pi gatāḥ sarve nadīṁ tataḥ,
sa cintāparamo bhūtvā tasthau tatraiva jambukaḥ ॥33॥
1.139.34: athājagāma pūrvaṁ tu snātvā vyāghro mahābalaḥ,
1.139.35: kiṁ śocasi mahāprājña tvaṁ no buddhimatāṁ varaḥ,
1.139.36: śr̥ṇu me tvaṁ mahābāho yad vākyaṁ mūṣiko’bravīt,
dhig balaṁ mr̥garājasya mayādyāyaṁ mr̥go hataḥ ॥36॥
1.139.38: bravīti yadi sa hyevaṁ kāle hyasmin prabodhitaḥ,
1.139.39: khādiṣye tatra māṁsāni ityuktvā prasthito vanam,
1.139.40: śr̥ṇu mūṣika bhadraṁ te nakulo yadihābravīt ॥40॥
1.139.42: tacchrutvā mūṣiko vākyaṁ santrastaḥ pragato bilam,
tataḥ snātvā sa vai tatra ājagāma vr̥ko nr̥pa ॥42॥
1.139.43: mr̥garājo hi saṅkruddho na te sādhu bhaviṣyati ॥43॥
1.139.47: mama dattvā niyuddhaṁ tvaṁ bhuṅkṣva māṁsaṁ yathepsitam,
1.139.48: nirjitā yat tvayā vīrāstasmād vīrataro bhavān,
1.139.49: khādati sma tadā māṁsamekaḥ san mantraniścayāt ॥49॥
1.139.51: evaṁ te kathitaṁ rājañśr̥ṇu cāpyaparaṁ tathā ॥51॥
1.139.52: putraḥ sakhā vā bhrātā vā pitā vā yadi vā guruḥ,
1.139.56: prahr̥tya ca kr̥pāyīta śoceta ca rudeta ca ॥56॥
1.139.57: athāsya praharet kāle yadā vicalite pathi ॥57॥
1.139.58: sa hi pracchādyate doṣaḥ śailo meghairivāsitaiḥ ॥58॥
1.139.59: adhanān nāstikāṁścaurān viṣaye sve na vāsayet ॥59॥
1.139.63: cāraḥ suvihitaḥ kārya ātmanaśca parasya vā,
1.139.65: catvareṣu ca kūpeṣu parvateṣu vaneṣu ca,
1.139.66: vācā bhr̥śaṁ vinītaḥ syād hr̥dayena tathā kṣuraḥ,
1.139.68: āmaḥ syāt pakvasaṅkāśo na ca jīryeta karhicit ॥68॥
1.139.70: dharmaṁ vicarataḥ pīḍā sāpi dvābhyāṁ niyacchati,
1.139.72: karmaṇā yena kenaiva mr̥dunā dāruṇena ca,
1.139.75: sa vr̥kṣāgre yathā suptaḥ patitaḥ pratibudhyate ॥75॥
1.139.84: anāgataṁ hi budhyeta yacca kāryaṁ puraḥ sthitam,
1.139.85: naiḥśreyasau tu tau jñeyau deśakālāviti sthitiḥ ॥85॥
1.139.88: āśāṁ kālavatīṁ kuryāt kālaṁ vighnena yojayet,
1.139.89: kṣuro bhūtvā haret prāṇān niśitaḥ kālasādhanaḥ,
1.139.90: vartamāno na majjestvaṁ tathā kr̥tyaṁ samācara ॥90॥
1.139.92: paścāttāpo yathā na syāt tathā nītirvidhīyatām ॥92॥
1.139.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi sambhavaparvaṇi kaṇikavākye ekonacatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥139॥
1.140.3: ākāreṇa ca taṁ mantraṁ bubudhe duṣṭacetasām ॥3॥
1.140.4: palāyane matiṁ cakre kuntyāḥ putraiḥ sahānaghaḥ ॥4॥
1.140.7: nauryayā mr̥tyupāśāt tvaṁ saputrā mokṣyase śubhe ॥7॥
1.140.8: tacchrutvā vyathitā kuntī putraiḥ saha yaśasvinī,
1.140.10: niṣādī pañcaputrā tu jātuṣe tatra veśmani,
1.140.11: sa ca mlecchādhamaḥ pāpo dagdhastatra purocanaḥ,
1.140.15: sakāmo bhava kauravya bhuṅkṣva rājyaṁ saputrakaḥ,
1.140.16: pretakāryāṇi ca tathā cakāra saha bāndhavaiḥ,
1.140.19: śr̥ṇu vistaraśo rājan vadato me parantapa,
1.140.24: rājyaprāptiṁ ca samprāptaṁ jyeṣṭhaṁ pāṇḍusutaṁ tadā,
kathayanti sma sambhūya catvareṣu sabhāsu ca ॥24॥
1.140.25: rājyaṁ na prāptavān pūrvaṁ sa kathaṁ nr̥patirbhavet ॥25॥
1.140.26: pratyākhyāya purā rājyaṁ na sa jātu grahīṣyati ॥26॥
1.140.28: sa hi bhīṣmaṁ śāntanavaṁ dhr̥tarāṣṭraṁ ca dharmavit,
1.140.29: teṣāṁ duryodhanaḥ śrutvā tāni vākyāni jalpatām,
1.140.30: sa tapyamāno duṣṭātmā teṣāṁ vāco na cakṣame,
1.140.31: tato virahitaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā pitaraṁ pratipūjya saḥ,
1.140.32: śrutā me jalpatāṁ tāta paurāṇāmaśivā giraḥ,
1.140.33: matametacca bhīṣmasya na sa rājyaṁ bubhukṣati,
asmākaṁ tu parāṁ pīḍāṁ cikīrṣanti pure janāḥ ॥33॥
1.140.35: sa eṣa pāṇḍordāyādyaṁ yadi prāpnoti pāṇḍavaḥ,
tasya putro dhruvaṁ prāptastasya tasyāpi cāparaḥ ॥35॥
1.140.36: te vayaṁ rājavaṁśena hīnāḥ saha sutairapi,
1.140.38: yadi tvaṁ hi purā rājannidaṁ rājyamavāptavān,
dhruvaṁ prāpsyāma ca vayaṁ rājyamapyavaśe jane ॥38॥
1.140.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi jatugr̥haparvaṇi duryodhanerṣyāyāṁ catvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥140॥
1.141.1: kaṇikasya ca vākyāni tāni śrutvā sa sarvaśaḥ ॥1॥
1.141.4: pāṇḍavebhyo bhayaṁ na syāt tān vivāsayatāṁ bhavān,
1.141.6: sarveṣu jñātiṣu tathā mayi tvāsīd viśeṣataḥ ॥6॥
1.141.7: nivedayati nityaṁ hi mama rājyaṁ dhr̥tavrataḥ ॥7॥
1.141.10: bhr̥tā hi pāṇḍunāmātyā balaṁ ca satataṁ bhr̥tam,
1.141.11: te purā satkr̥tāstāta pāṇḍunā nāgarā janāḥ,
kathaṁ yudhiṣṭhirasyārthe na no hanyuḥ sabāndhavān ॥11॥
1.141.15: yadā pratiṣṭhitaṁ rājyaṁ mayi rājan bhaviṣyati,
1.141.17: na ca bhīṣmo na ca droṇo na ca kṣattā na gautamaḥ,
1.141.18: samā hi kauraveyāṇāṁ vayaṁ te caiva putraka,
1.141.19: kathaṁ na vadhyatāṁ tāta gacchāma jagatastathā ॥19॥
1.141.20: madhyasthaḥ satataṁ bhīṣmo droṇaputro mayi sthitaḥ,
yataḥ putrastato droṇo bhavitā nātra saṁśayaḥ ॥20॥
1.141.21: kr̥paḥ śāradvataścaiva yata etau tato bhavet,
droṇaṁ ca bhāgineyaṁ ca na sa tyakṣyati karhicit ॥21॥
1.141.23: sa visrabdhaḥ pāṇḍuputrān saha mātrā pravāsaya,
1.141.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi jatugr̥haparvaṇi duryodhanaparāmarśe ekacatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥141॥
1.142.1: tato duryodhano rājā sarvāḥ prakr̥tayaḥ śanaiḥ,
1.142.6d1: astrāṇi ca tathā droṇād gautamācca viśeṣataḥ.
1.142.6d2: rakṣaṇe vyavahāre ca rājyasya satataṁ hite.
1.142.7: mamaite puruṣā nityaṁ kathayanti punaḥ punaḥ,
1.142.12: tato bhīṣmaṁ śāntanavaṁ viduraṁ ca mahāmatim,
droṇaṁ ca bāhlikaṁ caiva somadattaṁ ca kauravam ॥12॥
1.142.18: svastyastu vaḥ pathi sadā bhūtebhyaścaiva sarvaśaḥ,
mā ca vo’stvaśubhaṁ kiñcit sarvaśaḥ pāṇḍunandanāḥ ॥18॥
1.142.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi jatugr̥haparvaṇi vāraṇāvatayātrāyāṁ dvicatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥142॥
1.143.3: yatheyaṁ mama tadvat te sa tāṁ rakṣitumarhasi ॥3॥
1.143.4: sahāyo yena sandhāya mantrayeyaṁ yathā tvayā ॥4॥
1.143.5: saṁrakṣa tāta mantraṁ ca sapatnāṁśca mamoddhara,
1.143.10: mr̥ttikāṁ miśrayitvā tvaṁ lepaṁ kuḍyeṣu dāpaya ॥10॥
1.143.11: śaṇaṁ tailaṁ ghr̥taṁ caiva jatu dārūṇi caiva hi,
1.143.12: yathā ca tanna paśyeran parīkṣanto’pi pāṇḍavāḥ,
1.143.13: veśmanyevaṁ kr̥te tatra gatvā tān paramārcitān,
1.143.14: āsanāni ca divyāni yānāni śayanāni ca,
vidhātavyāni pāṇḍūnāṁ yathā tuṣyeta vai pitā ॥14॥
1.143.15: yathā ca tanna jānanti nagare vāraṇāvate,
tathā sarvaṁ vidhātavyaṁ yāvat kālasya paryayaḥ ॥15॥
1.143.17: dahyamāne svake gehe dagdhā iti tato janāḥ,
1.143.19: sa gatvā tvaritaṁ rājan duryodhanamate sthitaḥ,
1.143.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi jatugr̥haparvaṇi purocanopadeśe tricatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥143॥
1.144.2: anyeṣāṁ caiva vr̥ddhānāṁ kr̥pasya vidurasya ca ॥2॥
1.144.6: tatra kecid bruvanti sma brāhmaṇā nirbhayāstadā,
1.144.7: viṣamaṁ paśyate rājā sarvathā sa sumandadhīḥ,
kauravyo dhr̥tarāṣṭrastu na ca dharmaṁ prapaśyati ॥7॥
1.144.8: bhīmo vā balināṁ śreṣṭhaḥ kaunteyo vā dhanañjayaḥ ॥8॥
1.144.9: tān rājyaṁ pitr̥taḥ prāptān dhr̥tarāṣṭro na mr̥ṣyate ॥9॥
1.144.12: sa tasmin puruṣavyāghre devabhāvaṁ gate sati,
1.144.13: gr̥hān vihāya gacchāmo yatra gantā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥13॥
1.144.15: pitā mānyo guruḥ śreṣṭho yadāha pr̥thivīpatiḥ,
1.144.17: tadā kariṣyathāsmākaṁ priyāṇi ca hitāni ca ॥17॥
1.144.22: yo vetti na tu taṁ ghnanti pratighātavidaṁ dviṣaḥ ॥22॥
1.144.23: na dahediti cātmānaṁ yo rakṣati sa jīvati ॥23॥
1.144.29: nivr̥tte vidure cāpi bhīṣme paurajane tathā,
1.144.30: tvayā ca sa tathetyukto jānīmo na ca tad vayam ॥30॥
1.144.31: śrotumicchāmi tat sarvaṁ saṁvādaṁ tava tasya ca ॥31॥
1.144.32: panthāśca vo nāviditaḥ kaścit syāditi dharmadhīḥ ॥32॥
1.144.33: vijñātamiti tat sarvaṁ pratyukto viduro mayā ॥33॥
1.144.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi jatugr̥haparvaṇi vāraṇāvatagamane catuścatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥144॥
1.145.6: te praviśya purīṁ vīrāstūrṇaṁ jagmuratho gr̥hān,
1.145.9: tebhyo bhakṣyāṇi pānāni śayanāni śubhāni ca,
āsanāni ca mukhyāni pradadau sa purocanaḥ ॥9॥
1.145.17: tathā hi vartate mandaḥ suyodhanavaśe sthitaḥ,
1.145.18: āpadaṁ tena māṁ pārtha sa sambodhitavān purā,
1.145.20: tathaiva sādhu gacchāmo yatra pūrvoṣitā vayam ॥20॥
1.145.23: tathā hi vartate mandaḥ suyodhanavaśe sthitaḥ ॥23॥
1.145.24: kopaṁ kuryāt kimarthaṁ vā kauravān kopayīta saḥ ॥24॥
1.145.25: dharma ityeva kupyeran ye cānye kurupuṅgavāḥ ॥25॥
1.145.26: vayaṁ tu yadi dāhasya bibhyataḥ pradravemahi,
1.145.28: tadasmābhirimaṁ pāpaṁ taṁ ca pāpaṁ suyodhanam,
1.145.29: tathā no viditā mārgā bhaviṣyanti palāyatām ॥29॥
1.145.31: pauro vāpi janaḥ kaścit tathā kāryamatandritaiḥ ॥31॥
1.145.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi jatugr̥haparvaṇi bhīmasenayudhiṣṭhirasaṁvāde pañcacatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥145॥
1.146.1: vidurasya suhr̥t kaścit khanakaḥ kuśalo naraḥ,
1.146.2: pāṇḍavānāṁ priyaṁ kāryamiti kiṁ karavāṇi vaḥ ॥2॥
1.146.7: abhijānāmi saumya tvāṁ suhr̥daṁ vidurasya vai ॥7॥
1.146.8: śucimāptaṁ priyaṁ caiva sadā ca dr̥ḍhabhaktikam,
1.146.9: yathā tasya tathā nastvaṁ nirviśeṣā vayaṁ tvayi,
bhavataśca yathā tasya pālayāsmān yathā kaviḥ ॥9॥
1.146.12: asmāsviha hi dagdheṣu sakāmaḥ syāt suyodhanaḥ ॥12॥
1.146.14: idaṁ tadaśubhaṁ nūnaṁ tasya karma cikīrṣitam,
1.146.18: sa tasya tu gr̥hadvāri vasatyaśubhadhīḥ sadā,
tatra te sāyudhāḥ sarve vasanti sma kṣapāṁ nr̥pa ॥18॥
1.146.19: divā caranti mr̥gayāṁ pāṇḍaveyā vanād vanam,
1.146.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi jatugr̥haparvaṇi jatugr̥havāse ṣaṭcatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥146॥
1.147.6: tā vihr̥tya yathākāmaṁ bhuktvā pītvā ca bhārata,
1.147.7: niṣādī pañcaputrā tu tasmin bhojye yadr̥cchayā,
1.147.8: sā pītvā madirāṁ mattā saputrā madavihvalā,
1.147.9: atha pravāte tumule niśi supte jane tadā ॥9॥
1.147.11: jñātvā tu tad gr̥haṁ sarvamādīptaṁ pāṇḍunandanāḥ ॥11॥
1.147.13: prādurāsīt tadā tena bubudhe sa janavrajaḥ,
1.147.17: evaṁ te vilapanti sma vāraṇāvatakā janāḥ,
parivārya gr̥haṁ tacca tasthū rātrau samantataḥ ॥17॥
1.147.18: pāṇḍavāścāpi te sarve saha mātrā suduḥkhitāḥ,
1.147.19: na śekuḥ sahasā gantuṁ saha mātrā parantapāḥ ॥19॥
1.147.22: urasā pādapān bhañjan mahīṁ padbhyāṁ vidārayan,
1.147.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi jatugr̥haparvaṇi jatugr̥hadāhe saptacatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥147॥
1.148.1: viduraḥ preṣayāmāsa tad vanaṁ puruṣaṁ śucim ॥1॥
1.148.2: sa gatvā tu yathoddeśaṁ pāṇḍavān dadr̥śe vane,
1.148.7: na hantītyevamātmānaṁ yo rakṣati sa jīvati ॥7॥
1.148.8: tena māṁ preṣitaṁ viddhi viśvastaṁ sañjñayānayā,
1.148.9: karṇaṁ duryodhanaṁ caiva bhrātr̥bhiḥ sahitaṁ raṇe,
śakuniṁ caiva kaunteya vijetāsi na saṁśayaḥ ॥9॥
1.148.11: atha tān vyathitān dr̥ṣṭvā saha mātrā narottamān,
1.148.13: ityuktvā sa tu tān vīrān pumān viduracoditaḥ,
1.148.14: tārayitvā tato gaṅgāṁ pāraṁ prāptāṁśca sarvaśaḥ,
1.148.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi jatugr̥haparvaṇi gaṅgottaraṇe aṣṭacatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥148॥
1.149.2: jātuṣaṁ tad gr̥haṁ dagdhamamātyaṁ ca purocanam ॥2॥
1.149.8: khanakena tu tenaiva veśma śodhayatā bilam,
1.149.11: adya pāṇḍurmr̥to rājā mama bhrātā mahāyaśāḥ,
teṣu vīreṣu dagdheṣu mātrā saha viśeṣataḥ ॥11॥
1.149.12: satkārayantu tān vīrān kuntirājasutāṁ ca tām ॥12॥
1.149.13: kārayantu ca kulyāni śubhāni ca br̥hanti ca,
ye ca tatra mr̥tāsteṣāṁ suhr̥do yāntu tānapi ॥13॥
1.149.14: evaṁ gate mayā śakyaṁ yad yat kārayituṁ hitam,
pāṇḍavānāṁ ca kuntyāśca tat sarvaṁ kriyatāṁ dhanaiḥ ॥14॥
1.149.15d1: sametāstu tataḥ sarve bhīṣmeṇa saha kauravāḥ,
1.149.16: hā yudhiṣṭhira kauravya hā bhīma iti cāpare ॥16॥
1.149.17: hā phālguneti cāpyanye hā yamāviti cāpare,
1.149.18: vidurastvalpaśaścakre śokaṁ veda paraṁ hi saḥ ॥18॥
1.149.18d1: saha mātreti tacchrutvā vilalāpa ruroda ca.
1.149.18d2: parāsutvaṁ na paśyāmi pr̥thāyāḥ saha pāṇḍavaiḥ.
1.149.18d3: sarvathā vikr̥taṁ nītaṁ yadi te nidhanaṁ gatāḥ,
1.149.18d5: ātmānamupamāṁ kr̥tvā pareṣāṁ vartate tu yaḥ,
saha mātrā tu kauravyaḥ kathaṁ kālavaśaṁ gataḥ.
1.149.18d7: kālena sa hi sambhagno dhik kr̥tāntamanarthakam.
1.149.18d8: putragr̥dhnutayā kuntī na bhartāraṁ mr̥tā tvanu.
1.149.18d9: alpakālaṁ kule jātā bhartuḥ prītimavāpa yā,
1.149.18d10: mr̥to bhīma iti śrutvā mano na śraddadhāti me.
1.149.18d11: anindyāni ca yo gacchan kṣiprahasto dr̥ḍhāyudhaḥ,
1.149.18d13: khyāpitaṁ yena śūreṇa triṣu lokeṣu pauruṣam.
1.149.18d16: tasya vikranditaṁ śrutvā udakaṁ ca prasiñcataḥ,
1.149.18d17: mā śocīstvaṁ naravyāghra jahi śokaṁ mahāvrata,
na teṣāṁ vidyate pāpaṁ prāptakālaṁ kr̥taṁ mayā,
etacca tebhya udakaṁ viprasiñca na bhārata.
1.149.18d19: kathaṁ te tāta jīvanti pāṇḍoḥ putrā mahārathāḥ,
1.149.18d20: kathaṁ matpramukhāḥ sarve pramuktā mahato bhayāt,
1.149.18d24: tataḥ khanakamāhūya suraṅgāṁ vai bile tadā,
1.149.18d25: niṣkrāmitā mayā pūrvaṁ mā sma śoke manaḥ kr̥thāḥ,
nirgatāḥ pāṇḍavā rājan mātrā saha parantapāḥ.
1.149.18d26: mā sma śokamimaṁ kārṣīrjīvantyeva ca pāṇḍavāḥ.
1.149.18d28: tasmin yudhiṣṭhiraṁ kāle dakṣyanti bhuvi bhūmipāḥ,
1.149.23: itaḥ kaṣṭataraṁ kiṁ nu yad vayaṁ gahane vane,
diśaśca na vijānīmo gantuṁ caiva na śaknumaḥ ॥23॥
1.149.24: taṁ ca pāpaṁ na jānīmo yadi dagdhaḥ purocanaḥ,
1.149.25: tvaṁ hi no balavāneko yathā satatagastathā ॥25॥
1.149.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi jatugr̥haparvaṇi pāṇḍavavanapraveśe ekonapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥149॥
1.150.4: sa roṣita iva kruddho vane bhañjan mahādrumān,
1.150.7: avahat sa tu pr̥ṣṭhena rodhastu viṣameṣu ca ॥7॥
1.150.11: te śrameṇa ca kauravyāstr̥ṣṇayā ca prapīḍitāḥ,
1.150.12: nyaviśanta hi te sarve nirāsvāde mahāvane,
1.150.13: mātā satī pāṇḍavānāṁ pañcānāṁ madhyataḥ sthitā,
1.150.15: tato bhīmo vanaṁ ghoraṁ praviśya vijanaṁ mahat,
1.150.18: anujñātaḥ sa gaccheti bhrātrā jyeṣṭhena bhārata,
jagāma tatra yatra sma sārasā jalacāriṇaḥ ॥18॥
1.150.19: sa tatra pītvā pānīyaṁ snātvā ca bharatarṣabha,
1.150.21: sa suptāṁ mātaraṁ dr̥ṣṭvā bhrātr̥̄ṁśca vasudhātale,
1.150.22: ataḥ kaṣṭataraṁ kiṁ nu draṣṭavyaṁ hi bhaviṣyati,
1.150.28: kiṁ nu duḥkhataraṁ śakyaṁ mayā draṣṭumataḥ param,
1.150.29: triṣu lokeṣu yo rājyaṁ dharmanityo’rhate nr̥paḥ,
so’yaṁ bhūmau pariśrāntaḥ śete prākr̥tavat katham ॥29॥
1.150.30: śete prākr̥tavad bhūmau tato duḥkhataraṁ nu kim ॥30॥
1.150.32: sa jīveta sukhaṁ loke grāmadruma ivaikajaḥ ॥32॥
1.150.33: eko vr̥kṣo hi yo grāme bhavet parṇaphalānvitaḥ,
1.150.34: yeṣāṁ ca bahavaḥ śūrā jñātayo dharmamāśritāḥ,
te jīvanti sukhaṁ loke bhavanti ca nirāmayāḥ ॥34॥
1.150.38: nūnaṁ devāḥ prasannāste nānujñāṁ me yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥38॥
1.150.39: prayacchati vadhe tubhyaṁ tena jīvasi durmate,
1.150.40: kiṁ nu śakyaṁ mayā kartuṁ yat te na krudhyate nr̥paḥ ॥40॥
1.150.45: iti bhīmo vyavasyaiva jajāgāra svayaṁ tadā ॥45॥
1.150.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi jatugr̥haparvaṇi bhīmajalāharaṇe pañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥150॥
1.151.1: tatra teṣu śayāneṣu hiḍimbo nāma rākṣasaḥ,
1.151.6: ūrdhvāṅguliḥ sa kaṇḍūyan dhunvan rūkṣān śiroruhān,
1.151.8: snehasravān prasravati jihvā paryeti me sukham ॥8॥
1.151.10: uṣṇaṁ navaṁ prapāsyāmi phenilaṁ rudhiraṁ bahu ॥10॥
1.151.11: gaccha jānīhi ke tvete śerate vanamāśritāḥ,
mānuṣo balavān gandho ghrāṇaṁ tarpayatīva me ॥11॥
1.151.13: bhakṣayiṣyāva sahitau kuru tūrṇaṁ vaco mama ॥13॥
1.151.15: evamuktā hiḍimbā tu hiḍimbena tadā vane,
1.151.16: jagāma tatra yatra sma pāṇḍavā bharatarṣabha,
dadarśa tatra sā gatvā pāṇḍavān pr̥thayā saha,
1.151.23: ka ime śerate ceha puruṣā devarūpiṇaḥ ॥23॥
1.151.24: keyaṁ vai br̥hatī śyāmā sukumārī tavānagha,
śete vanamidaṁ prāpya viśvastā svagr̥he yathā ॥24॥
1.151.25: vasati hyatra pāpātmā hiḍimbo nāma rākṣasaḥ ॥25॥
1.151.28: etad vijñāya dharmajña yuktaṁ mayi samācara,
1.151.29d1: icchāmi vīra bhadraṁ te mā mā prāṇā vihāsiṣuḥ,
1.151.30: atulāmāpnuhi prītiṁ tatra tatra mayā saha ॥30॥
1.151.30d1: eṣa jyeṣṭho mama bhrātā mānyaḥ paramako guruḥ,
1.151.31: mātaraṁ bhrātaraṁ jyeṣṭhaṁ sukhasuptān kathaṁ tvimān,
1.151.32: ko hi suptānimān bhrātr̥̄n dattvā rākṣasabhojanam,
mātaraṁ ca naro gacchet kāmārta iva madvidhaḥ ॥32॥
1.151.33: yat te priyaṁ tat kariṣye sarvānetān prabodhaya,
1.151.34: sukhasuptān vane bhrātr̥̄n mātaraṁ caiva rākṣasi,
1.151.35: na hi me rākṣasā bhīru soḍhuṁ śaktāḥ parākramam,
na manuṣyā na gandharvā na yakṣāścārulocane ॥35॥
1.151.36: gaccha vā tiṣṭha vā bhadre yad vāpīcchasi tat kuru,
taṁ vā preṣaya tanvaṅgi bhrātaraṁ puruṣādakam ॥36॥
1.151.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi hiḍimbavadhaparvaṇi bhīmahiḍimbāsaṁvāde ekapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥151॥
1.152.4: sāhaṁ tvāṁ bhrātr̥bhiḥ sārdhaṁ yad bravīmi tathā kuru ॥4॥
1.152.5: āruhemāṁ mama śroṇiṁ neṣyāmi tvāṁ vihāyasā ॥5॥
1.152.7: mā bhaistvaṁ pr̥thusuśroṇi naiṣa kaścinmayi sthite,
1.152.10: vikramaṁ me yathendrasya sādya drakṣyasi śobhane,
1.152.12: vācaḥ śuśrāva tāḥ kruddho rākṣasaḥ puruṣādakaḥ ॥12॥
1.152.15: tāṁ tathā mānuṣaṁ rūpaṁ bibhratīṁ sumanoharam,
1.152.17: ko hi me bhoktukāmasya vighnaṁ carati durmatiḥ,
na bibheṣi hiḍimbe kiṁ matkopād vipramohitā ॥17॥
1.152.19: eṣa tānadya vai sarvān haniṣyāmi tvayā saha ॥19॥
1.152.23: kiṁ te hiḍimba etairvā sukhasuptaiḥ prabodhitaiḥ,
1.152.24: mayyeva praharehi tvaṁ na striyaṁ hantumarhasi,
1.152.25: na hīyaṁ svavaśā bālā kāmayatyadya māmiha,
1.152.26: bhaginī tava durvr̥tta rakṣasāṁ vai yaśohara,
tvanniyogena caiveyaṁ rūpaṁ mama samīkṣya ca ॥26॥
1.152.28: mayi tiṣṭhati duṣṭātman na striyaṁ hantumarhasi,
1.152.30: adya gātrāṇi te kaṅkāḥ śyenā gomāyavastathā,
karṣantu bhuvi saṁhr̥ṣṭā nihatasya mayā mr̥dhe ॥30॥
1.152.31: purā yad dūṣitaṁ nityaṁ tvayā bhakṣayatā narān ॥31॥
1.152.32: adya tvāṁ bhaginī rakṣaḥ kr̥ṣyamāṇaṁ mayāsakr̥t,
1.152.34: garjitena vr̥thā kiṁ te katthitena ca mānuṣa,
kr̥tvaitat karmaṇā sarvaṁ katthethā mā ciraṁ kr̥thāḥ ॥34॥
1.152.40: nigr̥hya taṁ balād bhīmo visphurantaṁ cakarṣa ha,
tasmād deśād dhanūṁṣyaṣṭau siṁhaḥ kṣudramr̥gaṁ yathā ॥40॥
1.152.41: tataḥ sa rākṣasaḥ kruddhaḥ pāṇḍavena balārditaḥ,
1.152.42: mā śabdaḥ sukhasuptānāṁ bhrātr̥̄ṇāṁ me bhavediti ॥42॥
1.152.44d4: tataḥ śabdena mahatā garjantau tau parasparam.
1.152.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi hiḍimbavadhaparvaṇi hiḍimbayuddhe dvipañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥152॥
1.153.3: kasya tvaṁ suragarbhābhe kā vāsi varavarṇinī,
1.153.4: yadi vāsya vanasya tvaṁ devatā yadi vāpsarāḥ,
ācakṣva mama tat sarvaṁ kimarthaṁ ceha tiṣṭhasi ॥4॥
1.153.6: tasya māṁ rākṣasendrasya bhaginīṁ viddhi bhāvini,
1.153.9: tato vr̥to mayā bhartā tava putro mahābalaḥ,
apanetuṁ ca yatito na caiva śakito mayā ॥9॥
1.153.10: cirāyamāṇāṁ māṁ jñātvā tataḥ sa puruṣādakaḥ,
1.153.11: sa tena mama kāntena tava putreṇa dhīmatā,
1.153.17: rākṣasena tadā bhīmaṁ kliśyamānaṁ nirīkṣya ca,
1.153.18: bhīma mā bhairmahābāho na tvāṁ budhyāmahe vayam,
1.153.22: purā saṁrajyate prācī purā sandhyā pravartate,
1.153.23: tvarasva bhīma mā krīḍa jahi rakṣo bibhīṣaṇam,
1.153.28: yadi vā manyase bhāraṁ tvamimaṁ rākṣasaṁ yudhi,
1.153.31: sa māryamāṇo bhīmena nanāda vipulaṁ svanam,
pūrayaṁstad vanaṁ sarvaṁ jalārdra iva dundubhiḥ ॥31॥
1.153.35: na dūraṁ nagaraṁ manye vanādasmādahaṁ vibho,
śīghraṁ gacchāma bhadraṁ te na no vidyāt suyodhanaḥ ॥35॥
1.153.36: tataḥ sarve tathetyuktvā saha mātrā mahārathāḥ,
1.153.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi hiḍimbavadhaparvaṇi hiḍimbavadhe tripañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥153॥
1.154.0d1: sā tānevāpatat tūrṇaṁ bhaginī tasya rakṣasaḥ,
abruvāṇā hiḍimbā tu rākṣasī pāṇḍavān prati.
1.154.0d2: abhivādya tataḥ kuntīṁ dharmarājaṁ ca pāṇḍavam,
1.154.0d3: ahaṁ te darśanādeva manmathasya vaśaṁ gatā,
1.154.2: kruddho’pi puruṣavyāghra bhīma mā sma striyaṁ vadhīḥ,
1.154.3: rakṣasastasya bhaginī kiṁ naḥ kruddhā kariṣyati ॥3॥
1.154.6: soḍhaṁ tat paramaṁ duḥkhaṁ mayā kālapratīkṣayā,
1.154.7: mayā hyutsr̥jya suhr̥daḥ svadharmaṁ svajanaṁ tathā,
1.154.8: pratyākhyātā na jīvāmi satyametad bravīmi te ॥8॥
1.154.9: tadarhasi kr̥pāṁ kartuṁ mayi tvaṁ varavarṇini,
matvā mūḍheti tanmā tvaṁ bhaktā vānugateti vā ॥9॥
1.154.11: ahaṁ hi manasā dhyātā sarvān neṣyāmi vaḥ sadā,
1.154.11d1: na yātudhānyahaṁ tvārye na cāsmi rajanīcarī,
1.154.12: yūyaṁ prasādaṁ kuruta bhīmaseno bhajeta mām ॥12॥
1.154.13: āpadastaraṇe prāṇān dhārayed yena tena vā,
1.154.15: yena yenācared dharmaṁ tasmin garhā na vidyate ॥15॥
1.154.15d1: mahato’tra striyaṁ kāmād bādhitāṁ trāhi māmapi,
1.154.15d3: tasmād vakṣyāmi vaḥ śreya āsannaṁ sara uttamam,
adyāsādya saraḥ snātvā viśramya ca vanaspatau.
1.154.15d5: trāṇaṁ ca vidurāt tubhyaṁ viditaṁ jñānacakṣuṣā.
1.154.15d6: āvāse śālihotrasya sa ca vāsaṁ vidhāsyati,
1.154.15d8: kādambāḥ sārasā haṁsāḥ kuraryaḥ kuraraiḥ saha,
1.154.15d10: tvaṁ hi dharmabhr̥tāṁ śreṣṭha mayoktaṁ śr̥ṇu bhārata,
rākṣasyeṣā hi vākyena dharmaṁ vadati sādhu vai.
1.154.15d11: bhāvena duṣṭā bhīmaṁ sā kiṁ kariṣyati rākṣasī,
1.154.16: evametad yathā’’ttha tvaṁ hiḍimbe nātra saṁśayaḥ,
sthātavyaṁ tu tvayā satye yathā brūyāṁ sumadhyame ॥16॥
1.154.18d1: evaṁ ramasva bhīmena yāvad garbhasya vedanam.
1.154.18d5: tat tatheti pratijñāya hiḍimbā rākṣasī tadā,
1.154.18d6: pāṇḍavānāṁ ca vāsaṁ sā kr̥tvā parṇamayaṁ tathā,
ātmanaśca tathā kuntyā ekoddeśe cakāra sā.
1.154.18d7: pāṇḍavāstu tataḥ snātvā śuddhāḥ sandhyāmupāsya ca,
1.154.18d8: tataste pāṇḍavāḥ sarve viśrāntāḥ pr̥thayā saha.
1.154.18d9: yathā jatugr̥he vr̥ttaṁ rākṣasena kr̥taṁ ca yat,
1.154.18d12: tasmāt pāṇḍuhitārthaṁ me yuvarāja hitaṁ kuru,
1.154.18d15: yudhiṣṭhiraṁ ca māṁ caiva varayāmāsa dharmataḥ.
1.154.18d16: dharmārthaṁ dehi putraṁ tvaṁ sa naḥ śreyaḥ kariṣyati,
prativākyaṁ tu necchāmi hyāvābhyāṁ vacanaṁ kuru.
1.154.19: śr̥ṇu rākṣasi satyena samayaṁ te vadāmyaham ॥19॥
1.154.20: tāvat kālaṁ gamiṣyāmi tvayā saha sumadhyame ॥20॥
1.154.21: tatheti tat pratijñāya hiḍimbā rākṣasī tadā,
1.154.30: ramayantī tathā bhīmaṁ tatra tatra manojavā ॥30॥
1.154.36: sadyo hi garbhān rākṣasyo labhante prasavanti ca,
1.154.38: ghaṭo hāsyotkaca iti mātā taṁ pratyabhāṣata,
abravīt tena nāmāsya ghaṭotkaca iti sma ha ॥38॥
1.154.39: teṣāṁ ca dayito nityamātmanityo babhūva ha ॥39॥
1.154.40: hiḍimbā samayaṁ kr̥tvā svāṁ gatiṁ pratyapadyata ॥40॥
1.154.43: tvaṁ kurūṇāṁ kule jātaḥ sākṣād bhīmasamo hyasi,
jyeṣṭhaḥ putro’si pañcānāṁ sāhāyyaṁ kuru putraka ॥43॥
1.154.44: yathā hi rāvaṇo loke indrajicca mahābalaḥ,
1.154.45: āmantrya rakṣasāṁ śreṣṭhaḥ pratasthe cottarāṁ diśam ॥45॥
1.154.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi hiḍimbavadhaparvaṇi ghaṭotkacotpattau catuṣpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥154॥
1.155.1: te vanena vanaṁ gatvā ghnanto mr̥gagaṇān bahūn,
1.155.6: tasthuḥ prāñjalayaḥ sarve saha mātrā parantapāḥ ॥6॥
1.155.8: na viṣādo’tra kartavyaḥ sarvametat sukhāya vaḥ ॥8॥
1.155.9: samāste caiva me sarve yūyaṁ caiva na saṁśayaḥ,
1.155.11: evaṁ sa tān samāśvāsya vyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ,
1.155.14: putrāstava ca mādryāśca sarva eva mahārathāḥ,
1.155.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi hiḍimbavadhaparvaṇi ekacakrāpraveśe vyāsadarśane pañcapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥155॥
1.156.4: cerurbhaikṣaṁ tadā te tu sarva eva viśāmpate,
1.156.4d4: mātā ciragatān dr̥ṣṭvā śocantīti ca pāṇḍavāḥ,
1.156.5: nivedayanti sma tadā kuntyā bhaikṣaṁ sadā niśi,
tayā vibhaktān bhāgāṁste bhuñjate sma pr̥thak pr̥thak ॥5॥
1.156.6: ardhaṁ te bhuñjate vīrāḥ saha mātrā parantapāḥ,
ardhaṁ sarvasya bhaikṣasya bhīmo bhuṅkte mahābalaḥ ॥6॥
1.156.7: tathā tu teṣāṁ vasatāṁ tasmin rāṣṭre mahātmanām,
1.156.10: kāruṇyāt sādhubhāvācca kuntī rājan na cakṣame ॥10॥
1.156.13: sā cintaye sadā putra brāhmaṇasyāsya kiṁ nvaham,
priyaṁ kuryāmiti gr̥he yat kuryuruṣitāḥ sukham ॥13॥
1.156.14: etāvān puruṣastāta kr̥taṁ yasmin na naśyati,
1.156.17: evaṁ tau kathayantau ca bhūyaḥ śuśruvatuḥ svanam,
1.156.19: tatastaṁ brāhmaṇaṁ tatra bhāryayā ca sutena ca,
1.156.21: jīvite paramaṁ duḥkhaṁ jīvite paramo jvaraḥ,
1.156.22: ātmā hyeko hi dharmārthau kāmaṁ caiva niṣevate,
1.156.23: āhuḥ kecit paraṁ mokṣaṁ sa ca nāsti kathañcana,
1.156.25: na hi yogaṁ prapaśyāmi yena mucyeyamāpadaḥ,
1.156.26: yatitaṁ vai mayā pūrvaṁ vettha brāhmaṇi tat tathā,
kṣemaṁ yatastato gantuṁ tvayā tu mama na śrutam ॥26॥
1.156.27: iha jātā vivr̥ddhāsmi pitā cāpi mameti vai,
1.156.28: svargato’pi pitā vr̥ddhastathā mātā ciraṁ tava,
bāndhavā bhūtapūrvāśca tatra vāse tu kā ratiḥ ॥28॥
1.156.29: so’yaṁ te bandhukāmāyā aśr̥ṇvatyā vaco mama,
1.156.30: athavā madvināśo’yaṁ na hi śakṣyāmi kañcana,
1.156.32: pitrā mātrā ca vihitāṁ sadā gārhasthyabhāginīm,
1.156.34: kuta eva parityaktuṁ sutaṁ śakṣyāmyahaṁ svayam ॥34॥
1.156.38: yasyāṁ lokāḥ prasūtiśca sthitā nityamatho sukham,
1.156.39: tyaktā hyete mayā vyaktaṁ neha śakṣyanti jīvitum ॥39॥
1.156.40: ātmatyāge kr̥te ceme mariṣyanti mayā vinā ॥40॥
1.156.41: aho dhik kāṁ gatiṁ tvadya gamiṣyāmi sabāndhavaḥ,
sarvaiḥ saha mr̥taṁ śreyo na ca me jīvitaṁ kṣamam ॥41॥
1.156.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi bakavadhaparvaṇi brāhmaṇacintāyāṁ ṣaṭpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥156॥
1.157.1: na hi santāpakālo’yaṁ vaidyasya tava vidyate ॥1॥
1.157.3: vyathāṁ jahi subuddhyā tvaṁ svayaṁ yāsyāmi tatra ca ॥3॥
1.157.4: etaddhi paramaṁ nāryāḥ kāryaṁ loke sanātanam,
1.157.5: tacca tatra kr̥taṁ karma tavāpīdaṁ sukhāvaham,
1.157.6: eṣa caiva gururdharmo yaṁ pravakṣyāmyahaṁ tava,
1.157.8: samarthaḥ poṣaṇe cāsi sutayo rakṣaṇe tathā,
na tvahaṁ sutayoḥ śaktā tathā rakṣaṇapoṣaṇe ॥8॥
1.157.9: kathaṁ syātāṁ sutau bālau bhareyaṁ ca kathaṁ tvaham ॥9॥
1.157.10: kathaṁ hi vidhavānāthā bālaputrā vinā tvayā,
1.157.12: prārthayanti janāḥ sarve patihīnāṁ tathā striyam ॥12॥
1.157.13: sthātuṁ pathi na śakṣyāmi sajjaneṣṭe dvijottama ॥13॥
1.157.15: anāthe sarvato lupte yathā tvaṁ dharmadarśivān ॥15॥
1.157.16: imāmapi ca te bālāmanāthāṁ paribhūya mām,
1.157.20: tau ca hīnau mayā bālau tvayā caiva tathā’’tmajau,
1.157.21: tvayā vihīnaṁ tasmāt tvaṁ māṁ parityaktumarhasi ॥21॥
1.157.22: vyuṣṭireṣā parā strīṇāṁ pūrvaṁ bhartuḥ parāṁ gatim,
1.157.22d1: mitaṁ dadāti hi pitā mitaṁ mātā mitaṁ sutaḥ,
amitasya hi dātāraṁ kā patiṁ nābhinandati.
1.157.25: iṣṭaṁ caiva hitaṁ caiva tava caiva kulasya ca ॥25॥
1.157.27: āpadarthe dhanaṁ rakṣed dārān rakṣed dhanairapi,
1.157.28: dr̥ṣṭādr̥ṣṭaphalārthaṁ hi bhāryā putro dhanaṁ gr̥ham,
1.157.29: ekato vā kulaṁ kr̥tsnamātmā vā kulavardhanaḥ,
1.157.31: dharmajñān rākṣasānāhurna hanyāt sa ca māmapi ॥31॥
1.157.32: nissaṁśayaṁ vadhaḥ puṁsāṁ strīṇāṁ saṁśayito vadhaḥ,
1.157.33: tvat prasūtiḥ priyā prāptā na māṁ tapsyatyajīvitam ॥33॥
1.157.34: jātaputrā ca vr̥ddhā ca priyakāmā ca te sadā,
1.157.37: etat sarvaṁ samīkṣya tvamātmatyāgaṁ ca garhitam,
ātmānaṁ tārayādyāśu kulaṁ cemau ca dārakau ॥37॥
1.157.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi bakavadhaparvaṇi brāhmaṇīvākye saptapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥157॥
1.158.2: mamāpi śrūyatāṁ vākyaṁ śrutvā ca kriyatāṁ kṣamam ॥2॥
1.158.3: tyaktavyāṁ māṁ parityajya trāhi sarvaṁ mayaikayā ॥3॥
1.158.5: iha vā tārayed durgāduta vā pretya bhārata,
sarvathā tārayet putraḥ putra ityucyate budhaiḥ ॥5॥
1.158.6: ākāṅkṣante ca dauhitrān mayi nityaṁ pitāmahāḥ,
tat svayaṁ vai paritrāsye rakṣantī jīvitaṁ pituḥ ॥6॥
1.158.7: bhrātā ca mama bālo’yaṁ gate lokamamuṁ tvayi,
1.158.8: tāte’pi hi gate svargaṁ vinaṣṭe ca mamānuje,
piṇḍaḥ pitr̥̄ṇāṁ vyucchidyet tat teṣāṁ vipriyaṁ bhavet ॥8॥
1.158.9: pitrā tyaktā tathā mātrā bhrātrā cāhamasaṁśayam,
1.158.10: tvayi tvaroge nirmukte mātā bhrātā ca me śiśuḥ,
1.158.11: ātmā putraḥ sakhā bhāryā kr̥cchraṁ tu duhitā kila,
sa kr̥cchrānmocayātmānaṁ māṁ ca dharme niyojaya ॥11॥
1.158.12: bhaviṣyāmi tvayā tāta vihīnā kr̥paṇā sadā ॥12॥
1.158.14: athavā yāsyase tatra tyaktvā māṁ dvijasattama,
1.158.15: ātmānaṁ parirakṣasva tyaktavyāṁ māṁ ca santyaja ॥15॥
1.158.16: kiṁ tvataḥ paramaṁ duḥkhaṁ yad vayaṁ svargate tvayi ॥16॥
1.158.18: itaḥ pradāne devāśca pitaraśceti na śrutam,
tvayā dattena toyena bhaviṣyanti hitāya vai ॥18॥
1.158.19: pitā mātā ca sā caiva kanyā prarurudustrayaḥ ॥19॥
1.158.21: mā pitā ruda mā mātarmā svasastviti cābravīt,
1.158.23: tathāpi teṣāṁ duḥkhena parītānāṁ niśamya tat,
1.158.24: ayaṁ kāla iti jñātvā kuntī samupasr̥tya tān,
1.158.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi bakavadhaparvaṇi brāhmaṇakanyāputravākye aṣṭapañcaśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥158॥
1.159.2: na tu duḥkhamidaṁ śakyaṁ mānuṣeṇa vyapohitum ॥2॥
1.159.3d1: tasyāṁ ghoraḥ sa vasati jighāṁsuḥ puruṣādakaḥ.
1.159.5: tatkr̥te paracakrācca bhūtebhyaśca na no bhayam ॥5॥
1.159.8: tadvimokṣāya ye kecid yatanti puruṣāḥ kvacit,
1.159.9: upāyaṁ taṁ na kurute yatnādapi sa mandadhīḥ,
1.159.10: etadarhā vayaṁ nūnaṁ vasāmo durbalasya ye,
1.159.11: guṇairete hi vatsyanti kāmagāḥ pakṣiṇo yathā ॥11॥
1.159.12: rājānaṁ prathamaṁ vindet tato bhāryāṁ tato dhanam,
1.159.15: na ca me vidyate vittaṁ saṅkretuṁ puruṣaṁ kvacit,
suhr̥jjanaṁ pradātuṁ ca na śakṣyāmi kadācana ॥15॥
1.159.16: gatiṁ caiva na paśyāmi tasmānmokṣāya rakṣasaḥ,
1.159.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi bakavadhaparvaṇi kuntīpraśne ekonaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥159॥
1.160.2: ekastava suto bālaḥ kanyā caikā tapasvinī,
na caitayostathā patnyā gamanaṁ tava rocaye ॥2॥
1.160.8: paraiḥ kr̥te vadhe pāpaṁ na kiñcinmayi vidyate ॥8॥
1.160.9: niṣkr̥tiṁ na prapaśyāmi nr̥śaṁsaṁ kṣudrameva ca ॥9॥
1.160.10: yācamānasya ca vadho nr̥śaṁso garhito budhaiḥ ॥10॥
1.160.11: kuryānna ninditaṁ karma na nr̥śaṁsaṁ kathañcana,
1.160.13: mamāpyeṣā matirbrahman viprā rakṣyā iti sthirā,
na cāpyaniṣṭaḥ putro me yadi putraśataṁ bhavet ॥13॥
1.160.14: na cāsau rākṣasaḥ śakto mama putravināśane,
vīryavān mantrasiddhaśca tejasvī ca suto mama ॥14॥
1.160.15: rākṣasāya ca tat sarvaṁ prāpayiṣyati bhojanam,
1.160.17: na tvidaṁ keṣucid brahman vyāhartavyaṁ kathañcana,
vidyārthino hi me putrān viprakuryuḥ kutūhalāt ॥17॥
1.160.18: guruṇā cānanujñāto grāhayed yat suto mama,
na sa kuryāt tathā kāryaṁ vidyayeti satāṁ matam ॥18॥
1.160.19: evamuktastu pr̥thayā sa vipro bhāryayā saha,
1.160.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi bakavadhaparvaṇi bhīmabakavadhāṅgīkāre ṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥160॥
1.161.4: brāhmaṇārthe mahat kr̥tyaṁ mokṣāya nagarasya ca ॥4॥
1.161.5: kimidaṁ sāhasaṁ tīkṣṇaṁ bhavatyā duṣkaraṁ kr̥tam,
parityāgaṁ hi putrasya na praśaṁsanti sādhavaḥ ॥5॥
1.161.7: yasya bāhū samāśritya sukhaṁ sarve śayāmahe,
1.161.8: na śete rajanīḥ sarvā duḥkhācchakuninā saha ॥8॥
1.161.9: yasya vīrasya vīryeṇa muktā jatugr̥hād vayam,
1.161.12: na cāyaṁ buddhidaurbalyād vyavasāyaḥ kr̥to mayā ॥12॥
1.161.13: iha viprasya bhavane vayaṁ putra sukhoṣitāḥ,
1.161.14: etāvāneva puruṣaḥ kr̥taṁ yasmin na naśyati ॥14॥
1.161.15: dr̥ṣṭvā bhīmasya vikrāntaṁ tadā jatugr̥he mahat,
1.161.18: jātamātraḥ purā caiva mamāṅkāt patito girau,
1.161.19: tadahaṁ prajñayā jñātvā balaṁ bhīmasya pāṇḍava,
pratikārye ca viprasya tataḥ kr̥tavatī matim ॥19॥
1.161.20: nedaṁ lobhānna cājñānānna ca mohād viniścitam,
buddhipūrvaṁ tu dharmasya vyavasāyaḥ kr̥to mayā ॥20॥
1.161.24: vaiśyasyārthe ca sāhāyyaṁ kurvāṇaḥ kṣatriyo bhuvi,
sa sarveṣvapi lokeṣu prajā rañjayate dhruvam ॥24॥
1.161.26: evaṁ māṁ bhagavān vyāsaḥ purā pauravanandana,
1.161.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi bakavadhaparvaṇi kuntīyudhiṣṭhirasaṁvāde ekaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥161॥
1.162.3d1: kuntī praviśya tān sarvān sāntvayāmāsa bhārata.
1.162.5: āsādya tu vanaṁ tasya rakṣasaḥ pāṇḍavo balī,
1.162.6: tataḥ sa rākṣasaḥ kruddho bhīmasya vacanāt tadā,
1.162.9: bhuñjānamannaṁ taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā bhīmasenaṁ sa rākṣasaḥ,
1.162.12: ravaṁ sa bhairavaṁ kr̥tvā samudyamya karāvubhau,
1.162.16: tataḥ sa bhūyaḥ saṅkruddho vr̥kṣamādāya rākṣasaḥ,
1.162.18: kṣiptaṁ kruddhena taṁ vr̥kṣaṁ pratijagrāha vīryavān,
1.162.19: tataḥ sa punarudyamya vr̥kṣān bahuvidhān balī,
1.162.21: nāma viśrāvya tu bakaḥ samabhidrutya pāṇḍavam,
1.162.25: hīyamānaṁ tu tad rakṣaḥ samīkṣya puruṣādakam,
1.162.27: savyena ca kaṭīdeśe gr̥hya vāsasi pāṇḍavaḥ,
tad rakṣo dviguṇaṁ cakre ruvantaṁ bhairavaṁ ravam ॥27॥
1.162.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi bakavadhaparvaṇi bakabhīmasenayuddhe dviṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥162॥
1.163.1: tataḥ sa bhagnapārśvāṅgo naditvā bhairavaṁ ravam,
1.163.3: tān bhītān vigatajñānān bhīmaḥ praharatāṁ varaḥ,
1.163.4: na hiṁsyā mānuṣā bhūyo yuṣmābhiriti karhicit,
1.163.5: tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā tāni rakṣāṁsi bhārata,
evamastviti taṁ prāhurjagr̥huḥ samayaṁ ca tam ॥5॥
1.163.6: tataḥ prabhr̥ti rakṣāṁsi tatra saumyāni bhārata,
1.163.9: tataḥ sa bhīmastaṁ hatvā gatvā brāhmaṇaveśma tat,
1.163.10: tato narā viniṣkrāntā nagarāt kalyameva tu,
1.163.12: ekacakrāṁ tato gatvā pravr̥ttiṁ pradaduḥ pure,
1.163.14: jñātvā cāgamya taṁ vipraṁ papracchuḥ sarva eva te ॥14॥
1.163.15: evaṁ pr̥ṣṭaḥ sa bahuśo rakṣamāṇaśca pāṇḍavān,
1.163.17: paripr̥cchya sa māṁ pūrvaṁ parikleśaṁ purasya ca,
1.163.18: mannimittaṁ bhayaṁ cāpi na kāryamiti cābravīt ॥18॥
1.163.19: tena nūnaṁ bhavedetat karma lokahitaṁ kr̥tam ॥19॥
1.163.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi bakavadhaparvaṇi bakavadhe triṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥163॥
1.164.1: ata ūrdhvaṁ tato brahman kimakurvata pāṇḍavāḥ ॥1॥
1.164.3: pratiśrayārthī tad veśma brāhmaṇasya jagāma ha ॥3॥
1.164.4: sa samyak pūjayitvā taṁ vipraṁ viprarṣabhastadā,
1.164.5: tataste pāṇḍavāḥ sarve saha kuntyā nararṣabhāḥ,
1.164.11: kathaṁ vipra sakhāyau tau bhinnau kasya kr̥tena vā ॥11॥
1.164.12: evaṁ taiścodito rājan sa vipraḥ puruṣarṣabhaiḥ,
1.164.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi caitrarathaparvaṇi draupadīsambhave catuḥṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥164॥
1.165.5: adhyagīṣṭa sa vedāṁśca vedāṅgāni ca sarvaśaḥ ॥5॥
1.165.6: bharadvājasya tu sakhā pr̥ṣato nāma pārthivaḥ,
tasyāpi drupado nāma tadā samabhavat sutaḥ ॥6॥
1.165.7: sa nityamāśramaṁ gatvā droṇena saha pārṣataḥ,
1.165.8: droṇo’pi rāmaṁ śuśrāva ditsantaṁ vasu sarvaśaḥ ॥8॥
1.165.9: āgataṁ vittakāmaṁ māṁ viddhi droṇaṁ dvijottama ॥9॥
1.165.10: astrāṇi vā śarīraṁ vā brahmannekatamaṁ vr̥ṇu ॥10॥
1.165.11: astrāṇi caiva sarvāṇi teṣāṁ saṁhārameva ca,
prayogaṁ caiva sarveṣāṁ dātumarhati me bhavān ॥11॥
1.165.16: sa viniścitya manasā pāñcālyaṁ prati buddhimān,
1.165.17: tasmai pautrān samādāya vasūni vividhāni ca,
prāptāya pradadau bhīṣmaḥ śiṣyān droṇāya dhīmate ॥17॥
1.165.19: ācāryavetanaṁ kiñcid hr̥di yad vartate mama,
1.165.20: yadā ca pāṇḍavāḥ sarve kr̥tāstrāḥ kr̥taniścayāḥ,
1.165.21: tasmādākr̥ṣya tad rājyaṁ mama śīghraṁ pradīyatām ॥21॥
1.165.22: tataḥ pāṇḍusutāḥ pañca nirjitya drupadaṁ yudhi,
1.165.22d1: mahendra iva durdharṣo mahendra iva dānavam,
1.165.23: arājā kila no rājñaḥ sakhā bhavitumarhati ॥23॥
1.165.24: ataḥ prayatitaṁ rājye yajñasena tvayā saha,
1.165.26: evaṁ bhavatu bhadraṁ te bhāradvāja mahāmate,
1.165.28: asatkāraḥ sa tu mahān muhūrtamapi tasya tu,
nāpaiti hr̥dayād rājño durmanāḥ sa kr̥śo’bhavat ॥28॥
1.165.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi caitrarathaparvaṇi draupadīsambhave pañcaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥165॥
1.166.3: jātān putrān sa nirvedād dhig bandhūniti cābravīt,
1.166.4: prabhāvaṁ vinayaṁ śikṣāṁ droṇasya caritāni ca,
1.166.11: yena me karmaṇā brahman putraḥ syād droṇamr̥tyave ॥11॥
1.166.12: upayāja kr̥te tasmin gavāṁ dātāsmi te’rbudam,
yad vā te’nyad dvijaśreṣṭha manasaḥ supriyaṁ bhavet,
sarvaṁ tat te pradātāhaṁ na hi me’trāsti saṁśayaḥ ॥12॥
1.166.13: ārādhayiṣyan drupadaḥ sa taṁ paryacarat punaḥ ॥13॥
1.166.15: jyeṣṭho bhrātā mamāgr̥hṇād vicaran gahane vane,
1.166.17: vivinakti na śaucaṁ yaḥ so’nyatrāpi kathaṁ bhavet ॥17॥
1.166.18: saṁhitādhyayanaṁ kurvan vasan gurukule ca yaḥ,
bhaikṣyamutsr̥ṣṭamanyeṣāṁ bhuṅkte sma ca yadā tadā ॥18॥
1.166.19: taṁ vai phalārthinaṁ manye bhrātaraṁ tarkacakṣuṣā ॥19॥
1.166.20: taṁ vai gacchasva nr̥pate sa tvāṁ saṁyājayiṣyati,
1.166.22: ayutāni dadānyaṣṭau gavāṁ yājaya māṁ vibho,
1.166.23: sa hi brahmavidāṁ śreṣṭho brahmāstre cāpyanuttamaḥ,
tasmād droṇaḥ parājaiṣṭa māṁ vai sa sakhivigrahe ॥23॥
1.166.29: brahmakṣatre ca vihite brāhmaṁ tejo viśiṣyate,
so’haṁ kṣātrād balāddhīno bāhmaṁ tejaḥ prapedivān ॥29॥
1.166.31: tat karma kuru me yāja vitasamyarbudaṁ gavām,
1.166.32: yājo droṇavināśāya pratijajñe tathā ca saḥ ॥32॥
1.166.33: ācakhyau karma vaitānaṁ tadā putraphalāya vai ॥33॥
1.166.34: sa ca putro mahāvīryo mahātejā mahābalaḥ,
iṣyate yadvidho rājan bhavitā te tathāvidhaḥ ॥34॥
1.166.35: ājahre tat tathā sarvaṁ drupadaḥ karmasiddhaye ॥35॥
1.166.36: prehi māṁ rājñi pr̥ṣati mithunaṁ tvāmupasthitam ॥36॥
1.166.37: avaliptaṁ mukhaṁ brahman divyān gandhān bibharmi ca,
sutārthe nopalabdhāsmi tiṣṭha yāja mama priye ॥37॥
1.166.38: kathaṁ kāmaṁ na sandadhyāt sā tvaṁ viprehi tiṣṭha vā ॥38॥
1.166.39: evamuktvā tu yājena hute haviṣi saṁskr̥te,
1.166.40: bibhrat sakhaḍgaḥ saśaro dhanuṣmān vinadan muhuḥ ॥40॥
1.166.41: so’dhyārohad rathavaraṁ tena ca prayayau tadā,
tataḥ praṇeduḥ pañjālāḥ prahr̥ṣṭhāḥ sādhu sādhviti ॥41॥
1.166.43: rājñaḥ śokāpaho jāta eṣa droṇavadhāya vai,
1.166.47: yā bibharti paraṁ rūpaṁ yasyā nāstyupamā bhuvi,
1.166.51: tau dr̥ṣṭvā pārṣatī yājaṁ prapede vai sutārthinī,
1.166.54: kr̥ṣṇetyevābruvan kr̥ṣṇāṁ kr̥ṣṇābhūt sā hi varṇataḥ,
1.166.56: amokṣaṇīyaṁ daivaṁ hi bhāvi matvā mahāmatiḥ,
1.166.56d4: tasmin gr̥he suviśvastān pāṇḍavān pr̥thayā saha,
1.166.56d5: agninā tu svayamapi dagdhaḥ kṣudro nr̥śaṁsakr̥t,
1.166.56d11: etatkāryasya kartā tu na dr̥ṣṭo śrutaḥ purā,
etad vr̥ttaṁ mahārāja pāṇḍavān prati naḥ śrutam.
1.166.56d12: śrutvā tu vacanaṁ teṣāṁ yajñaseno mahāmatiḥ,
1.166.56d14: aho rūpamaho dhairyamaho vīryaṁ ca śikṣitam,
1.166.56d17: lokastad veda yaccaiva tathā yājena vai śrutam.
1.166.56d19: kiṁ kariṣyāmi te naṣṭāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ pr̥thayā saha,
1.166.56d21: tādr̥śā na vinaśyanti naiva yānti parābhavam.
1.166.56d22: brāhmaṇaiḥ kathitaṁ satyaṁ vedeṣu ca mayā śrutam.
1.166.56d24: yatra vā tatra jīvanti pāṇḍavāste na saṁśayaḥ.
1.166.56d27: yatra vā nivasantaste pāṇḍavāḥ pr̥thayā saha,
dūrasthā vā samīpasthāḥ svargasthā vāpi pāṇḍavāḥ.
1.166.56d28: śrutvā svayaṁvaraṁ rājan sameṣyanti na saṁśayaḥ,
tasmāt svayaṁvaro rājan ghuṣyatāṁ mā ciraṁ kr̥thāḥ.
1.166.56d30: puṣyamāse tu rohiṇyāṁ śuklapakṣe śubhe tithau,
1.166.56d32: yadr̥cchayā tu pāñcālī gacched vā madhyamaṁ patim.
1.166.56d33: ko hi jānāti lokeṣu prajāpatividhiṁ param,
tasmāt saputrā gacchethā brāhmaṇyai yadi rocate.
1.166.56d37: ahaṁ ca tatra gacchāmi mamaibhiḥ saha śiṣyakaiḥ,
ekasārthāḥ prayātāḥ smo brāhmaṇyai yadi rocate.
1.166.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi caitrarathaparvaṇi draupadīsambhave ṣaṭṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥166॥
1.167.5: punardraṣṭuṁ hi tānīha prīṇayanti na nastathā,
bhaikṣaṁ ca na tathā vīra labhyate kurunandana ॥5॥
1.167.6: te vayaṁ sādhu pañcālān gacchāma yadi manyase,
1.167.8: ekatra ciravāsaśca kṣamo na ca mato mama,
te tatra sādhu gacchāmo yadi tvaṁ putra manyase ॥8॥
1.167.9: bhavatyā yanmataṁ kāryaṁ tadasmākaṁ paraṁ hitam,
anujāṁstu na jānāmi gaccheyurneti vā punaḥ ॥9॥
1.167.11: tata āmantrya taṁ vipraṁ kuntī rājan sutaiḥ saha,
1.167.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi caitrarathaparvaṇi pañcāladeśayātrāyāṁ saptaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥167॥
1.168.4: api dharmeṇa vartedhvaṁ śāstreṇa ca parantapāḥ,
api vipreṣu pūjā vaḥ pūjārheṣu na hīyate ॥4॥
1.168.7: karmabhiḥ svakr̥taiḥ sā tu durbhagā samapadyata,
nādhyagacchat patiṁ sā tu kanyā rūpavatī satī ॥7॥
1.168.9: varaṁ varaya bhadraṁ te varado’smīti śaṅkaraḥ ॥9॥
1.168.11: pañca te patayo bhadre bhaviṣyantīti bhāratāḥ ॥11॥
1.168.14: drupadasya kule jajñe sā kanyā devarūpiṇī ॥14॥
1.168.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi caitrarathaparvaṇi draupadījanmāntarakathane aṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥168॥
1.169.4: prakāśārthaṁ yayau tatra rakṣārthaṁ ca mahārathaḥ ॥4॥
1.169.5: tatra gaṅgājale ramye vivikte krīḍayan striyaḥ,
1.169.6: śabdaṁ teṣāṁ sa śuśrāva nadīṁ samupasarpatām,
1.169.7: sa dr̥ṣṭvā pāṇḍavāṁstatra saha mātrā parantapān,
1.169.10: lobhāt pracāraṁ caratastāsu velāsu vai narān,
1.169.11: ato rātrau prāpnuvanto jalaṁ brahmavido janāḥ,
1.169.13: ahaṁ hi mānī cerṣyuśca kuberasya priyaḥ sakhā ॥13॥
1.169.15: na kauṇapāḥ śr̥ṅgiṇo vā na devā na ca mānuṣāḥ,
1.169.17: na kālaniyamo hyasti gaṅgāṁ prāpya saridvarām ॥17॥
1.169.18: aśaktā hi raṇe krūra yuṣmānarcanti mānavāḥ ॥18॥
1.169.20: gaṅgāṁ ca yamunāṁ caiva plakṣajātāṁ sarasvatīm,
rathasthāṁ sarayūṁ caiva gomatīṁ gaṇḍakīṁ tathā ॥20॥
1.169.23: kathamicchasi tāṁ roddhuṁ naiṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥23॥
1.169.28: tasmādastreṇa divyena yotsye’haṁ na tu māyayā ॥28॥
1.169.31: ityuktvā pāṇḍavaḥ kruddho gandharvāya mumoca ha,
1.169.32: virathaṁ viplutaṁ taṁ tu sa gandharvaṁ mahābalaḥ,
1.169.35: trāyasva māṁ mahābhāga patiṁ cemaṁ vimuñca me,
gandharvī śaraṇaṁ prāptā nāmnā kumbhīnasī prabho ॥35॥
1.169.36: ko nihanyād ripuṁ tāta muñcemaṁ ripusūdana ॥36॥
1.169.37: jīvitaṁ pratipadyasva gaccha gandharva mā śucaḥ,
1.169.38: na ca ślāghe balenāṅga na nāmnā janasaṁsadi ॥38॥
1.169.40: astrāgninā vicitro’yaṁ dagdho me ratha uttamaḥ,
1.169.41: sambhr̥tā caiva vidyeyaṁ tapaseha mayā purā,
1.169.42: yo ripuṁ yojayet prāṇaiḥ kalyāṇaṁ kiṁ na so’rhati ॥42॥
1.169.43: cākṣuṣī nāma vidyeyaṁ yāṁ somāya dadau manuḥ,
1.169.44: āgamo’syā mayā prokto vīryaṁ pratinibodha me ॥44॥
1.169.45: tat paśyed yādr̥śaṁ cecchet tādr̥śaṁ draṣṭumarhati ॥45॥
1.169.47: vidyayā hyanayā rājan vayaṁ nr̥bhyo viśeṣitāḥ,
1.169.48: bhrātr̥bhyastava tubhyaṁ ca pr̥thagdātā śataṁ śatam ॥48॥
1.169.49: kṣīṇākṣīṇā bhavantyete na hīyante ca raṁhasaḥ ॥49॥
1.169.51: loke yaśo dhanaṁ kiñcit saiva vajratanuḥ smr̥tā ॥51॥
1.169.53: rathāṅgaṁ vaḍavā sūte śūrāścāśveṣu ye matāḥ ॥53॥
1.169.54: iti gandharvajāḥ kāmaṁ pūrayiṣyanti me hayāḥ ॥54॥
1.169.55: yadi prītena me dattaṁ saṁśaye jīvitasya vā,
vidyādhanaṁ śrutaṁ vāpi na tad gandharva rocaye ॥55॥
1.169.56: jīvitasya pradānena prīto vidyāṁ dadāmi te ॥56॥
1.169.58: sakhe tad brūhi gandharva yuṣmabhyo yad bhayaṁ bhavet ॥58॥
1.169.59: kāraṇaṁ brūhi gandharva kiṁ tad yena sma dharṣitāḥ,
1.169.60: yūyaṁ tato dharṣitāḥ stha mayā vai pāṇḍunandanāḥ ॥60॥
1.169.60d1: jānatā ca mayā tasmāt tejaścābhijanaṁ ca vaḥ,
iyaṁ matimatāṁ śreṣṭha dharṣituṁ vai kr̥tā matiḥ.
1.169.60d2: ko hi vastriṣu lokeṣu na veda bharatarṣabha,
1.169.62: guṇān kathayatāṁ vīra pūrveṣāṁ tava dhīmatām ॥62॥
1.169.63: imāṁ vasumatīṁ kr̥tsnāṁ prabhāvaḥ sukulasya te ॥63॥
1.169.65: dharmaṁ vāyuṁ ca śakraṁ ca vijānāmyaśvinau tathā,
1.169.67: jānannapi ca vaḥ pārtha kr̥tavāniha dharṣaṇām ॥67॥
1.169.68: strīsakāśe ca kauravya na pumān kṣantumarhati,
1.169.70: yena teneha vidhinā kīrtyamānaṁ nibodha me ॥70॥
1.169.71: brahmacaryaṁ paro dharmaḥ sa cāpi niyatastvayi,
1.169.72: yastu syāt kṣatriyaḥ kaścit kāmavr̥ttaḥ parantapa,
naktaṁ ca yudhi yudhyeta na sa jīvet kathañcana ॥72॥
1.169.76: yasya syād dharmavid vāgmī purodhāḥ śīlavān śuciḥ ॥76॥
1.169.77: lābhaṁ labdhumalabdhaṁ vā labdhaṁ vā parirakṣitum,
1.169.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi caitrarathaparvaṇi gandharvaparābhave ekonasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥169॥
1.170.2: tapatī nāma kā caiṣā tāpatyā yatkr̥te vayam,
kaunteyā hi vayaṁ sādho tattvamicchāmi veditum ॥2॥
1.170.3: viśrutāṁ triṣu lokeṣu śrāvayāmāsa vai kathām ॥3॥
1.170.5: uktavānasmi yena tvāṁ tāpatya iti yad vacaḥ,
1.170.6: ya eṣa divi dhiṣṇyena nākaṁ vyāpnoti tejasā,
etasya tapatī nāma babhūva sadr̥śī sutā ॥6॥
1.170.7: viśrutā triṣu lokeṣu tapatī tapasā yutā ॥7॥
1.170.8: na devī nāsurī caiva na yakṣī na ca rākṣasī,
nāpsarā na ca gandharvī tathā rūpeṇa kācana ॥8॥
1.170.9: svācārā caiva sādhvī ca suveṣā caiva bhāminī ॥9॥
1.170.10: na tasyāḥ sadr̥śaṁ kañcit triṣu lokeṣu bhārata,
1.170.11: samprāptayauvanāṁ paśyan deyāṁ duhitaraṁ tu tām,
1.170.15: tapatyāḥ sadr̥śaṁ mene sūryaḥ saṁvaraṇaṁ patim ॥15॥
1.170.16: dātumaicchat tataḥ kanyāṁ tasmai saṁvaraṇāya tām,
1.170.17: yathā hi divi dīptāṁśuḥ prabhāsayati tejasā,
1.170.20: tasmai dātuṁ manaścakre tapatīṁ tapanaḥ svayam ॥20॥
1.170.23: sa mr̥tāśvaścaran pārtha padbhyāmeva girau nr̥paḥ,
1.170.25: sa hi tāṁ tarkayāmāsa rūpato nr̥patiḥ śriyam,
1.170.27: giripr̥ṣṭhe tu sā yasmin sthitā svasitalocanā,
1.170.28: tasyā rūpeṇa sa girirveṣeṇa ca viśeṣataḥ,
1.170.29: avamene ca tāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā sarvalokeṣu yoṣitaḥ,
avāptaṁ cātmano mene sa rājā cakṣuṣaḥ phalam ॥29॥
1.170.30: janmaprabhr̥ti yat kiñcid dr̥ṣṭavān sa mahīpatiḥ,
1.170.31: na cacāla tato deśād bubudhe na ca kiñcana ॥31॥
1.170.34: tāṁ ca dr̥ṣṭvaiva kalyāṇīṁ kalyāṇābhijano nr̥paḥ,
1.170.36: kāsi kasyāsi rambhoru kimarthaṁ ceha tiṣṭhasi,
1.170.38: na devīṁ nāsurīṁ caiva na yakṣīṁ na ca rākṣasīm,
na ca bhogavatīṁ manye na gandharvīṁ na mānuṣīm ॥38॥
1.170.39: yā hi dr̥ṣṭā mayā kāścicchrutā vāpi varāṅganāḥ,
na tāsāṁ sadr̥śīṁ manye tvāmahaṁ mattakāśini ॥39॥
1.170.41: evaṁ tāṁ sa mahīpālo babhāṣe na tu sā tadā,
1.170.44: apaśyamānaḥ sa tu tāṁ bahu tatra vilapya ca,
1.170.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi caitrarathaparvaṇi tapatyupākhyāne saptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥170॥
1.171.8: bhajasva bhajamānaṁ māṁ prāṇā hi prajahanti mām,
tvadarthaṁ hi viśālākṣi māmayaṁ niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥8॥
1.171.11: na hyahaṁ tvadr̥te bhīru śakṣyāmi khalu jīvitum ॥11॥
1.171.13: tvaṁ hi māṁ prītiyogena trātumarhasi bhāvini ॥13॥
1.171.14: na tvāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā punaścānyāṁ draṣṭuṁ kalyāṇi rocate ॥14॥
1.171.15: prasīda vaśago’haṁ te bhaktaṁ māṁ bhaja bhāvini,
1.171.19: vivāhānāṁ hi rambhoru gāndharvaḥ śreṣṭha ucyate ॥19॥
1.171.20: mayi cedasti te prītiryācasva pitaraṁ mama ॥20॥
1.171.21: yathā hi te mayā prāṇāḥ saṅgr̥hītā nareśvara,
1.171.22: samīpaṁ nopagacchāmi na svatantrā hi yoṣitaḥ ॥22॥
1.171.23: kā hi sarveṣu lokeṣu viśrutābhijanaṁ nr̥pam,
1.171.24: tasmādevaṁ gate kāle yācasva pitaraṁ mama,
1.171.25: sa cet kāmayate dātuṁ tava māmarisūdana,
1.171.26: ahaṁ hi tapatī nāma sāvitryavarajā sutā,
1.171.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi caitrarathaparvaṇi tapatyupākhyāne ekasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥171॥
1.172.1: sa tu rājā punarbhūmau tatraiva nipapāta ha ॥1॥
1.172.3: taṁ hi dr̥ṣṭvā maheṣvāsaṁ nirastaṁ patitaṁ bhuvi ॥3॥
1.172.6: prajñayā vayasā caiva vr̥ddhaḥ kīrtyā nayena ca,
1.172.11: sa tu rājā giriprasthe tasmin punarupāviśat ॥11॥
1.172.16: tathā tu niyatātmānaṁ taṁ nr̥paṁ munisattamaḥ,
1.172.20: tat te dadyāmabhipretaṁ yadyapi syāt suduṣkaram ॥20॥
1.172.22: yaiṣā te tapatī nāma sāvitryavarajā sutā,
1.172.24: ityuktaḥ sa tadā tena dadānītyeva niścitaḥ,
1.172.25: varaḥ saṁvaraṇo rājñāṁ tvamr̥ṣīṇāṁ varo mune,
1.172.29: dr̥ṣṭvā ca devakanyāṁ tāṁ tapatīṁ cāruhāsinīm,
1.172.31: kr̥cchrād dvādaśarātre tu tasya rājñaḥ samāhite,
1.172.33: jagrāha vidhivat pāṇiṁ tapatyāḥ sa nararṣabhaḥ ॥33॥
1.172.35: tataḥ pure ca rāṣṭre ca vaneṣūpavaneṣu ca,
1.172.36: so’tha rājā girau tasmin vijahārāmaro yathā ॥36॥
1.172.37: tato dvādaśa varṣāṇi kānaneṣu vaneṣu ca,
reme tasmin girau rājā tathaiva saha bhāryayā ॥37॥
1.172.38: tasya rājñaḥ pure tasmin samā dvādaśa sattama,
na vavarṣa sahasrākṣo rāṣṭre caivāsya bhārata ॥38॥
1.172.44: tatastat tādr̥śaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā sa eva bhagavānr̥ṣiḥ,
1.172.45: tapatyā sahitaṁ rājan vyuṣitaṁ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ,
1.172.47: tataḥ sarāṣṭraṁ mumude tat puraṁ parayā mudā,
1.172.48: tapatyā sahitaḥ patnyā yathā śacyā marutpatiḥ ॥48॥
1.172.49: tava vaivasvatī pārtha tāpatyastvaṁ yayā mataḥ ॥49॥
1.172.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi caitrarathaparvaṇi tapatyupākhyānasamāptau dvisaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥172॥
1.173.1: sa gandharvavacaḥ śrutvā tat tadā bharatarṣabha,
1.173.3: etadicchāmyahaṁ śrotuṁ yathāvat tad vadasva me ॥3॥
1.173.4: ya eṣa gandharvapate pūrveṣāṁ naḥ purohitaḥ,
1.173.12: sa hi tān yājayāmāsa sarvān nr̥patisattamān,
1.173.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi caitrarathaparvaṇi purohitakaraṇakathane trisaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥173॥
1.174.1: vasatorāśrame divye śaṁsa naḥ sarvameva tat ॥1॥
1.174.2: pārtha sarveṣu lokeṣu yathāvat tannibodha me ॥2॥
1.174.5: sa cacāra sahāmātyo mr̥gayāṁ gahane vane,
1.174.9: uktā kāmān prayaccheti sā kāmān duhyate sadā ॥9॥
1.174.12: ratnāni ca mahārhāṇi vāsāṁsi vividhāni ca,
1.174.13: sāmātyaḥ sabalaścaiva tutoṣa sa bhr̥śaṁ tadā,
1.174.15: abhinandya sa tāṁ rājā nandinīṁ gādhinandanaḥ ॥15॥
1.174.16: abravīcca bhr̥śaṁ tuṣṭaḥ sa rājā tamr̥ṣiṁ tadā,
arbudena gavāṁ brahman mama rājyena vā punaḥ ॥16॥
1.174.19: arbudena gavāṁ yastvaṁ na dadāsi mamepsitam ॥19॥
1.174.20: svadharmaṁ na prahāsyāmi neṣyāmi ca balena gām,
1.174.21: yathecchasi tathā kṣipraṁ kuru mā tvaṁ vicāraya,
1.174.24: bhr̥śaṁ ca tāḍyamānā vai na jagāmāśramāt tataḥ,
śr̥ṇomi te ravaṁ bhadre vinadantyāḥ punaḥ punaḥ ॥24॥
1.174.25: hriyase tvaṁ balād bhadre viśvāmitreṇa nandini,
kiṁ kartavyaṁ mayā tatra kṣamāvān brāhmaṇo hyaham ॥25॥
1.174.28: na cukṣubhe tadā dhairyānna cacāla dhr̥tavrataḥ ॥28॥
1.174.29: kṣatriyāṇāṁ balaṁ tejo brāhmaṇānāṁ kṣamā balam,
kṣamā māṁ bhajate yasmād gamyatāṁ yadi rocate ॥29॥
1.174.30: kiṁ nu tyaktāsmi bhagavan yadevaṁ tvaṁ prabhāṣase,
atyaktāhaṁ tvayā brahman netuṁ śakyā na vai balāt ॥30॥
1.174.31: na tvāṁ tyajāmi kalyāṇi sthīyatāṁ yadi śakyate,
dr̥ḍhena dāmnā baddhvaiṣa vatsaste hriyate balāt ॥31॥
1.174.37: pauṇḍrān kirātān yavanān siṁhalān barbarān khasān ॥37॥
1.174.42: na ca prāṇairviyujyante kecit tatrāsya sainikāḥ,
1.174.43: sā gaustat sakalaṁ sainyaṁ kālayāmāsa dūrataḥ,
1.174.44d5: āgneyaṁ vāruṇaṁ caindraṁ yāmyaṁ vāyavyameva ca,
1.174.44d9: yadi te’sti paraṁ śauryaṁ tad darśaya mayi sthite.
1.174.46: balābalaṁ viniścitya tapa eva paraṁ balam,
sa rājyaṁ sphītamutsr̥jya tāṁ ca dīptāṁ nr̥paśriyam ॥46॥
1.174.47: bhogāṁśca pr̥ṣṭhataḥ kr̥tvā tapasyeva mano dadhe,
sa gatvā tapasā siddhiṁ lokān viṣṭabhya tejasā ॥47॥
1.174.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi caitrarathaparvaṇi vāsiṣṭhe viśvāmitraparābhave catuḥsaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥174॥
1.175.1: kalmāṣapāda ityevaṁ loke rājā babhūva ha,
1.175.2: sa kadācid vanaṁ rājā mr̥gayāṁ niryayau purāt,
1.175.3: hatvā ca suciraṁ śrānto rājā nivavr̥te tataḥ ॥3॥
1.175.8: mama panthā mahārāja dharma eṣa sanātanaḥ,
rājñā sarveṣu dharmeṣu deyaḥ panthā dvijātaye ॥8॥
1.175.9: evaṁ parasparaṁ tau tu patho’rthaṁ vākyamūcatuḥ,
1.175.10: nāpi rājā munermānāt krodhāccātha jagāma ha ॥10॥
1.175.17: tataḥ sa bubudhe paścāt tamr̥ṣiṁ nr̥pasattamaḥ,
1.175.19: sa tu śaptastadā tena śaktinā vai nr̥pottamaḥ,
1.175.20: tasya bhāvaṁ viditvā sa nr̥pateḥ kurusattama,
1.175.21: rākṣasaḥ kiṅkaro nāma viveśa nr̥patiṁ tadā ॥21॥
1.175.22: rakṣasā taṁ gr̥hītaṁ tu viditvā munisattamaḥ,
1.175.24: dadarśātha dvijaḥ kaścid rājānaṁ prasthitaṁ vanam,
1.175.26: ityuktvā prayayau rājā tasthau ca dvijasattamaḥ ॥26॥
1.175.38: uvāca śaktiṁ taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā na cirādiva bhārata ॥38॥
1.175.41: śaktinaṁ tu mr̥taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā viśvāmitraḥ punaḥ punaḥ,
vasiṣṭhasyaiva putreṣu tad rakṣaḥ sandideśa ha ॥41॥
1.175.44: na tveva kauśikocchedaṁ mene matimatāṁ varaḥ ॥44॥
1.175.46: na mamāra ca pātena sa yadā tena pāṇḍava,
1.175.47: taṁ tadā susamiddho’pi na dadāha hutāśanaḥ,
1.175.48: baddhvā kaṇṭhe śilāṁ gurvīṁ nipapāta tadāmbhasi ॥48॥
1.175.49: na mamāra yadā vipraḥ kathañcit saṁśitavrataḥ,
jagāma sa tataḥ khinnaḥ punarevāśramaṁ prati ॥49॥
1.175.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi caitrarathaparvaṇi vāsiṣṭhe vasiṣṭhaśoke pañcasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥175॥
1.176.2: vr̥kṣān bahuvidhān pārtha harantīṁ tīrajān bahūn ॥2॥
1.176.7: śokabuddhiṁ tadā cakre na caikatra vyatiṣṭhata,
1.176.14: purā sāṅgasya vedasya śakteriva mayā śrutaḥ ॥14॥
1.176.15: ayaṁ kukṣau samutpannaḥ śaktergarbhaḥ sutasya te,
1.176.17: tataḥ pratinivr̥ttaḥ sa tayā vadhvā sahānagha,
1.176.18: sa tu dr̥ṣṭvaiva taṁ rājā kruddha utthāya bhārata,
1.176.21: taṁ nivārayituṁ śakto nānyo’sti bhuvi kaścana,
1.176.23: mā bhaiḥ putri na bhetavyaṁ rākṣasāt tu kathañcana,
naitad rakṣo bhayaṁ yasmāt paśyasi tvamupasthitam ॥23॥
1.176.26: mantrapūtena ca punaḥ sa tamabhyukṣya vāriṇā,
1.176.27: sa hi dvādaśa varṣāṇi vāsiṣṭhasyaiva tejasā,
1.176.28: rakṣasā vipramukto’tha sa nr̥pastad vanaṁ mahat,
1.176.30: asmin kāle yadiṣṭaṁ te brūhi kiṁ karavāṇi te ॥30॥
1.176.31: vr̥ttametad yathākālaṁ gaccha rājyaṁ praśādhi vai,
1.176.35: dadānītyeva taṁ tatra rājānaṁ pratyuvāca ha,
1.176.36: tataḥ pratiyayau kāle vasiṣṭhaḥ saha tena vai,
1.176.40: sa ca tāṁ pūrayāmāsa lakṣmyā lakṣmīvatāṁ varaḥ,
1.176.44: r̥tāvatha maharṣiḥ sa sambabhūva tayā saha,
1.176.46: dīrghakālena sā garbhaṁ suṣuve na tu taṁ yadā,
1.176.47: tato’pi dvādaśe varṣe sa jajñe puruṣarṣabhaḥ,
aśmako nāma rājarṣiḥ paudanyaṁ yo nyaveśayat ॥47॥
1.176.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi caitrarathaparvaṇi vāsiṣṭhe saudāsasutotpattau ṣaṭsaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥176॥
1.177.3: parāsuḥ sa yatastena vasiṣṭhaḥ sthāpito muniḥ,
garbhasthena tato loke parāśara iti smr̥taḥ ॥3॥
1.177.4: amanyata sa dharmātmā vasiṣṭhaṁ pitaraṁ muniḥ,
1.177.7: mā tāta tāta tāteti brūhyenaṁ pitaraṁ pituḥ,
1.177.8: manyase yaṁ tu tāteti naiṣa tātastavānagha,
ārya eṣa pitā tasya pitustava yaśasvinaḥ ॥8॥
1.177.10: taṁ tathā niścitātmānaṁ sa mahātmā mahātapāḥ,
1.177.12: sa tānagrabhujastāta dhānyena ca dhanena ca ॥12॥
1.177.14: bhr̥gūṇāṁ tu dhanaṁ jñātvā rājānaḥ sarva eva te ॥14॥
1.177.15: bhūmau tu nidadhuḥ kecid bhr̥gavo dhanamakṣayam ॥15॥
1.177.16: daduḥ kecid dvijātibhyo jñātvā kṣatriyato bhayam,
bhr̥gavastu daduḥ kecit teṣāṁ vittaṁ yathepsitam ॥16॥
1.177.18: tad vittaṁ dadr̥śuḥ sarve sametāḥ kṣatriyarṣabhāḥ ॥18॥
1.177.24: atha garbhaḥ sa bhittvoruṁ brāhmaṇyā nirjagāma ha ॥24॥
1.177.25: muṣṇan dr̥ṣṭīḥ kṣatriyāṇāṁ madhyāhna iva bhāskaraḥ,
1.177.29: saputrā tvaṁ prasādaṁ naḥ kartumarhasi śobhane,
1.178.1: ayaṁ tu bhārgavo nūnamūrujaḥ kupito’dya vaḥ ॥1॥
1.178.3: garbhānapi yadā yūyaṁ bhr̥gūṇāṁ ghnata putrakāḥ,
1.178.5: so’yaṁ pitr̥vadhād vyaktaṁ krodhād vo hantumicchati,
tejasā tasya divyena cakṣūṁṣi muṣitāni vaḥ ॥5॥
1.178.6: ayaṁ vaḥ praṇipātena tuṣṭo dr̥ṣṭīḥ pramokṣyati ॥6॥
1.178.7: ūcuḥ prasīdeti tadā prasādaṁ ca cakāra saḥ ॥7॥
1.178.8: anenaiva ca vikhyāto nāmnā lokeṣu sattamaḥ,
sa aurva iti viprarṣirūruṁ bhittvā vyajāyata ॥8॥
1.178.10: sa cakre tāta lokānāṁ vināśāya mahāmanāḥ,
1.178.16: āyuṣā viprakr̥ṣṭena yadā naḥ kheda āviśat,
1.178.17: nikhātaṁ yacca vai vittaṁ kenacid bhr̥guveśmani,
1.178.18: kiṁ hi vittena naḥ kāryaṁ svargepsūnāṁ dvijottama,
1.178.19: yadā tu mr̥tyurādātuṁ na naḥ śaknoti sarvaśaḥ,
1.178.20: ātmahā ca pumāṁstāta na lokām̐llabhate śubhān,
1.178.21: na caitannaḥ priyaṁ tāta yadidaṁ kartumicchasi,
1.178.22: mā vadhīḥ kṣatriyāṁstāta na lokān sapta putraka,
1.179.1: sarvalokavināśāya na sā me vitathā bhavet ॥1॥
1.179.3: yo hi kāraṇataḥ krodhaṁ sañjātaṁ kṣantumarhati,
nālaṁ sa manujaḥ samyak trivargaṁ parirakṣitum ॥3॥
1.179.6: saṁhāro hi yadā loke bhr̥gūṇāṁ kṣatriyādhamaiḥ,
1.179.9: pratiṣeddhā hi pāpasya yadā lokeṣu vidyate,
1.179.10: yadā tu pratiṣeddhāraṁ pāpoṁ na labhate kvacit,
1.179.11: jānannapi ca yaḥ pāpaṁ śaktimān na niyacchati,
īśaḥ san so’pi tenaiva karmaṇā samprayujyate ॥11॥
1.179.16: tasmād vidhadhvaṁ yacchreyo lokānāṁ mama ceśvarāḥ ॥16॥
1.179.17: apsu taṁ muñca bhadraṁ te lokā hyapsu pratiṣṭhitāḥ ॥17॥
1.179.19: ayaṁ tiṣṭhatu te vipra yadīcchasi mahodadhau,
1.179.20: na caivaṁ sāmarā lokā gamiṣyanti parābhavam ॥20॥
1.179.22: mahaddhayaśiro bhūtvā yat tad vedavido viduḥ,
1.179.23: tasmāt tvamapi bhadraṁ te na lokān hantumarhasi,
1.180.2: īje ca sa mahātejāḥ sarvavedavidāṁ varaḥ,
1.180.3: tato vr̥ddhāṁśca bālāṁśca rākṣasān sa mahāmuniḥ,
1.180.4: na hi taṁ vārayāmāsa vasiṣṭho rakṣasāṁ vadhāt,
1.180.5: trayāṇāṁ pāvakānāṁ ca satre tasmin mahāmuniḥ,
āsīt purastād dīptānāṁ caturtha iva pāvakaḥ ॥5॥
1.180.12: prajocchedamimaṁ mahyaṁ na hi kartuṁ tvamarhasi,
1.180.13: adharmiṣṭhaṁ variṣṭhaḥ san kuruṣe tvaṁ parāśara ॥13॥
1.180.15: ātmajena sa doṣeṇa śaktirnīta ito divam ॥15॥
1.180.16: na hi taṁ rākṣasaḥ kaścicchakto bhakṣayituṁ mune,
1.180.18: ye ca śaktyavarāḥ putrā vasiṣṭhasya mahāmune,
te ca sarve mudā yuktā modante sahitāḥ suraiḥ ॥18॥
1.180.19: rakṣasāṁ ca samuccheda eṣa tāta tapasvinām ॥19॥
1.180.20: tat satraṁ muñca bhadraṁ te samāptamidamastu te ॥20॥
1.180.23: sa tatrādyāpi rakṣāṁsi vr̥kṣānaśmana eva ca,
bhakṣayan dr̥śyate vahniḥ sadā parvaṇi parvaṇi ॥23॥
1.181.1: kāraṇaṁ kiṁ puraskr̥tya bhāryā vai saṁniyojitā ॥1॥
1.181.2: jānatā vai paraṁ dharmaṁ vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā,
1.181.3: adharmiṣṭhaṁ vasiṣṭhena kr̥taṁ cāpi purā sakhe,
1.181.4: vasiṣṭhaṁ prati durdharṣa tathā mitrasahaṁ nr̥pam ॥4॥
1.181.5: kathitaṁ te mayā sarvaṁ yathā śaptaḥ sa pārthivaḥ,
1.181.12: śr̥ṇu rājan mama vaco yat tvāṁ vakṣyāmi suvrata,
1.181.17: so’gniḥ samabhavad dīptastaṁ ca deśaṁ vyadīpayat,
1.181.19: prekṣantyā bhakṣito me’dya priyo bhartā mahāyaśāḥ,
1.181.21: tena saṅgamya te bhāryā tanayaṁ janayiṣyati,
sa te vaṁśakaraḥ putro bhaviṣyati nr̥pādhama ॥21॥
1.181.22: evaṁ śaptvā tu rājānaṁ sā tamāṅgirasī śubhā,
1.181.25: na hi sasmāra sa nr̥pastaṁ śāpaṁ kāmamohitaḥ,
devyāḥ so’tha vacaḥ śrutvā sambhrānto nr̥pasattamaḥ ॥25॥
1.181.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi caitrarathaparvaṇi vasiṣṭhopākhyāne ekāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥181॥
1.182.1: asmākamanurūpo vai yaḥ syād gandharva vedavit,
1.182.2: dhaumya utkocake tīrthe taṁ vr̥ṇudhvaṁ yadīcchatha ॥2॥
1.182.6: tata utkocakaṁ tīrthaṁ gatvā dhaumyāśramaṁ tu te,
taṁ vavruḥ pāṇḍavā dhaumyaṁ paurohityāya bhārata ॥6॥
1.182.8: te samāśaṁsire labdhāṁ śriyaṁ rājyaṁ ca pāṇḍavāḥ,
brāhmaṇaṁ tai puraskr̥tya pāñcālīṁ ca svayaṁvare ॥8॥
1.182.10: tena dharmavidā pārthā yājyā dharmavidaḥ kr̥tāḥ ॥10॥
1.182.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi caitrarathaparvaṇi dhaumyapurohitakaraṇe dvyaśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥182॥
1.183.1: prayayurdraupadīṁ draṣṭuṁ taṁ ca deśaṁ mahotsavam ॥1॥
1.183.2: te prayātā naravyāghrāḥ saha mātrā parantapāḥ,
1.183.3: kva bhavanto gamiṣyanti kuto vābhyāgatā iha ॥3॥
1.183.4: bhavanto vai vijānantu saha mātrā dvijarṣabhāḥ ॥4॥
1.183.6: ekasārthaṁ prayātāḥ sma vayaṁ tatraiva gāminaḥ,
1.183.9: yo jātaḥ kavacī khaḍgī saśaraḥ saśarāsanaḥ,
1.183.10: nīlotpalasamo gandho yasyāḥ krośāt pravāti vai ॥10॥
1.183.11: gacchāmo vai vayaṁ draṣṭuṁ taṁ ca divyaṁ mahotsavam ॥11॥
1.183.14: te tatra vividhān dāyān vijayārthaṁ nareśvarāḥ,
pradāsyanti dhanaṁ gāśca bhakṣyaṁ bhojyaṁ ca sarvaśaḥ ॥14॥
1.183.15: pratigr̥hya ca tat sarvaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā caiva svayaṁvaram,
1.183.17: evaṁ kautūhalaṁ kr̥tvā dr̥ṣṭvā ca pratigr̥hya ca,
1.183.19: ayaṁ bhrātā tava śrīmān darśanīyo mahābhujaḥ,
1.183.20: paramaṁ bho gamiṣyāmo draṣṭuṁ caiva mahotsavam,
1.183.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi svayaṁvaraparvaṇi pāṇḍavāgamane tryaśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥183॥
1.184.2: dadr̥śuḥ pāṇḍavā vīrā muniṁ dvaipāyanaṁ tadā ॥2॥
1.184.3: tasmai yathāvat satkāraṁ kr̥tvā tena ca satkr̥tāḥ,
1.184.4: paśyanto ramaṇīyāni vanāni ca sarāṁsi ca,
1.184.6: te tu dr̥ṣṭvā puraṁ tacca skandhāvāraṁ ca pāṇḍavāḥ,
1.184.7: tān samprāptāṁstathā vīrāñjajñire na narāḥ kvacit ॥7॥
1.184.8: kr̥ṣṇāṁ dadyāmiti sadā na caitad vivr̥ṇoti saḥ ॥8॥
1.184.10: tena yantreṇa samitaṁ rājā lakṣyaṁ cakāra saḥ ॥10॥
1.184.11: idaṁ sajyaṁ dhanuḥ kr̥tvā sajjairebhiśca sāyakaiḥ,
atītya lakṣyaṁ yo veddhā sa labdhā matsutāmiti ॥11॥
1.184.25: priyān sarvasya lokasya sukr̥taiḥ karmabhiḥ śubhaiḥ ॥25॥
1.184.28: tataḥ samājo vavr̥dhe sa rājan divasān bahūn,
1.184.32: santarpayitvā jvalanaṁ brāhmaṇān svasti vācya ca,
1.184.33: niḥśabde tu kr̥te tasmin dhr̥ṣṭadyumno viśāmpate,
1.184.37: nāmnā ca gotreṇa ca karmaṇā ca
1.184.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi svayaṁvaraparvaṇi dhr̥ṣṭadyumnavākye caturaśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥184॥
1.185.4: ete cānye ca bahavo dhārtarāṣṭrā mahābalāḥ,
1.185.9: suketuḥ saha putreṇa sunāmnā ca suvarcasā ॥9॥
1.185.12: jalasandhaḥ pitāputrau vidaṇḍo daṇḍa eva ca,
1.185.24: vidhyeta ya idaṁ lakṣyaṁ varayethāḥ śubhe’dya tam ॥24॥
1.185.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi svayaṁvaraparvaṇi rājanāmakīrtane pañcāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥185॥
1.186.10: bhīmaṁ sajiṣṇuṁ ca yamau ca vīrau,
1.186.12: tāṁ draupadīṁ prekṣya tadā sma sarve
1.186.28d3: āropayaṁstu tad rājā dhanuṣā balinā tadā.
1.186.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi svayaṁvaraparvaṇi rājaparāṅmukhībhavane ṣaḍaśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥186॥
1.187.5: vaṭumātreṇa śakyaṁ hi sajyaṁ kartuṁ dhanurdvijāḥ ॥5॥
1.187.7: prasthito dhanurāyantuṁ vāryatāṁ sādhu mā gamat ॥7॥
1.187.8: na ca vidviṣṭatāṁ loke gamiṣyāmo mahīkṣitām ॥8॥
1.187.11: śaktirasya mahotsāhā na hyaśaktaḥ svayaṁ vrajet,
na ca tad vidyate kiñcit karma lokeṣu yad bhavet ॥11॥
1.187.13: durbalā api viprā hi balīyāṁsaḥ svatejasā,
1.187.14: sukhaṁ duḥkhaṁ mahad hrasvaṁ karma yat samupāgatam,
1.187.14d1: dhanurvede ca vede ca yogeṣu vividheṣu ca,
na taṁ paśyāmi medinyāṁ brāhmaṇābhyadhiko bhavet.
1.187.16: evaṁ teṣāṁ vilapatāṁ viprāṇāṁ vividhā giraḥ ॥16॥
1.187.18: kr̥ṣṇaṁ ca manasā kr̥tvā jagr̥he cārjuno dhanuḥ ॥18॥
1.187.25: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā drupadaḥ prīto babhūva ripusūdanaḥ,
1.187.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi svayaṁvaraparvaṇi lakṣyacchedane saptāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥187॥
1.188.1: tasmai ditsati kanyāṁ tu brāhmaṇāya tadā nr̥pe,
1.188.4: na hyarhatyeṣa sammānaṁ nāpi vr̥ddhakramaṁ guṇaiḥ,
1.188.5: ayaṁ hi sarvānāhūya satkr̥tya ca narādhipān,
1.188.7: na ca vipreṣvadhīkāro vidyate varaṇaṁ prati,
1.188.8: athavā yadi kanyeyaṁ na ca kañcid bubhūṣati,
1.188.10: brāhmaṇārthaṁ hi no rājyaṁ jīvitaṁ hi vasūni ca,
1.188.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi svayaṁvaraparvaṇi kr̥ṣṇavākye aṣṭāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥188॥
1.189.1: ūcuste bhīrna kartavyā vayaṁ yotsyāmahe parān ॥1॥
1.189.2: uvāca prekṣakā bhūtvā yūyaṁ tiṣṭhatha pārśvataḥ ॥2॥
1.189.6: āhave hi dvijasyāpi vadho dr̥ṣṭo yuyutsataḥ ॥6॥
1.189.7: tataḥ karṇo mahātejā jiṣṇuṁ prati yayau raṇe ॥7॥
1.189.10: karṇaṁ vaikartanaṁ śrīmān vikr̥ṣya balavad dhanuḥ ॥10॥
1.189.13: kr̥te pratikr̥taṁ paśya paśya bāhubalaṁ ca me,
1.189.17: kiṁ tvaṁ sākṣād dhanurvedo rāmo vā viprasattama,
1.189.19: pumān yodhayituṁ śaktaḥ pāṇḍavād vā kirīṭinaḥ ॥19॥
1.189.20: nāsmi karṇa dhanurvedo nāsmi rāmaḥ pratāpavān ॥20॥
1.189.22: sthito’smyadya raṇe jetuṁ tvāṁ vai vīra sthiro bhava,
1.189.24: balinau yuddhasampannau vidyayā ca balena ca,
1.189.29: yacchalyaṁ pātitaṁ bhūmau nāvadhīd balinaṁ balī ॥29॥
1.189.30: pātite bhīmasenena śalye karṇe ca śaṅkite,
1.189.32: ko hi rādhāsutaṁ karṇaṁ śakto yodhayituṁ raṇe,
anyatra rāmād droṇād vā pāṇḍavād vā kirīṭinaḥ ॥32॥
1.189.33: kr̥ṣṇād vā devakīputrāt kr̥pād vāpi śaradvataḥ,
ko vā duryodhanaṁ śaktaḥ pratiyodhayituṁ raṇe ॥33॥
1.189.35: vīrād duryodhanād vānyaḥ śaktaḥ pātayituṁ raṇe,
1.189.36: brāhmaṇā hi sadā rakṣyāḥ sāparādhāpi nityadā,
1.189.37: athānyān puruṣāṁścāpi kr̥tvā tat karma saṁyuge ॥37॥
1.189.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi svayaṁvaraparvaṇi pāṇḍavapratyāgamane ekonanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥189॥
1.190.12: dr̥ṣṭvā te tatra paśyantīṁ sarve kr̥ṣṇāṁ yaśasvinīm,
1.190.14: kāmyaṁ hi rūpaṁ pāñcālyā vidhātrā vihitaṁ svayam,
1.190.16: sarveṣāṁ draupadī bhāryā bhaviṣyati hi naḥ śubhā ॥16॥
1.190.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi svayaṁvaraparvaṇi rāmakr̥ṣṇāgamane navatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥190॥
1.191.4: baliṁ ca viprāya ca dehi bhikṣām ॥4॥
1.191.6: ardhaṁ tu bhīmāya ca dehi bhadre
1.191.14: kva sā gatā kena nītā ca kr̥ṣṇā ॥14॥
1.191.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi svayaṁvaraparvaṇi dhr̥ṣṭadyumnapratyāgamane ekanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥191॥
1.192.1: vr̥ttaṁ yathā yena hr̥tā ca kr̥ṣṇā ॥1॥
1.192.20: kr̥taṁ hi tat syāt sukr̥taṁ mamedaṁ
1.192.23d1: na cāpi śīle na kule na gotre.
1.192.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi vaivāhikaparvaṇi purohitayudhiṣṭhirasaṁvāde dvinavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥192॥
1.193.1: kr̥ṣṇāṁ ca tatraiva ciraṁ na kāryam ॥1॥
1.193.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi vaivāhikaparvaṇi yudhiṣṭhirādiparīkṣaṇe trinavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥193॥
1.194.4: bravītu no bhavān satyaṁ sandeho hyatra no mahān ॥4॥
1.194.5: api no bhāgadheyāni śubhāni syuḥ parantapa ॥5॥
1.194.6: icchayā brūhi tat satyaṁ satyaṁ rājasu śobhate,
iṣṭāpūrtena ca tathā vaktavyamanr̥taṁ na tu ॥6॥
1.194.8: mā rājan vimanā bhūstvaṁ pāñcālya prītirastu te,
1.194.9: vayaṁ hi kṣatriyā rājan pāṇḍoḥ putrā mahātmanaḥ,
1.194.10: ābhyāṁ tava sutā rājan nirjitā rājasaṁsadi,
yamau ca tatra kuntī ca yatra kr̥ṣṇā vyavasthitā ॥10॥
1.194.11: vyetu te mānasaṁ duḥkhaṁ kṣatriyāḥ smo nararṣabha,
1.194.12: iti tathyaṁ mahārāja sarvametad bravīmi te,
bhavān hi gururasmākaṁ paramaṁ ca parāyaṇam ॥12॥
1.194.13: prativaktuṁ mudā yukto nāśakat taṁ yudhiṣṭhiram ॥13॥
1.194.14: yatnena tu sa taṁ harṣaṁ saṁnigr̥hya parantapaḥ,
1.194.15: papraccha cainaṁ dharmātmā yathā te pradrutāḥ purāt,
1.194.17: pratijajñe ca rājyāya drupado vadatāṁ varaḥ ॥17॥
1.194.18: tataḥ kuntī ca kr̥ṣṇā ca bhīmasenārjunāvapi,
yamau ca rājñā sandiṣṭaṁ viviśurbhavanaṁ mahat ॥18॥
1.194.19: tatra te nyavasan rājan yajñasenena pūjitāḥ,
1.194.21: tamabravīt tato rājā dharmātmā ca yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
1.194.22: bhavān vā vidhivat pāṇiṁ gr̥hṇātu duhiturmama,
yasya vā manyase vīra tasya kr̥ṣṇāmupādiśa ॥22॥
1.194.23: sarveṣāṁ mahiṣī rājan draupadī no bhaviṣyati,
evaṁ pravyāhr̥taṁ pūrvaṁ mama mātrā viśāmpate ॥23॥
1.194.24: pārthena vijitā caiṣā ratnabhūtā sutā tava ॥24॥
1.194.25: eṣa naḥ samayo rājan ratnasya saha bhojanam,
na ca taṁ hātumicchāmaḥ samayaṁ rājasattama ॥25॥
1.194.26: sarveṣāṁ dharmataḥ kr̥ṣṇā mahiṣī no bhaviṣyati,
1.194.27: naikasyā bahavaḥ puṁsaḥ śrūyante patayaḥ kvacit ॥27॥
1.194.29: sūkṣmo dharmo mahārāja nāsya vidmo vayaṁ gatim,
1.194.30: na me vāganr̥taṁ prāha nādharme dhīyate matiḥ,
1.194.31: mā ca śaṅkā tatra te syāt kathañcidapi pārthiva ॥31॥
1.194.32: tvaṁ ca kuntī ca kaunteya dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaśca me sutaḥ,
1.194.33: te sametya tataḥ sarve kathayanti sma bhārata,
1.194.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi vaivāhikaparvaṇi dvaipāyanāgamane caturnavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥194॥
1.195.2: pratinandya sa tāṁ pūjāṁ pr̥ṣṭvā kuśalamantataḥ,
1.195.5: kathamekā bahūnāṁ syād dharmapatnī na saṅkaraḥ,
1.195.6: yasya yasya mataṁ yad yacchrotumicchāmi tasya tat ॥6॥
1.195.7: na hyekā vidyate patnī bahūnāṁ dvijasattama ॥7॥
1.195.9: tato’haṁ na karomyenaṁ vyavasāyaṁ kriyāṁ prati,
dharmaḥ sadaiva sandigdhaḥ pratibhāti hi me tvayam ॥9॥
1.195.10: yavīyasaḥ kathaṁ bhāryāṁ jyeṣṭho bhrātā dvijarṣabha,
1.195.11: na tu dharmasya sūkṣmatvād gatiṁ vidma kathañcana,
adharmo dharma iti vā vyavasāyo na śakyate ॥11॥
1.195.13: na me vāganr̥taṁ prāha nādharme dhīyate matiḥ,
vartate hi mano me’tra naiṣo’dharmaḥ kathañcana ॥13॥
1.195.14: śrūyate hi purāṇe’pi jaṭilā nāma gautamī,
1.195.16: gurūṇāṁ caiva sarveṣāṁ mātā paramako guruḥ ॥16॥
1.195.19: na tu vakṣyāmi sarveṣāṁ pāñcāla śr̥ṇu me svayam ॥19॥
1.195.20: yathā ca prāha kaunteyastathā dharmo na saṁśayaḥ ॥20॥
1.195.21: tata utthāya bhagavān vyāso dvaipāyanaḥ prabhuḥ,
1.195.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi vaivāhikaparvaṇi vyāsavākye pañcanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥195॥
1.196.5: kiṁ vo bhayaṁ mānuṣebhyo yūyaṁ sarve yadāmarāḥ,
mā vo martyasakāśād vai bhayaṁ bhavitumarhati ॥5॥
1.196.6: martyā amartyāḥ saṁvr̥ttā na viśeṣo’sti kaścana,
1.196.12: kā tvaṁ bhadre rodiṣi kasya heto-
1.196.15: tvaṁ viddhi vidvan bhuvanaṁ vaśe sthitam,
1.196.31: taireva sārdhaṁ tu tataḥ sa devo
1.196.36: kathaṁ hi strī karmaṇā te mahītalāt
1.196.44: nādhyagacchat patiṁ sā tu kanyā rūpavatī satī ॥44॥
1.196.47: dadau tasyai sa deveśastaṁ varaṁ prītamānasaḥ,
pañca te patayo bhadre bhaviṣyantīti śaṅkaraḥ ॥47॥
1.196.49: tāṁ devadevaḥ prītātmā punaḥ prāha śubhaṁ vacaḥ,
1.196.50: tat tathā bhavitā bhadre vacastad bhadramastu te,
1.196.51: drupadaiṣā hi sā jajñe sutā vai devarūpiṇī,
1.196.52: seha taptvā tapo ghoraṁ duhitr̥tvaṁ tavāgatā ॥52॥
1.196.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi vaivāhikaparvaṇi pañcendropākhyāne ṣaṇṇavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥196॥
1.197.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi vaivāhikaparvaṇi draupadīvivāhe saptanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥197॥
1.198.1: pāṇḍavaiḥ saha saṁyogaṁ gatasya drupadasya ha,
na babhūva bhayaṁ kiñcid devebhyo’pi kathañcana ॥1॥
1.198.5: rohiṇī ca yathā some damayantī yathā nale ॥5॥
1.198.6: yathā nārāyaṇo lakṣmīstathā tvaṁ bhava bhartr̥ṣu ॥6॥
1.198.8: pūjayantyā yathānyāyaṁ śaśvad gacchantu te samāḥ ॥8॥
1.198.11: tānyāpnuhi tvaṁ kalyāṇi sukhinī śaradāṁ śatam ॥11॥
1.199.2: yena tad dhanurādāya lakṣyaṁ viddhaṁ mahātmanā,
1.199.3: yaḥ śalyaṁ madrarājaṁ vai protkṣipyāpātayad balī,
1.199.4: na cāsya sambhramaḥ kaścidāsīt tatra mahātmanaḥ,
1.199.6: saputrā hi purā kuntī dagdhā jatugr̥he śrutā,
1.199.7d2: tataḥ svayaṁvare vr̥tte dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ sma bhārata,
1.199.7d3: utsādanīyāḥ kaunteyāḥ sarve kṣatrasya me matāḥ.
1.199.7d4: evaṁ parājitāḥ sarve yadi yūyaṁ gamiṣyatha,
1.199.7d5: na cedevaṁ kariṣyadhvaṁ loke hāsyā bhaviṣyatha.
1.199.7d6: yamete saṁśritā vastuṁ kāmayante ca bhūmipam,
so’lpavīryabalo rājā drupado vai mato mama.
1.199.7d15: prakr̥tīḥ sapta vai jñātvā ātmanaśca parasya ca,
tathā deśaṁ ca kālaṁ ca ṣaḍvidhāṁśca nayed guṇān.
1.199.7d16: sthānaṁ vr̥ddhiṁ kṣayaṁ caiva bhūmiṁ mitrāṇi vikramam,
1.199.7d18: vapuṣā hi tu bhūtānāṁ netrāṇi hr̥dayāni ca,
1.199.7d19: na tu kevaladaivena prajā bhāvena bhejire,
yad babhūva manaḥkāntaṁ karmaṇā ca cakāra tat.
1.199.7d20: na hyayuktaṁ na cāsaktaṁ nānr̥taṁ na ca vipriyam,
1.199.7d21: na tān paśyāmi ye śaktāḥ samucchettuṁ yathā balāt.
1.199.7d24: amitraṁ yatate jetuṁ na roṣeṇeti me matiḥ.
1.199.7d25: parikrīya dhanaiḥ śatrūn mitrāṇi ca balāni ca,
mūlaṁ ca sudr̥ḍhaṁ kr̥tvā hantyarīn pāṇḍavastadā.
1.199.7d27: śreyaśca yadi manyadhvaṁ manmataṁ yadi vo matam,
saṁvidaṁ pāṇḍavaiḥ sārdhaṁ kr̥tvā yāma yathāgatam.
1.199.7d31: aiṣṭako dāravo vapro mānuṣaśceti yaḥ smr̥taḥ,
1.199.7d35: tasmāt sandhiṁ vayaṁ kr̥tvā dhārtarāṣṭrasya pāpaḍavaiḥ,
1.199.7d36: etanmama mataṁ sarvaiḥ kriyatāṁ yadi rocate,
etaddhi sukr̥taṁ manye kṣemaṁ cāpi mahīkṣitām.
1.199.8: vr̥tte svayaṁvare caiva rājānaḥ sarva eva te,
1.199.9: atha duryodhano rājā vimanā bhrātr̥bhiḥ saha,
aśvatthāmnā mātulena karṇena ca kr̥peṇa ca ॥9॥
1.199.10: taṁ tu duḥśāsano vrīḍan mandaṁ mandamivābravīt ॥10॥
1.199.11: yadyasau brāhmaṇo na syād vindeta draupadīṁ na saḥ,
na hi taṁ tattvato rājan veda kaścid dhanañjayam ॥11॥
1.199.12: daivaṁ ca paramaṁ manye pauruṣaṁ cāpyanarthakam,
dhigastu pauruṣaṁ tāta dhriyante yatra pāṇḍavāḥ ॥12॥
1.199.15: dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaṁ tu sañcintya tathaiva ca śikhaṇḍinam,
1.199.17: uvāca diṣṭyā kuravo vardhanta iti vismitaḥ ॥17॥
1.199.19: manyate sa vr̥taṁ putraṁ jyeṣṭhaṁ drupadakanyayā,
1.199.20: ānīyatāṁ vai kr̥ṣṇeti putraṁ duryodhanaṁ tadā ॥20॥
1.199.21: athāsya paścād vidura ācakhyau pāṇḍavān vr̥tān,
sarvān kuśalino vīrān pūjitān drupadena ha ॥21॥
1.199.22d2: evaṁ vidura bhadraṁ te yadi jīvanti pāṇḍavāḥ,
sādhvācārā tathā kuntī sambandho drupadena ca.
1.199.23: yathā cābhyadhikā buddhirmama tān prati tacchr̥ṇu ॥23॥
1.199.24: yat te kuśalino vīrā mitravantaśca pāṇḍavāḥ,
1.199.25: ko hi drupadamāsādya mitraṁ kṣattaḥ sabāndhavam,
1.199.26: taṁ tathā bhāṣamāṇaṁ tu viduraḥ pratyabhāṣata,
nityaṁ bhavatu te buddhireṣā rājañchataṁ samāḥ,
ityuktvā prayayau rājan viduraḥ svaṁ niveśanam ॥26॥
1.199.28: saṁnidhau vidurasya tvāṁ doṣaṁ vaktuṁ na śaknuvaḥ,
1.199.29: abhiṣṭauṣi ca yat kṣattuḥ samīpe dviṣatāṁ vara ॥29॥
1.199.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi vidurāgamanarājyalambhaparvaṇi duryodhanavākye navanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥199॥
1.200.3: yacca tvaṁ manyase prāptaṁ tad bravīhi suyodhana,
rādheya manyase yacca prāptakālaṁ vadāśu me ॥3॥
1.200.6: atha tatraiva vā teṣāṁ nivāsaṁ rocayantu te ॥6॥
1.200.9: vyutthāpayantu vā kr̥ṣṇāṁ bahutvāt sukaraṁ hi tat,
1.200.10: mr̥tyurvidhīyatāṁ channaiḥ sa hi teṣāṁ balādhikaḥ ॥10॥
1.200.11: tamāśritya hi kaunteyaḥ purā cāsmān na manyate,
sa hi tīkṣṇaśca śūraśca teṣāṁ caiva parāyaṇam ॥11॥
1.200.12: yatiṣyante na rājyāya sa hi teṣāṁ vyapāśrayaḥ ॥12॥
1.200.13: tamr̥te phālguno yuddhe rādheyasya na pādabhāk ॥13॥
1.200.14: asmān balavato jñātvā na yatiṣyanti durbalāḥ ॥14॥
1.200.19: tāvadeva hi te śakyā na śakyāstu tataḥ param ॥19॥
1.200.20: sādhvī vā yadi vāsādhvī kiṁ vā rādheya manyase ॥20॥
1.200.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi vidurāgamanarājyalambhaparvaṇi duryodhanavākye dviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥200॥
1.201.1: duryodhana tava prajñā na samyagiti me matiḥ,
na hyupāyena te śakyāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ kuruvardhana ॥1॥
1.201.2: nigrahītuṁ tadā vīra na caiva śakitāstvayā ॥2॥
1.201.5: na ca te vyasanairyoktuṁ śakyā diṣṭakr̥tena ca,
1.201.6: ekasyāṁ ye ratāḥ patnyāṁ na bhidyante parasparam ॥6॥
1.201.7: na cāpi kr̥ṣṇā śakyeta tebhyo bhedayituṁ paraḥ,
1.201.8: taṁ ca prāptavatī kr̥ṣṇā na sā bhedayituṁ kṣamā ॥8॥
1.201.9: āryavrataśca pāñcālyo na sa rājā dhanapriyaḥ,
1.201.12: tāvat praharaṇīyāste tat tubhyaṁ tāta rocatām,
asmatpakṣo mahān yāvad yāvat pāñcālako laghuḥ,
tāvat praharaṇaṁ teṣāṁ kriyatāṁ mā vicāraya ॥12॥
1.201.13: vāhanāni prabhūtāni mitrāṇi ca kulāni ca,
yāvanna teṣāṁ gāndhāre tāvad vikrama pārthiva ॥13॥
1.201.14: yāvacca rājā pāñcālyo nodyame kurute manaḥ,
1.201.16: vasūni vividhān bhogān rājyameva ca kevalam,
1.201.18: svako hi dharmaḥ śūrāṇāṁ vikramaḥ pārthivarṣabha ॥18॥
1.201.19: te balena vayaṁ rājan mahatā caturaṅgiṇā,
1.201.20: na hi sāmnā na dānena na bhedena ca pāṇḍavāḥ,
1.201.24: bhūya eva tu bhīṣmaśca droṇo vidura eva ca,
yuvāṁ ca kurutaṁ buddhiṁ bhaved yā naḥ sukhodayā ॥24॥
1.201.25: tata ānāyya tān sarvān mantriṇaḥ sumahāyaśāḥ,
1.201.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi vidurāgamanarājyalambhaparvaṇi dhr̥tarāṣṭramantraṇe ekādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥201॥
1.202.1: na rocate vigraho me pāṇḍuputraiḥ kathañcana,
1.202.2: yathā ca mama te rakṣyā dhr̥tarāṣṭra tathā tava ॥2॥
1.202.3: yathā ca mama rājñaśca tathā duryodhanasya te,
1.202.5: duryodhana yathā rājyaṁ tvamidaṁ tāta paśyasi,
1.202.6: yadi rājyaṁ na te prāptāḥ pāṇḍaveyā yaśasvinaḥ,
1.202.7: adharmeṇa ca rājyaṁ tvaṁ prāptavān bharatarṣabha,
1.202.9: ato’nyathā cet kriyate na hitaṁ no bhaviṣyati,
1.202.13: diṣṭyā dhriyante pārthā hi diṣṭyā jīvati sā pr̥thā,
diṣṭyā purocanaḥ pāpo na sakāmo’tyayaṁ gataḥ ॥13॥
1.202.15: na cāpi doṣeṇa tathā loko manyet purocanam,
yathā tvāṁ puruṣavyāghra loko doṣeṇa gacchati ॥15॥
1.202.17: na cāpi teṣāṁ vīrāṇāṁ jīvatāṁ kurunandana,
1.202.19: yadi dharmastvayā kāryo yadi kāryaṁ priyaṁ ca me,
kṣemaṁ ca yadi kartavyaṁ teṣāmardhaṁ pradīyatām ॥19॥
1.202.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi vidurāgamanarājyalambhaparvaṇi bhīṣmavākye dvyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥202॥
1.203.4: mithaḥ kr̥tyaṁ ca tasmai sa ādāya vasu gacchatu,
vr̥ddhiṁ ca paramāṁ brūyāt tvatsaṁyogodbhavāṁ tathā ॥4॥
1.203.5: samprīyamāṇaṁ tvāṁ brūyāda rājan duryodhanaṁ tathā,
asakr̥d drupade caiva dhr̥ṣṭadyumne ca bhārata ॥5॥
1.203.6: ucitatvaṁ priyatvaṁ ca yogasyāpi ca varṇayet,
punaḥ punaśca kaunteyān mādrīputrau ca sāntvayan ॥6॥
1.203.8: pāṇḍavānāṁ ca sarveṣāṁ kuntyā yuktāni yāni ca ॥8॥
1.203.11: tataste pāṇḍavāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ pūjyamānāḥ sadā tvayā,
1.203.12: etat tava mahārāja putreṣu teṣu caiva hi,
1.203.14: brūyānniḥśreyasaṁ nāma kathaṁ kuryāt satāṁ matam ॥14॥
1.203.15: vidhipūrvaṁ hi sarvasya duḥkhaṁ vā yadi vā sukham ॥15॥
1.203.20: sa rājña upabhogyāni striyo ratnadhanāni ca,
ādade sarvaśo mūḍha aiśvaryaṁ ca svayaṁ tadā ॥20॥
1.203.22: yatamāno’pi tad rājyaṁ na śaśāketi naḥ śrutam ॥22॥
1.203.23: kimanyad vihitā nūnaṁ tasya sā puruṣendratā,
yadi te vihitaṁ rājyaṁ bhaviṣyati viśāmpate ॥23॥
1.203.24: miṣataḥ sarvalokasya sthāsyate tvayi tad dhruvam,
ato’nyathā ced vihitaṁ yatamāno na lapsyase ॥24॥
1.203.27: hitaṁ tu paramaṁ karṇa bravīmi kulavardhanam,
atha tvaṁ manyase duṣṭaṁ brūhi yat paramaṁ hitam ॥27॥
1.203.28: ato’nyathā cet kriyate yad bravīmi paraṁ hitam,
kuravo vai vinaṅkṣyakṣyanti nacireṇaiva me matiḥ ॥28॥
1.203.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi vidurāgamanarājyalambhaparvaṇi droṇavākye tryadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥203॥
1.204.2: priyaṁ hitaṁ ca tad vākyamuktavān kurusattamaḥ,
bhīṣmaḥ śāntanavo rājan pratigr̥hṇāsi tanna ca ॥2॥
1.204.3: tacca rādhāsutaḥ karṇo manyate na hitaṁ tava ॥3॥
1.204.4: ābhyāṁ puruṣasiṁhābhyāṁ yo vā syāt prajñayādhikaḥ ॥4॥
1.204.5: imau hi vr̥ddhau vayasā prajñayā ca śrutena ca,
samau ca tvayi rājendra tathā pāṇḍusuteṣu ca ॥5॥
1.204.6: dharme cānavarau rājan satyatāyāṁ ca bhārata,
1.204.11: etaddhi paramaṁ śreyo manye’haṁ tava bhārata,
1.204.12: tathaiva pāṇḍaveyāste putrā rājan na saṁśayaḥ,
1.204.13: mantriṇaste na ca śreyaḥ prapaśyanti viśeṣataḥ,
atha te hr̥daye rājan viśeṣaḥ sveṣu vartate,
antarasthaṁ vivr̥ṇvānāḥ śreyaḥ kuryurna te dhruvam ॥13॥
1.204.15: tat tathā puruṣavyāghra tava tad bhadramastu te ॥15॥
1.204.16: kathaṁ hi pāṇḍavaḥ śrīmān savyasācī dhanañjayaḥ,
śakyo vijetuṁ saṅgrāme rājan maghavatāpi hi ॥16॥
1.204.18: kathaṁ vijetuṁ śakyau tau raṇe jīvitumicchatā ॥18॥
1.204.19: nityāni pāṇḍave jyeṣṭhe sa jīyeta raṇe katham ॥19॥
1.204.20: yeṣāṁ pakṣadharo rāmo yeṣāṁ mantrī janārdanaḥ,
kiṁ nu tairajitaṁ saṅkhye yeṣāṁ pakṣe ca sātyakiḥ ॥20॥
1.204.21: drupadaḥ śvaśuro yeṣāṁ yeṣāṁ śyālāśca pārṣatāḥ,
1.204.22: so’śakyatāṁ ca vijñāya teṣāmagre ca bhārata,
dāyādyatāṁ ca dharmeṇa samyak teṣu samācara ॥22॥
1.204.24: jīvitaṁ ca paraṁ śreyaḥ kṣatrasya ca vivardhanam ॥24॥
1.204.25: drupado’pi mahān rājā kr̥tavairaśca naḥ purā,
1.204.26: yataḥ kr̥ṣṇastataḥ sarve yataḥ kr̥ṣṇastato jayaḥ ॥26॥
1.204.27: yacca sāmnaiva śakyeta kāryaṁ sādhayituṁ nr̥pa,
1.204.28: śrutvā ca jīvataḥ pārthān paurajānapadā janāḥ,
balavad darśane hr̥ṣṭāsteṣāṁ rājan priyaṁ kuru ॥28॥
1.204.29: adharmayuktā duṣprajñā bālā maiṣāṁ vacaḥ kr̥thāḥ ॥29॥
1.204.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi vidurāgamanarājyalambhaparvaṇi viduravākye caturadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥204॥
1.205.1: hitaṁ ca paramaṁ vākyaṁ tvaṁ ca satyaṁ bravīṣi mām ॥1॥
1.205.2: tathaiva dharmataḥ sarve mama putrā na saṁśayaḥ ॥2॥
1.205.4: tayā ca devarūpiṇyā kr̥ṣṇayā saha bhārata ॥4॥
1.205.5: diṣṭyā jīvanti te pārthā diṣṭyā jīvati sā pr̥thā,
1.205.6: diṣṭyā vardhāmahe sarve diṣṭyā śāntaḥ purocanaḥ,
1.205.8: draupadyāḥ pāṇḍavānāṁ ca yajñasenasya caiva ha ॥8॥
1.205.10: sa cāpi pratijagrāha dharmeṇa viduraṁ tataḥ,
1.205.11: snehāt pariṣvajya sa tān papracchānāmayaṁ tataḥ ॥11॥
1.205.13: pradadau cāpi ratnāni vividhāni vasūni ca ॥13॥
1.205.14: drupadasya ca putrāṇāṁ yathā dattāni kauravaiḥ ॥14॥
1.205.17: abravīt kuśalaṁ rājan prīyamāṇaḥ punaḥ punaḥ,
1.205.18: tathā bhīṣmaḥ śāntanavaḥ kauravaiḥ saha sarvaśaḥ,
1.205.21: yathā sambandhakaṁ prāpya yajñasena tvayā saha ॥21॥
1.205.22: etad viditvā tu bhavān prasthāpayatu pāṇḍavān,
draṣṭuṁ hi pāṇḍuputrāṁśca tvaranti kuravo bhr̥śam ॥22॥
1.205.23: utsukā nagaraṁ draṣṭuṁ bhaviṣyanti tathā pr̥thā ॥23॥
1.205.24: draṣṭukāmāḥ pratīkṣante puraṁ ca viṣayāśca naḥ ॥24॥
1.205.26: āgamiṣyanti kaunteyāḥ kuntī ca saha kr̥ṣṇayā ॥26॥
1.205.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi vidurāgamanarājyalambhaparvaṇi viduradrupadasaṁvāde pañcādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥205॥
1.206.1: mamāpi paramo harṣaḥ sambandhe’smin kr̥te prabho ॥1॥
1.206.2: gamanaṁ cāpi yuktaṁ syād dr̥ḍhameṣāṁ mahātmanām,
na tu tāvanmayā yuktametad vaktuṁ svayaṁ girā ॥2॥
1.206.3: yadā tu manyate vīraḥ kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
1.206.4: rāmakr̥ṣṇau ca dharmajñau tadā gacchantu pāṇḍavāḥ,
1.206.5: yathā vakṣyasi naḥ prītyā tat kariṣyāmahe vayam ॥5॥
1.206.6: yathā vā manyate rājā drupadaḥ sarvadharmavit ॥6॥
1.206.8: yathaiva hi mahābhāgāḥ kaunteyā mama sāmpratam,
1.206.9: na tad dhyāyati kaunteyaḥ pāṇḍuputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
1.206.9d1: pādau spr̥ṣṭvā pr̥thāyāstu śirasā ca mahīṁ gataḥ,
dr̥ṣṭvā tu devaraṁ kuntī śuśoca ca muhurmuhuḥ.
1.206.9d3: kūrmaścintayate putrān yatra vā tatra vā gatān,
1.206.9d4: tava putrāstu jīvanti tvaṁ trātā bharatarṣabha,
tathaiva tava putrāstu mayā tāta surakṣitāḥ.
1.206.9d5: duḥkhāstu bahavaḥ prāptā tathā prāṇāntikā mayā,
ataḥ paraṁ na jānāmi kartavyaṁ jñātumarhasi.
1.206.9d6: praṇipatyābravīt kṣattā mā śoca iti bhārata.
1.206.9d7: na vinaśyanti lokeṣu tava putrā mahābalāḥ,
bāndhavaiḥ sahitāḥ sarvairmā śokaṁ kuru mādhavi.
1.206.11: ādāya draupadīṁ kr̥ṣṇāṁ kuntīṁ caiva yaśasvinīm,
1.206.11d6: pr̥thak pr̥thak caiva dadau sa koṭiṁ
1.206.11d7: śibikānāṁ śataṁ pūrṇaṁ vāhān pañcaśataṁ narān,
1.206.11d8: haraṇaṁ cāpi pāñcālyā jñātideyaṁ tu saumakiḥ,
dhr̥ṣṭadyumno yayau tatra bhaginīṁ gr̥hya bhārata.
1.206.13: vikarṇaṁ ca maheṣvāsaṁ citrasenaṁ ca bhārata,
droṇaṁ ca parameṣvāsaṁ gautamaṁ kr̥pameva ca ॥13॥
1.206.17: yo naḥ svāniva dāyādān dharmeṇa parirakṣati ॥17॥
1.206.19: kiṁ nu nādya kr̥taṁ tāta sarveṣāṁ naḥ paraṁ priyam,
1.206.20: yadi dattaṁ yadi hutaṁ vidyate yadi nastapaḥ,
tena tiṣṭhantu nagare pāṇḍavāḥ śaradāṁ śatam ॥20॥
1.206.22: kr̥tvā tu kuśalapraśnaṁ sarveṇa nagareṇa ca,
1.206.22d3: vavande tatra gāndhārīṁ mādhavī kr̥ṣṇayā saha,
1.206.22d4: sā cintya viduraṁ prāha yuktitaḥ subalātmajā.
1.206.22d6: yathāsukhaṁ tathā kuntī raṁsyate svagr̥he sutaiḥ.
1.206.24: bhrātr̥bhiḥ saha kaunteya nibodha gadato mama,
1.206.24d1: pāṇḍunā vardhitaṁ rājyaṁ pāṇḍunā pālitaṁ jagat.
1.206.24d3: tasmāt tvamapi kaunteya śāsanaṁ kuru mā ciram.
1.206.24d4: śāsanaṁ na kariṣyanti mama nityaṁ yudhiṣṭhira.
1.206.25: na ca vo vasatastatra kaścicchaktaḥ prabādhitum,
1.206.26: pratigr̥hya tu tad vākyaṁ nr̥paṁ sarve praṇamya ca ॥26॥
1.206.26d3: puṇyāhaṁ vācyatāṁ tāta gosahasraṁ tu dīyatām,
1.206.26d5: muktāvalīśca hāraṁ ca niṣkādīn kuṇḍalāni ca,
1.206.26d9: prītāḥ prītena manasā praśaṁsantu pure janāḥ.
1.206.26d10: pāṇḍoḥ kr̥topakārasya rājyaṁ dattvā mamaiva ca,
1.206.26d11: bhīṣmo droṇaḥ kr̥paḥ kṣattā sādhu sādhvityabhāṣata,
1.206.26d13: āgatya kurubhiḥ sarvaiḥ pūjitaḥ sa suhr̥dgaṇaiḥ.
1.206.26d16: jitvā tu pr̥thivīṁ kr̥tsnāṁ vaśe kr̥tvā nararṣabhān.
1.206.26d21: praviveśa tato rājā nāgaraiḥ pūjito bhr̥śam.
1.206.26d22: gāndhāriputrāḥ śocantaḥ sarve te saha bāndhavaiḥ.
1.206.26d27: tasmāt tvaṁ khāṇḍavaprasthaṁ puraṁ rāṣṭraṁ ca vardhaya,
1.206.26d28: puraṁ rāṣṭraṁ samr̥ddhaṁ vai dhanadhānyaiḥ samāvr̥tam.
1.206.29: tataḥ puṇye śive deśo śāntiṁ kr̥tvā mahārathāḥ,
1.206.37: tatra ramye śive deśo kauravyasya niveśanam ॥37॥
1.206.48: taḍāgāni ca ramyāṇi br̥hanti subahūni ca ॥48॥
1.206.50: tatra bhīṣmeṇa rājñā ca dharmapraṇayane kr̥te,
1.206.51d1: dvaipāyanaṁ ca sampūjya visr̥jya ca narādhipa,
1.206.51d2: tava prasādād vārṣṇeya rājyaṁ prāptaṁ mayānagha,
prasādādeva te vīra śūnyaṁ rāṣṭraṁ sudurgamam.
1.206.51d4: mātāsmākaṁ pitā devo na pāṇḍuṁ vidma vai vayam,
jñātvā tu kr̥tyaṁ kartavyaṁ kārayasva bhavān hi naḥ,
1.206.51d5: pitr̥paitāmahaṁ rājyaṁ kathaṁ na syāt tava prabho.
