1.206.51d6: yatheṣṭaṁ pālaya mahīṁ sadā dharmadhuraṁ vaha.
1.206.51d7: ādr̥tya tasya vākyāni śāsanaṁ kuru tasya vai.
1.206.51d8: uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā gamiṣyāmi namo’stu te.
1.206.51d9: jātuṣaṁ gr̥hamāsādya mayā prāptaṁ ca keśava,
āryeṇa cāpi na jñātaṁ kuntibhojena cānagha.
1.206.51d10: tvayā nāthena govinda duḥkhaṁ tīrṇaṁ mahattaram,
1.206.52: tāṁ niveśya tato vīro rāmeṇa saha keśavaḥ,
1.206.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi vidurāgamanarājyalambhaparvaṇi puranirmāṇe ṣaḍadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥206॥
1.207.3: kathaṁ ca pañca kr̥ṣṇāyāmekasyāṁ te narādhipāḥ,
1.207.9d4: pareṇa tapasā yukto brāhmeṇa tapasā vr̥taḥ.
1.207.9d5: naye nītau ca nirato viśrutaśca mahāmuniḥ,
1.207.9d10: avadāte ca sūkṣme ca divye ca rucire śubhe,
1.207.9d14: yoktā dharme bahuvidhe mano matimatāṁ varaḥ,
1.207.9d19: svare’svare ca vividhe vr̥tteṣu vividheṣu ca,
1.207.9d21: cikīrṣitaṁ ca yo vettā yathā lokena saṁvr̥tam.
1.207.9d23: eṣāṁ svarāṇāṁ vettā ca boddhā ca vacanasvarān,
1.207.10: āsanaṁ ruciraṁ tasmai pradadau svaṁ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
1.207.11: prādād yudhiṣṭhiro dhīmān rājyaṁ tasmai nyavedayat,
1.207.14: jagāma tatra yatrāste nāradaḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha,
1.207.18: yathā vo nātra bhedaḥ syāt tathā nītirvidhīyatām ॥18॥
1.207.21: yathā vo nātra bhedaḥ syāt tat kuruṣva yudhiṣṭhira ॥21॥
1.207.23: apsarā devakanyā vā kasya caiṣā tilottamā,
1.207.24: śrotumicchāmahe brahman paraṁ kautūhalaṁ hi naḥ ॥24॥
1.207.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi vidurāgamanarājyalambhaparvaṇi yudhiṣṭhiranāradasaṁvāde saptādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥207॥
1.208.5: vinānyonyaṁ na bhuñjāte vinānyonyaṁ na jalpataḥ,
1.208.7: dīkṣāṁ kr̥tvā gatau vindhyaṁ tāvugraṁ tepatustapaḥ ॥7॥
1.208.8: tau tu dīrgheṇa kālena tapoyuktau babhūvatuḥ,
1.208.11: tato devā bhayaṁ jagmurugraṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tayostapaḥ,
1.208.12: na ca tau cakraturbhaṅgaṁ vratasya sumahāvratau ॥12॥
1.208.15: na ca tau cakraturbhaṅgaṁ vratasya sumahāvratau ॥15॥
1.208.18: dr̥ṣṭvā pitāmahaṁ devaṁ tasthatuḥ prāñjalī tadā ॥18॥
1.208.19: ūcatuśca prabhuṁ devaṁ tatastau sahitau tadā,
1.208.20: ubhāvapyamarau syāvaḥ prasanno yadi nau prabhuḥ ॥20॥
1.208.23: hetunānena daityendrau na vā kāmaṁ karomyaham ॥23॥
1.208.24: triṣu lokeṣu yad bhūtaṁ kiñcit sthāvarajaṅgamam,
1.208.25: yat prārthitaṁ yathoktaṁ ca kāmametad dadāni vām,
1.208.26: tataḥ pitāmaho dattvā varametat tadā tayoḥ,
nivarttya tapasastau ca brahmalokaṁ jagāma ha ॥26॥
1.208.28: tau tu labdhavarau dr̥ṣṭvā kr̥takāmau manasvinau,
1.208.29: tatastau tu jaṭā bhittvā maulinau sambabhūvatuḥ,
1.208.31: gīyatāṁ pīyatāṁ ceti śabdaścāsīd gr̥he gr̥he ॥31॥
1.209.4: cāraṇaiḥ stūyamānau tau jagmatuḥ parayā mudā ॥4॥
1.209.6: tayorāgamanaṁ jñātvā varadānaṁ ca tat prabhoḥ,
1.209.10: tejo balaṁ ca devānāṁ vardhayanti śriyaṁ tathā ॥10॥
1.209.13: yajñairyajanti ye kecid yājayanti ca ye dvijāḥ,
tān sarvān prasabhaṁ hatvā balinau jagmatustataḥ ॥13॥
1.209.15: tapodhanaiśca ye kruddhaiḥ śāpā uktā mahātmabhiḥ,
1.209.16: nākrāmanta yadā śāpā bāṇā muktāḥ śilāsviva,
1.209.27: evaṁ sarvā diśo daityau jitvā krūreṇa karmaṇā,
1.209.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi vidurāgamanarājyalambhaparvaṇi sundopasundopākhyāne navādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥209॥
1.210.1: jagmustadā parāmārtiṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tat kadanaṁ mahat ॥1॥
1.210.6: tato’bhigamya te dīnāḥ sarva eva maharṣayaḥ ॥6॥
1.210.7: yathā hr̥taṁ yathā caiva kr̥taṁ yena krameṇa ca ॥7॥
1.210.8: tato devagaṇāḥ sarve te caiva paramarṣayaḥ ॥8॥
1.210.9: tataḥ pitāmahaḥ śrutvā sarveṣāṁ tad vacastadā ॥9॥
1.210.12: nirmame yoṣitaṁ divyāṁ cintayitvā punaḥ punaḥ ॥12॥
1.210.13: triṣu lokeṣu yat kiñcid bhūtaṁ sthāvarajaṅgamam,
samānayad darśanīyaṁ tat tadatra sa viśvavit ॥13॥
1.210.16: na tasyāḥ sūkṣmamapyasti yad gātre rūpasampadā,
niyuktā yatra vā dr̥ṣṭirna sajjati nirīkṣatām ॥16॥
1.210.17: jahāra sarvabhūtānāṁ cakṣūṁṣi ca manāṁsi ca ॥17॥
1.210.18: tilaṁ tilaṁ samānīya ratnānāṁ yad vinirmitā,
tilottameti tat tasyā nāma cakre pitāmahaḥ ॥18॥
1.210.19: kiṁ kāryaṁ mayi bhūteśa yenāsmyadyeha nirmitā ॥19॥
1.210.21: virodhaḥ syād yathā tābhyāmanyonyena tathā kuru ॥21॥
1.210.24: kurvatyā tu tadā tatra maṇḍalaṁ tat pradakṣiṇam,
1.210.31: gacchantyā tu tayā sarve devāśca paramarṣayaḥ,
1.210.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi vidurāgamanarājyalambhaparvaṇi sundopasundopākhyāne tilottamāprasthāpane daśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥210॥
1.211.1: jitvā tu pr̥thivīṁ daityau niḥsapatnau gatavyathau,
1.211.10: śanairjagāma taṁ deśaṁ yatrāstāṁ tau mahāsurau ॥10॥
1.211.11: tau tu pītvā varaṁ pānaṁ madaraktāntalocanau,
1.211.13: dakṣiṇe tāṁ kare subhrūṁ sundo jagrāha pāṇinā,
1.211.18: pragr̥hya ca gade bhīme tasyāṁ tau kāmamohitau ॥18॥
1.211.20: tatastā vidrutā nāryaḥ sa ca daityagaṇastathā ॥20॥
1.211.23: varaṁ ditsuḥ sa tatraināṁ prītaḥ prāha pitāmahaḥ,
1.211.24: tejasā ca sudr̥ṣṭāṁ tvāṁ na kariṣyati kaścana,
1.211.26: tasmād bravīmi vaḥ snehāt sarvān bharatasattamāḥ ॥26॥
1.211.27: yathā vo nātra bhedaḥ syāt sarveṣāṁ draupadīkr̥te,
tathā kuruta bhadraṁ vo mama cet priyamicchatha ॥27॥
1.211.29: sa no dvādaśa varṣāṇi brahmacārī vane vaset ॥29॥
1.211.31: evaṁ taiḥ samayaḥ pūrvaṁ kr̥to nāradacoditaiḥ,
na cābhidyanta te sarve tadānyonyena bhārata ॥31॥
1.211.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi vidurāgamanarājyalambhaparvaṇi sundopasundopākhyāne ekādaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥211॥
1.212.1: evaṁ te samayaṁ kr̥tvā nyavasaṁstatra pāṇḍavāḥ,
1.212.3: te tayā taiśca sā vīraiḥ patibhiḥ saha pañcabhiḥ,
1.212.5: kasyacit taskarā jahruḥ kecid gā nr̥pasattama ॥5॥
1.212.12: śrutvaiva ca mahābāhurmā bhairityāha taṁ dvijam,
1.212.16: yadyasya rudato dvāri na karomyadya rakṣaṇam ॥16॥
1.212.18: anādr̥tya tu rājānaṁ gate mayi na saṁśayaḥ,
1.212.20: adharmo vai mahānastu vane vā maraṇaṁ mama,
1.212.23: na dūre te gatāḥ kṣudrāstāvad gacchāvahe saha,
1.212.25: brāhmaṇaṁ samupākr̥tya yaśaḥ prāpya ca pāṇḍavaḥ,
tatastad godhanaṁ pārtho dattvā tasmai dvijātaye ॥25॥
1.212.28: vanavāso gamiṣyāmi samayo hyeṣa naḥ kr̥taḥ,
1.212.30: uvāca dīno rājā ca dhanañjayamidaṁ vacaḥ,
pramāṇamasmi yadi te mattaḥ śr̥ṇu vaco’nagha ॥30॥
1.212.31: anupraveśe yad vīra kr̥tavāṁstvaṁ mama priyam,
sarvaṁ tadanujānāmi vyalīkaṁ na ca me hr̥di ॥31॥
1.212.33: na hi te dharmalopo’sti na ca te dharṣaṇā kr̥tā ॥33॥
1.212.34: na vyājena cared dharmamiti me bhavataḥ śrutam,
1.212.34d1: ājñā tu mama dātavyā bhavatā kīrtivardhana,
1.212.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi arjunavanavāsaparvaṇi arjunatīrthayātrāyāṁ dvādaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥212॥
1.213.3: divyākhyānāni ye cāpi paṭhanti madhuraṁ dvijāḥ ॥3॥
1.213.5: ramaṇīyāni citrāṇi vanāni ca sarāṁsi ca,
1.213.7: tatra tasyādbhutaṁ karma śr̥ṇu tvaṁ janamejaya,
kr̥tavān yad viśuddhātmā pāṇḍūnāṁ pravaro hi saḥ ॥7॥
1.213.8: niviṣṭe tatra kaunteye brāhmaṇeṣu ca bhārata,
1.213.16: agnikāryaṁ sa kr̥tvā tu nāgarājasutāṁ tadā,
1.213.17: kaścāyaṁ subhage deśaḥ kā ca tvaṁ kasya vā’’tmajā ॥17॥
1.213.22: anr̥taṁ noktapūrvaṁ ca mayā kiñcana karhicit ॥22॥
1.213.23: kathaṁ ca nānr̥taṁ me syāt tava cāpi priyaṁ bhavet,
na ca pīḍyeta me dharmastathā kuryā bhujaṅgame ॥23॥
1.213.26: vane cared brahmacaryamiti vaḥ samayaḥ kr̥taḥ,
1.213.28: kr̥tvā mama paritrāṇaṁ tava dharmo na lupyate,
yadi vāpyasya dharmasya sūkṣmo’pi syād vyatikramaḥ ॥28॥
1.213.29: sa ca te dharma eva syād dattvā prāṇān mamārjuna,
bhaktāṁ ca bhaja māṁ pārtha satāmetanmataṁ prabho ॥29॥
1.213.32: yāce tvāṁ cābhikāmāhaṁ tasmāt kuru mama priyam,
1.213.36: sādhyā jalacarāḥ sarve bhaviṣyanti na saṁśayaḥ ॥36॥
1.213.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi arjunavanavāsaparvaṇyulūpīsaṅgame ca trayodaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥213॥
1.214.1: kathayitvā ca tat sarvaṁ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ sa bhārata,
1.214.7: mahānadīṁ gayāṁ caiva gaṅgāmapi ca bhārata ॥7॥
1.214.8: ātmanaḥ pāvanaṁ kurvan brāhmaṇebhyo dadau ca gāḥ ॥8॥
1.214.10: dr̥ṣṭvā ca vidhivat tāni dhanaṁ cāpi dadau tataḥ,
1.214.16: tāṁ dadarśa pure tasmin vicarantīṁ yadr̥cchayā,
dr̥ṣṭvā ca tāṁ varārohāṁ cakame caitravāhanīm ॥16॥
1.214.17: dehi me khalvimāṁ rājan kṣatriyāya mahātmane ॥17॥
1.214.18: tacchrutvā tvabravīd rājā kasya putro’si nāma kim,
1.214.19: rājā prabhañjano nāma kule’smin sambabhūva ha ॥19॥
1.214.21: sa tasmai bhagavān prādādekaikaṁ prasavaṁ kule ॥21॥
1.214.22: teṣāṁ kumārāḥ sarveṣāṁ pūrveṣāṁ mama jajñire ॥22॥
1.214.23: ekā ca mama kanyeyaṁ kulasyotpādinī bhr̥śam,
1.214.24: tasmādekaḥ suto yo’syāṁ jāyate bhārata tvayā ॥24॥
1.214.26: sa tatheti pratijñāya tāṁ kanyāṁ pratigr̥hya ca,
1.214.27: āmantrya nr̥patiṁ taṁ tu jagāma parivartitum ॥27॥
1.214.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi arjunavanavāsaparvaṇi citrāṅgadāsaṅgame caturdaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥214॥
1.215.2: varjayanti sma tīrthāni tatra pañca sma tāpasāḥ,
1.215.3: kārandhamaṁ prasannaṁ ca hayamedhaphalaṁ ca tat ॥3॥
1.215.7: grāhāḥ pañca vasantyeṣu haranti ca tapodhanān,
1.215.9: vigāhya sahasā śūraḥ snānaṁ cakre parantapaḥ ॥9॥
1.215.14: kā vai tvamasi kalyāṇi kuto vāsi jalecarī ॥14॥
1.215.15: kimarthaṁ ca mahat pāpamidaṁ kr̥tavatī purā,
1.215.19: āditya iva taṁ deśaṁ kr̥tsnaṁ sarvaṁ vyakāśayat,
1.215.20: ahaṁ ca saurabheyī ca samīcī budbudā latā ॥20॥
1.215.21: gāyantyo’tha hasantyaśca lobhayitvā ca taṁ dvijam ॥21॥
1.215.22: sa ca nāsmāsu kr̥tavān mano vīra kathañcana,
1.215.23: grāhabhūtā jale yūyaṁ cariṣyatha śataṁ samāḥ ॥23॥
1.216.2: rūpeṇa vayasā caiva kandarpeṇa ca darpitāḥ,
ayuktaṁ kr̥tavatyaḥ sma kṣantumarhasi no dvija ॥2॥
1.216.4: tasmād dharmeṇa vardha tvaṁ nāsmān hiṁsitumarhasi ॥4॥
1.216.5: satyo bhavatu kalyāṇa eṣa vādo manīṣiṇām ॥5॥
1.216.6: śaraṇaṁ ca prapannānāṁ śiṣṭāḥ kurvanti pālanām,
śaraṇaṁ tvāṁ prapannāḥ smastasmāt tvaṁ kṣantumarhasi ॥6॥
1.216.9: yadā ca vo grāhabhūtā gr̥hṇantīḥ puruṣāñjale,
1.216.10: tadā yūyaṁ punaḥ sarvāḥ svaṁ rūpaṁ pratipatsyatha,
1.216.11: tāni sarvāṇi tīrthāni tataḥ prabhr̥ti caiva ha,
1.216.12: tato’bhivādya taṁ vipraṁ kr̥tvā cāpi pradakṣiṇam,
1.216.13: kva nu nāma vayaṁ sarvāḥ kālenālpena taṁ naram,
1.216.15: abhivādya ca taṁ pārtha sthitāḥ sma vrīḍitānanāḥ ॥15॥
1.216.16: sa no’pr̥cchad duḥkhamūlamuktavatyo vayaṁ ca tam,
1.216.17: dakṣiṇe sāgarānūpe pañca tīrthāni santi vai,
puṇyāni ramaṇīyāni tāni gacchata mā ciram ॥17॥
1.216.19: tasya sarvā vayaṁ vīra śrutvā vākyamihāgatāḥ,
1.216.20: etāstu mama tāḥ sakhyaścatasro’nyā jale śritāḥ,
kuru karma śubhaṁ vīra etāḥ sarvā vimokṣaya ॥20॥
1.216.22: utthāya ca jalāt tasmāt pratilabhya vapuḥ svakam,
1.216.23: tīrthāni śodhayitvā tu tathānujñāya tāḥ prabhuḥ,
1.216.26: iha vai bhava bhadraṁ te vardhethā babhruvāhanam ॥26॥
1.216.27: kuntīṁ yudhiṣṭhiraṁ bhīmaṁ bhrātarau me kanīyasau ॥27॥
1.216.28: āgatya tatra paśyethā anyānapi ca bāndhavān,
1.216.29: jitvā tu pr̥thivīṁ sarvāṁ rājasūyaṁ kariṣyati ॥29॥
1.216.31: drakṣyāmi rājasūye tvāṁ putraṁ pālaya mā śucaḥ ॥31॥
1.216.32: tasmād bharasva putraṁ vai puruṣaṁ vaṁśavardhanam ॥32॥
1.216.33: pāṇḍavānāṁ priyaṁ putraṁ tasmāt pālaya sarvadā ॥33॥
1.217.5: tāvanyonyaṁ samāśliṣya pr̥ṣṭvā ca kuśalaṁ vane,
1.217.9: pūrvameva tu kr̥ṣṇasya vacanāt taṁ mahīdharam,
1.217.12: tīrthānāṁ palvalānāṁ ca parvatānāṁ ca darśanam,
1.217.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi arjunavanavāsaparvaṇi arjunadvārakāgamane saptadaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥217॥
1.218.3: sa deśaḥ śobhito rājan kalpavr̥kṣaiśca sarvaśaḥ ॥3॥
1.218.17: subhadrā nāma bhadraṁ te piturme dayitā sutā,
yadi te vartate buddhirvakṣyāmi pitaraṁ svayam ॥17॥
1.218.18: rūpeṇa caiṣā sampannā kamivaiṣā na mohayet ॥18॥
1.218.19: kr̥tameva tu kalyāṇaṁ sarvaṁ mama bhaved dhruvam,
yadi syānmama vārṣṇeyī mahiṣīyaṁ svasā tava ॥19॥
1.218.20: prāptau tu ka upāyaḥ syāt taṁ bravīhi janārdana,
āsthāsyāmi tadā sarvaṁ yadi śakyaṁ nareṇa tat ॥20॥
1.218.23: sa tvamarjuna kalyāṇīṁ prasahya bhaginīṁ mama,
hara svayaṁvare hyasyāḥ ko vai veda cikīrṣitam ॥23॥
1.219.6: daivatāni ca sarvāṇi brāhmaṇān svasti vācya ca ॥6॥
1.219.7: pradakṣiṇaṁ gireḥ kr̥tvā prayayau dvārakāṁ prati,
1.219.9: hriyamāṇāṁ tu tāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā subhadrāṁ sainikā janāḥ,
1.219.11: teṣāṁ śrutvā sabhāpālo bherīṁ sāṁnāhikīṁ tataḥ,
1.219.17: dhanūṁṣi ca mahārhāṇi kavacāni br̥hanti ca ॥17॥
1.219.23: tataste tad vacaḥ śrutvā grāhyarūpaṁ halāyudhāt,
1.219.26: na ca so’rhati tāṁ pūjāṁ durbuddhiḥ kulapāṁsanaḥ ॥26॥
1.219.27: ko hi tatraiva bhuktvānnaṁ bhājanaṁ bhettumarhati,
1.219.28: icchanneva hi sambandhaṁ kr̥taṁ pūrvaṁ ca mānayan,
ko hi nāma bhavenārthī sāhasena samācaret ॥28॥
1.219.30: kathaṁ hi śiraso madhye kr̥taṁ tena padaṁ mama,
1.219.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi subhadrāharaṇaparvaṇi baladevakrodhe ekonaviṁśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥219॥
1.220.3: arthalubdhān na vaḥ pārtho manyate sātvatān sadā,
1.220.4: vikrayaṁ cāpyapatyasya kaḥ kuryāt puruṣo bhuvi ॥4॥
1.220.5: etān doṣāṁstu kaunteyo dr̥ṣṭavāniti me matiḥ,
ataḥ prasahya hr̥tavān kanyāṁ dharmeṇa pāṇḍavaḥ ॥5॥
1.220.8: na ca paśyāmi yaḥ pārthaṁ vijayeta raṇe balāt,
1.220.9: sa ca nāma rathastādr̥ṅmadīyāste ca vājinaḥ ॥9॥
1.220.10: yoddhā pārthaśca śīghrāstraḥ ko nu tena samo bhavet,
1.220.11: yadi nirjitya vaḥ pārtho balād gacchet svakaṁ puram ॥11॥
1.220.12: praṇaśyed vo yaśaḥ sadyo na tu sāntve parājayaḥ,
1.220.14: puṣkare tu tataḥ śeṣaṁ kālaṁ vartitavān prabhuḥ ॥14॥
1.220.15d2: spr̥ṣṭvā ca caraṇau rājño bhīmasya ca dhanañjayaḥ,
yamābhyāṁ vandito hr̥ṣṭaḥ sasvaje tau nananda ca.
1.220.17: tatraiva gaccha kaunteya yatra sā sātvatātmajā,
1.220.23: pratyutthāya tadā kr̥ṣṇā svasāraṁ mādhavasya ca ॥23॥
1.220.26: śrutvā tu puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ samprāptaṁ svaṁ purottamam,
1.220.53: gajānāṁ tu prabhinnānāṁ tridhā prasravatāṁ madam,
1.220.64: mr̥gān vidhyan varāhāṁśca reme sārdhaṁ kirīṭinā ॥64॥
1.220.65: tataḥ subhadrā saubhadraṁ keśavasya priyā svasā,
1.220.71: janmaprabhr̥ti kr̥ṣṇaśca cakre tasya kriyāḥ śubhāḥ,
sa cāpi vavr̥dhe bālaḥ śuklapakṣe yathā śaśī ॥71॥
1.220.74: āgame ca prayoge ca cakre tulyamivātmanā,
1.220.77: kr̥ṣṇasya sadr̥śaṁ śaurye vīrye rūpe tathā’’kr̥tau,
1.220.83: śrutaṁ karma mahat kr̥tvā nivr̥ttena kirīṭinā,
1.221.9: prajānāṁ remire tulyaṁ netrāṇi hr̥dayāni ca ॥9॥
1.221.10: na tu kevaladaivena prajā bhāvena remire,
yad babhūva manaḥkāntaṁ karmaṇā sa cakāra tat ॥10॥
1.221.11: na hyayuktaṁ na cāsatyaṁ nāsahyaṁ na ca vāpriyam,
1.221.12: sa hi sarvasya lokasya hitamātmana eva ca,
1.221.13: tathā tu muditāḥ sarve pāṇḍavā vigatajvarāḥ,
1.221.14: uṣṇāni kr̥ṣṇa vartante gacchāvo yamunāṁ prati ॥14॥
1.221.22: vane kāścicajjale kāścit kāścid veśmasu cāṅganāḥ,
1.221.23: draupadī ca subhadrā ca vāsāṁsyābharaṇāni ca,
prāyacchatāṁ mahārāja te tu tasmin madotkaṭe ॥23॥
1.221.26: śabdena pūryate harmyaṁ tad vanaṁ sumaharddhimat ॥26॥
1.221.33: upasr̥ṣṭaṁ tu taṁ kr̥ṣṇau bhrājamānaṁ dvijottamam,
1.221.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi khāṇḍavadāhaparvaṇi brāhmaṇarūpyanalāgamane ekaviṁśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥221॥
1.222.5: nāhamannaṁ bubhukṣe vai pāvakaṁ māṁ nibodhatam,
1.222.6: na ca śaknomyahaṁ dagdhuṁ rakṣyamāṇaṁ mahātmanā ॥6॥
1.222.7: vasatyatra sakhā tasya takṣakaḥ pannagaḥ sadā,
1.222.8: taṁ didhakṣurna śaknomi dagdhuṁ śakrasya tejasā ॥8॥
1.222.9: sa māṁ prajvalitaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā meghāmbhobhiḥ pravarṣati,
1.222.13: na hyetat kāraṇaṁ brahmannalpaṁ sampratibhāti me,
1.222.15: śr̥ṇu me bruvato rājan sarvametad yathātatham,
1.222.22: cakṣurvikalatāṁ prāptā na prapeduśca te kratum,
1.222.25: sa ca rājākarod yatnaṁ mahāntaṁ sasuhr̥jjanaḥ,
1.222.27: yadyahaṁ patito viprāḥ śuśrūṣāyāṁ na ca sthitaḥ ॥27॥
1.222.29: asthāne vā parityāgaṁ kartuṁ me dvijasattamāḥ,
prapanna eva vo viprāḥ prasādaṁ kartumarhatha ॥29॥
1.222.32: yadā na śekū rājānaṁ yājanārthaṁ parantapa ॥32॥
1.222.35: gaccha rudra sakāśaṁ tvaṁ sa hi tvāṁ yājayiṣyati ॥35॥
1.222.36: kailāsaṁ parvataṁ gatvā tapa ugraṁ samāsthitaḥ ॥36॥
1.222.38: āhāramakarod rājā mūlāni ca phalāni ca ॥38॥
1.222.40: taṁ tathā nr̥paśārdūlaṁ tapyamānaṁ mahat tapaḥ,
1.222.42: varaṁ vr̥ṇīṣva bhadraṁ te yaṁ tvamicchasi pārthiva,
1.222.44: etacchrutvā tu vacanaṁ rājñā tena prabhāṣitam ॥44॥
1.222.46: tvayā ca sumahat taptaṁ tapo rājan varārthinā,
1.222.48: kāmaṁ prārthayase yaṁ tvaṁ mattaḥ prāpsyasi taṁ nr̥pa,
1.222.49: tathā cakāra tat sarvaṁ yathoktaṁ śūlapāṇinā,
1.222.50: dr̥ṣṭvaiva ca sa rājānaṁ śaṅkaro lokabhāvanaḥ,
1.222.52: ato’haṁ tvāṁ svayaṁ nādya yājayāmi parantapa,
1.222.53: durvāsā iti vikhyātaḥ sa hi tvāṁ yājayiṣyati,
1.222.56: etacchrutvā tu vacanaṁ tasya rājño mahātmanaḥ ॥56॥
1.222.59: tataḥ satraṁ samabhavat tasya rājño mahātmanaḥ,
1.222.60: tasmin parisamāpte tu rājñaḥ satre mahātmanaḥ,
1.222.61: ye tatra dīkṣitāḥ sarve sadasyāśca mahaujasaḥ,
so’pi rājan mahābhāgaḥ svapuraṁ prāviśat tadā ॥61॥
1.222.65: haviṣā ca tato vahniḥ parāṁ tr̥ptimagacchata ॥65॥
1.222.69: bhagavan paramā prītiḥ kr̥tvā me śvetaketunā ॥69॥
1.222.74: mā gamastvaṁ yathā vahne prakr̥tistho bhaviṣyasi,
1.222.75: purā devaniyogena yat tvayā bhasmasāt kr̥tam,
1.222.76: teṣāṁ tvaṁ medasā tr̥ptaḥ prakr̥tistho bhaviṣyasi ॥76॥
1.222.77: gaccha śīghraṁ pradagdhuṁ tvaṁ tato mokṣyasi kilbiṣāt,
1.222.79: pradīptaṁ khāṇḍavaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā ye syustatra nivāsinaḥ,
1.222.83: anena tu prakāreṇa bhūyo bhūyaśca prajvalan,
1.222.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi khāṇḍavadāhaparvaṇi agniparābhave dvāviṁśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥222॥
1.223.2: uvāca cainaṁ bhagavān muhūrtaṁ sa vicintya tu ॥2॥
1.223.3: upāyaḥ paridr̥ṣṭo me yathā tvaṁ dhakṣyase’nagha,
kālaṁ ca kañcit kṣamatāṁ tatastvaṁ dhakṣyase’nala ॥3॥
1.223.4: tābhyāṁ tvaṁ sahito dāvaṁ dhakṣyase havyavāhana ॥4॥
1.223.7: abravīcca tadā brahmā yathā tvaṁ dhakṣyase’nala,
1.223.8: samprāptau mānuṣe loke kāryārthaṁ hi divaukasām ॥8॥
1.223.9: arjunaṁ vāsudevaṁ ca yau tau loko’bhimanyate,
1.223.10: tau tvaṁ yācasva sāhāyye dāhārthaṁ khāṇḍavasya ca,
tato dhakṣyasi taṁ dāvaṁ rakṣitaṁ tridaśairapi ॥10॥
1.223.11: tau tu sattvāni sarvāṇi yatnato vārayiṣyataḥ,
devarājaṁ ca sahitau tatra me nāsti saṁśayaḥ ॥11॥
1.223.15: uttamāstrāṇi me santi divyāni ca bahūni ca,
1.223.16: kurvataḥ samare yatnaṁ vegaṁ yad viṣahenmama ॥16॥
1.223.17: na hi voḍhuṁ rathaḥ śaktaḥ śarān mama yathepsitān ॥17॥
1.223.19: tathā kr̥ṣṇasya vīryeṇa nāyudhaṁ vidyate samam,
1.223.21: pauruṣeṇa tu yat kāryaṁ tat kartārau sva pāvaka,
1.223.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi khāṇḍavadāhaparvaṇi arjunāgnisaṁvāde trayoviṁśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥223॥
1.224.2: sa ca taccintitaṁ jñātvā darśayāmāsa pāvakam ॥2॥
1.224.4: somena rājñā yad dattaṁ dhanuścaiveṣudhī ca te,
tat prayacchobhayaṁ śīghraṁ rathaṁ ca kapilakṣaṇam ॥4॥
1.224.5: kāryaṁ ca sumahat pārtho gāṇḍīvena kariṣyati,
1.224.13: yaṁ sma somaḥ samāruhya dānavānajayat prabhuḥ ॥13॥
1.224.16: dhvaje bhūtāni tatrāsan vividhāni mahānti ca ॥16॥
1.224.19: āruroha tadā pārtho vimānaṁ sukr̥tī yathā,
tacca divyaṁ dhanuḥ śreṣṭhaṁ brahmaṇā nirmitaṁ purā ॥19॥
1.224.21: jagrāha balamāsthāya jyayā ca yuyuje dhanuḥ,
maurvyāṁ tu yojyamānāyāṁ balinā pāṇḍavena ha ॥21॥
1.224.22: ye’śr̥ṇvan kūjitaṁ tatra teṣāṁ vai vyathitaṁ manaḥ,
1.224.24: āgneyamastraṁ dayitaṁ sa ca kalyo’bhavat tadā,
1.224.27: kṣiptaṁ kṣiptaṁ raṇe caitat tvayā mādhava śatruṣu,
1.224.30: kalyau svo bhagavan yoddhumapi sarvaiḥ surāsuraiḥ,
1.224.31: cakreṇa bhasmasāt sarvaṁ visr̥ṣṭena tu vīryavān,
1.224.37: dahyatastasya ca babhau rūpaṁ dāvasya bhārata,
1.224.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi khāṇḍavadāhaparvaṇi gāṇḍīvādidāne caturviṁśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥224॥
1.225.1: dikṣu sarvāsu bhūtānāṁ cakrāte kadanaṁ mahat ॥1॥
1.225.2: yatra yatra ca dr̥śyante prāṇinaḥ khāṇḍavālayāḥ,
1.225.6: tyaktaṁ na śekuḥ snehena tatraiva nidhanaṁ gatāḥ ॥6॥
1.225.8: tatra tatra sma dr̥śyante vinaśyantaḥ śarīriṇaḥ ॥8॥
1.225.16: kiṁ nvime mānavāḥ sarve dahyante citrabhānunā,
1.225.20: kha eva samaśuṣyanta na kāścit pāvakaṁ gatāḥ ॥20॥
1.225.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi khāṇḍavadāhaparvaṇi indrakrodhe pañcaviṁśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥225॥
1.226.2: khāṇḍavaṁ ca vanaṁ sarvaṁ pāṇḍavo bahubhiḥ śaraiḥ,
1.226.3: na ca sma kiñcicchaknoti bhūtaṁ niścarituṁ tataḥ,
1.226.4: dahyamāne vane tasmin kurukṣetraṁ gato hi saḥ ॥4॥
1.226.7: tasya pūrvaṁ śiro grastaṁ pucchamasya nigīrya ca,
1.226.10: tāṁ ca māyāṁ tadā dr̥ṣṭvā ghorāṁ nāgena vañcitaḥ,
dvidhā tridhā ca khagatān prāṇinaḥ pāṇḍavo’cchinat ॥10॥
1.226.12: tato jiṣṇuḥ sahasrākṣaṁ khaṁ vitatyāśugaiḥ śaraiḥ,
1.226.20: kr̥ṣṇābhyāṁ rakṣitaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā taṁ ca dāvamahaṅkr̥tāḥ,
1.226.32: kāladaṇḍaṁ yamo rājan gadāṁ caiva dhaneśvaraḥ,
pāśāṁśca tatra varuṇo vicitrāṁ ca tathāśanim ॥32॥
1.226.34: jagr̥he ca dhanurdhātā musalaṁ tu jayastathā,
1.226.36: pūṣā bhagaśca saṅkruddhaḥ savitā ca viśāmpate ॥36॥
1.226.38: ete cānye ca bahavo devāstau puruṣottamau ॥38॥
1.226.40: tathā dr̥ṣṭvā susaṁrabdhaṁ śakraṁ devaiḥ sahācyutau ॥40॥
1.226.46: bhūya eva tadā vīryaṁ jijñāsuḥ savyasācinaḥ,
1.226.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi khāṇḍavadāhaparvaṇi devakr̥ṣṇārjunayuddhe ṣaḍviṁśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥226॥
1.227.5: tena nādena raudreṇa nādena ca vibhāvasoḥ ॥5॥
1.227.12: sametānāṁ ca sarveṣāṁ dānavānāṁ ca sarvaśaḥ ॥12॥
1.227.13: tayorbalāt paritrātuṁ taṁ ca dāvaṁ yadā surāḥ ॥13॥
1.227.17: na ca śakyau yudhā jetuṁ kathañcidapi vāsava ॥17॥
1.227.24: devarājaṁ tadā yāntaṁ saha devairavekṣya tu ॥24॥
1.227.27: na ca sma kiñcicchaknoti bhūtaṁ niścarituṁ tataḥ ॥27॥
1.227.30: na cālabhanta te śarma rodhassu viṣameṣu ca ॥30॥
1.227.33: na tvarjunaṁ mahābāho nāpi kr̥ṣṇaṁ janārdanam ॥33॥
1.227.34: nirīkṣituṁ vai śaknoti kaścid yoddhuṁ kutaḥ punaḥ,
1.227.35: rākṣasā dānavā nāgā jaghne cakreṇa tān hariḥ,
1.227.38: tāṁ sa kr̥ṣṇārjunakr̥tāṁ sudhāṁ prāpya hutāśanaḥ ॥38॥
1.227.41: vijñāya dānavendrāṇāṁ mayaṁ vai śilpināṁ varam ॥41॥
1.227.42: sa cakramudyataṁ dr̥ṣṭvā didhakṣantaṁ ca pāvakam ॥42॥
1.227.43: tasya bhītasvanaṁ śrutvā mā bhairiti dhanañjayaḥ ॥43॥
1.227.44: taṁ na bhetavyamityāha mayaṁ pārtho dayāparaḥ ॥44॥
1.227.45: na hantumaicchad dāśārhaḥ pāvako na dadāha ca ॥45॥
1.227.46: tad vanaṁ pāvako dhīmān dināni daśa pañca ca,
1.227.47: tasmin vane dahyamāne ṣaḍagnirna dadāha ca,
1.227.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi mayadarśanaparvaṇi mayadānavatrāṇe saptaviṁśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥227॥
1.228.1: tasmin vane dahyamāne brahmannetat pracakṣva me ॥1॥
1.228.7: sa gatvā tapasaḥ pāraṁ dehamutsr̥jya bhārata,
jagāma pitr̥lokāya na lebhe tatra tatphalam ॥7॥
1.228.9: kiṁ mayā na kr̥taṁ tatra yasyaitat karmaṇaḥ phalam ॥9॥
1.228.11: r̥ṇino mānavā brahman jāyante yena tacchr̥ṇu,
1.228.12: tapasvī yajñakr̥ccāsi na ca te vidyate prajā ॥12॥
1.228.13: ta ime prasavasyārthe tava lokāḥ samāvr̥tāḥ,
1.228.15: kva nu śīghramapatyaṁ syād bahulaṁ cetyacintayat ॥15॥
1.228.17: tānapāsya sa tatraiva jagāma lapitāṁ prati ॥17॥
1.228.18: bālān sa tānaṇḍagatān saha mātrā munirvane,
tasmin gate mahābhāge lapitāṁ prati bhārata ॥18॥
1.228.20: na jahau putraśokārtā jaritā khāṇḍave sutān,
1.228.23: putrān prati vadan bhīto lokapālaṁ mahaujasam,
1.228.26: tvadr̥te hi jagat kr̥tsnaṁ sadyo naśyed hutāśana,
tubhyaṁ kr̥tvā namo viprāḥ svakarmavijitāṁ gatim ॥26॥
1.228.27: gacchanti saha patnībhiḥ sutairapi ca śāśvatīm,
1.228.29: tavaiva karma vihitaṁ bhūtaṁ sarvaṁ carācaram,
tvayā’’po vihitāḥ pūrvaṁ tvayi sarvamidaṁ jagat ॥29॥
1.228.30: tvayi havyaṁ ca kavyaṁ ca yathāvat sampratiṣṭhitam,
tvameva dahano deva tvaṁ dhātā tvaṁ br̥haspatiḥ ॥30॥
1.228.32: uvāca cainaṁ prītātmā kimiṣṭaṁ karavāṇi te ॥32॥
1.228.33: pradahan khāṇḍavaṁ dāvaṁ mama putrān visarjaya ॥33॥
1.229.2: niśamya putrakān bālān mātā teṣāṁ tapasvinī,
1.229.4: ime ca māṁ karṣayanti śiśavo mandacetasaḥ,
1.229.5: ajātapakṣāśca sutā na śaktāḥ saraṇe mama ॥5॥
1.229.6: na ca tyaktumahaṁ śaktā hr̥dayaṁ dūyatīva me ॥6॥
1.229.7: kaṁ tu jahyāmahaṁ putraṁ kamādāya vrajāmyaham,
kiṁ nu me syāt kr̥taṁ kr̥tvā manyadhvaṁ putrakāḥ katham ॥7॥
1.229.8: chādayiṣyāmi vo gātraiḥ kariṣye maraṇaṁ saha ॥8॥
1.229.10: ityevamuktvā prayayau pitā vo nirghr̥ṇaḥ purā ॥10॥
1.229.11: kiṁ nu kr̥tvā kr̥taṁ kāryaṁ bhavediti ca vihvalā,
1.229.12: snehamutsr̥jya mātastvaṁ pata yatra na havyavāṭ ॥12॥
1.229.13: tvayi mātarvinaṣṭāyāṁ na naḥ syāt kulasantatiḥ ॥13॥
1.229.14: anvavekṣyaitadubhayaṁ kṣemaṁ syād yat kulasya naḥ,
tad vai kartuṁ paraḥ kālo mātareṣa bhavet tava ॥14॥
1.229.15: mā tvaṁ sarvavināśāya snehaṁ kārṣīḥ suteṣu naḥ,
na hīdaṁ karma moghaṁ syāllokakāmasya naḥ pituḥ ॥15॥
1.229.16: tadāviśadhvaṁ tvaritā vahneratra na vo bhayam ॥16॥
1.229.18: rocatāmeṣa vo vādo mokṣārthaṁ ca hutāśanāt ॥18॥
1.229.20: kathaṁ na syāt pitā moghaḥ kathaṁ mātā dhriyeta naḥ ॥20॥
1.229.22: garhitaṁ maraṇaṁ naḥ syādākhunā bhakṣite bile,
1.229.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi mayadarśanaparvaṇi jaritāvilāpe ekonatriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥229॥
1.230.1: kṣudraṁ padbhyāṁ gr̥hītvā ca yāto nātra bhayaṁ hi vaḥ ॥1॥
1.230.2: na hr̥taṁ taṁ vayaṁ vidmaḥ śyenenākhuṁ kathañcana,
1.230.4: cara khe tvaṁ yathānyāyaṁ putrānāpsyasi śobhanān ॥4॥
1.230.5: ahaṁ vegena taṁ yāntamadrākṣaṁ patatāṁ varam,
1.230.9: praviśadhvaṁ bilaṁ putrā viśrabdhā nāsti vo bhayam,
1.230.10: na vidmahe hr̥taṁ mātaḥ śyenenākhuṁ kathañcana,
avijñāya na śakyāmaḥ praveṣṭuṁ vivaraṁ bhuvaḥ ॥10॥
1.230.11: nāsti vo’tra bhayaṁ putrāḥ kriyatāṁ vacanaṁ mama ॥11॥
1.230.12: na tvaṁ mithyopacāreṇa mokṣayethā bhayāddhi naḥ,
1.230.13: na copakr̥tamasmābhirna cāsmān vettha ye vayam,
pīḍyamānā bibharṣyasmān kā satī ke vayaṁ tava ॥13॥
1.230.18: tatastaṁ jvalitaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā jvalanaṁ te vihaṅgamāḥ,
1.230.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi mayadarśanaparvaṇi śārṅgakopākhyāne triṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥230॥
1.231.1: sa kr̥cchrakālaṁ samprāpya vyathāṁ naivaiti karhicit ॥1॥
1.231.2: sa kr̥cchrakāle vyathito na śreyo vindate mahat ॥2॥
1.231.3: prājñaḥ śūro bahūnāṁ hi bhavatyeko na saṁśayaḥ ॥3॥
1.231.4: jyeṣṭhastāto bhavati vai jyeṣṭho muñcati kr̥cchrataḥ,
1.231.6: tuṣṭuvuḥ prayatā bhūtvā yathāgniṁ śr̥ṇu pārthiva ॥6॥
1.231.10: yadagne te śivaṁ rūpaṁ ye ca te sapta hetayaḥ,
tena naḥ paripāhi tvamārttān vai śaraṇaiṣiṇaḥ ॥10॥
1.231.12: tvaṁ dhārayasi bhūtāni bhuvanaṁ tvaṁ bibharṣi ca ॥12॥
1.231.17: tvatta etāḥ punaḥ śukra vīrudhoṁ haritacchadāḥ,
1.231.18: idaṁ vai sadma tigmāṁśo varuṇasya parāyaṇam,
1.231.21: r̥ṣirdroṇastvamasi vai brahma tad vyāhr̥taṁ tvayā,
īpsitaṁ te kariṣyāmi na ca te vidyate bhayam ॥21॥
1.231.22: mandapālena vai yūyaṁ mama pūrvaṁ niveditāḥ,
varjayeḥ putrakān mahyaṁ dahan dāvamiti sma ha ॥22॥
1.231.23: tasya tad vacanaṁ droṇa tvayā yacceha bhāṣitam,
ubhayaṁ me garīyastu brūhi kiṁ karavāṇi te,
bhr̥śaṁ prīto’smi bhadraṁ te brahman stotreṇa sattama ॥23॥
1.231.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi mayadarśanaparvaṇi śārṅgakopākhyāne ekatriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥231॥
1.232.1: uktvāpi ca sa tigmāṁśuṁ naiva śarmādhigacchati ॥1॥
1.232.2: kathaṁ nu śaktāḥ śaraṇe lapite mama putrakāḥ ॥2॥
1.232.4: kathaṁ tvaśaktā trāṇāya mātā teṣāṁ tapasvinī,
1.232.6: jaritāriḥ kathaṁ putraḥ sārisr̥kkaḥ kathaṁ ca me,
stambamitraḥ kathaṁ droṇaḥ kathaṁ sā ca tapasvinī ॥6॥
1.232.8: tejasvino vīryavanto na teṣāṁ jvalanād bhayam ॥8॥
1.232.9: tvayāgnau te parītāśca svayaṁ hi mama saṁnidhau,
1.232.10: lokapālo na tāṁ vācamuktvā mithyā kariṣyati,
samakṣaṁ bandhukr̥tye na tena te svastha mānasam ॥10॥
1.232.11: dhruvaṁ mayi na te sneho yathā tasyāṁ purābhavat ॥11॥
1.232.12: na hi pakṣavatā nyāyyaṁ niḥsnehena suhr̥jjane,
1.232.15: bhūtaṁ hitvā ca bhāvyarthe yo’valambet sa mandadhīḥ,
avamanyeta taṁ loko yathecchasi tathā kuru ॥15॥
1.232.19: aśrūṇi mumuce teṣāṁ darśanāt sā punaḥ punaḥ,
1.232.20: atha te sarva evainaṁ nābhyanandaṁstadā sutāḥ ॥20॥
1.232.21: na caivocustadā kiñcit tamr̥ṣiṁ sādhvasādhu vā ॥21॥
1.232.23: evaṁ bruvantaṁ duḥkhārtaṁ kiṁ māṁ na pratibhāṣase,
kr̥tavānapi hi tyāgaṁ naiva śāntimito labhe ॥23॥
1.232.24: kiṁ nu jyeṣṭhena te kāryaṁ kimanantarajena te,
kiṁ vā madhyamajātena kiṁ kaniṣṭhena vā punaḥ ॥24॥
1.232.25: yāṁ tvaṁ māṁ sarvato hīnāmutsr̥jyāsi gataḥ purā,
1.232.30: iṣṭamevaṁ gate hi tvaṁ sā tathaivādya vartate ॥30॥
1.232.31: na hi bhāryeti viśvāsaḥ kāryaḥ puṁsā kathañcana,
na hi kāryamanudhyāti nārī putravatī satī ॥31॥
1.232.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate ādiparvaṇi mayadarśanaparvaṇi śārṅgakopākhyāne dvātriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥232॥
1.233.2: bhavatāṁ ca paraṁ vīryaṁ pūrvaṁ nāhamihāgataḥ ॥2॥
1.233.3: na santāpo hi vaḥ kāryaḥ putrakā hr̥di māṁ prati,
r̥ṣīn veda hutāśo’pi brahma tad viditaṁ ca vaḥ ॥3॥
1.233.9: pradātuṁ tacca śakrastu kālaṁ cakre mahādyutiḥ ॥9॥
1.233.11: ahameva ca taṁ kālaṁ vetsyāmi kurunandana,
1.233.12: āgneyāni ca sarvāṇi vāyavyāni ca sarvaśaḥ,
1.233.14: evaṁ dattvā vara tābhyāṁ saha devairmarutpatiḥ,
1.233.15: ahāni pañca caikaṁ ca virarāma sutarpitaḥ ॥15॥
1.233.16: jagdhvā māṁsāni pītvā ca medāṁsi rudhirāṇi ca,
1.233.17: anujānāmi vāṁ vīrau carataṁ yatra vāñchitam ॥17॥
1.233.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śatasāhasryāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ vaiyāsikyāmādiparvaṇi mayadarśanaparvaṇi varapradāne trayastriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥233॥
